source: Ritual and the Moon (owner book), Parts 2-3

entries.body: The Aries new moon activates your 1st house of Self, a time to reclaim yourself, energy, and power. Happy birthday Aries! It's your birthday month, and this new moon is all about you. Don't let anyone make you feel guilty for taking the time to focus on yourself and your needs. The planning you do this week sets you up for the year ahead. Others might consider you selfish for focusing as much on yourself right now. However, your external reality is a reflection of your inner reality. If you don't take the time to get yourself sorted, you can't fully be there for yourself or others later. This new moon in your home sign creates dynamic tension in expressing a new vision of yourself. The time has come for a complete makeover of your identity and how you show up to the world. Become clear about what you want to call in, what talents you want to develop, and which direction you want to take your life. If you have experienced setbacks this past year, this is the time to strategize how to face and solve any challenges. The new moon in the 1st house is a time of new beginnings, rebirth, and redirection. This moon is a reminder that sometimes all you need is a fresh start. A chance to go down a different path, try something new, or redirect your life. Embrace this opportunity, step into a new version of yourself, make a change and explore the possibilities of what could be. The first house is ruled by Aries and corresponds to the Emperor in the Major Arcana. How would it feel to believe in your authority and proceed fearlessly? When you align with your true Self, you will be on the correct path, and your obstacles will be overcome. If you allow yourself to be influenced by others, acting out of alignment with your authentic Self, you may experience friction and roadblocks. The 1st house is ruled by Aries and corresponds to The Emperor in the Major Arcana. Aries ruler, Mars, corresponds to the Tower in the tarot. With both The Emperor and The Tower energy present, this new moon cracks your shell, and forces you to emerge raw, fragile, uninhibited, and authentically seen. The Aries new moon is a reminder that the only constant in life is change, and the more you cling to your ego, the more the Universe will humble you with shocking displays of power. The Tower is divided into two halves with seven stories (each level pays homage to one of the ancient planetary gods) above and seven stories below, representing the higher and lower consciousness of man. It symbolizes the human spine, with each ring representing the chakras that kundalini energy must pass through in order to reach enlightenment at the crown chakra, which sits at the top. The Tower reveals a basic fact of spiritual life: the Universe may strike unexpectedly, bringing you insights and awareness, in order to break down all the long-established patterns and assumptions that are no longer working; that has been taken for granted or ignored. When the shock abates, you may find a sense of release and liberation, perceiving a divine logic at work. Repeat this affirmation every morning and night until it becomes second nature - "I am strong and capable. I am never moved nor shaken by the outside environment."

The Aries's new moon activates your 2nd house of disposable income and foundation. Aries asks that you advocate for your time and talent. There has been a lot of activity in your sign over the last few weeks and you are emerging with a new sense of who you are and what direction you want to take in life. How much you value yourself is apparent in what you are manifesting externally, so keep showing up for yourself and believing in your talents, beauty, compassion, and creativity. Any behind-the-scenes work you have been doing will also soon be noticed. This month and Aries New Moon is about reconnecting to your resources, finances, security, and your sense of self-worth. You have a great opportunity this week to either close a deal that leads towards success or come up with an idea that can help you generate money (towards your financial success). Use this time to connect to your spiritual and artistic side. While you focus on these opportunities, remain grounded and in the moment with your personal relationships. Take time to realign with your values for the sake of your emotional well-being. You are being pushed to explore how to create a solid foundation under your feet, and to define what foundation and comfort mean for you at this time. Remember — your external reality is a reflection of your inner reality. “Even when my patience is tested, I find strength in envisioning my future goals.” The second house is ruled by Taurus (The Hierophant), with Venus (The Empress) as its planetary ruler. The Empress symbolizes everything in life that grows and flourishes; she embodies the transformative energy that imbues the mysterious process from seed to fruition. With both Venus (Empress) and Taurus (The Hierophant) energy grounds your focus back down to earth. This is a time to put your energy into tangible projects and skills. It's possible that this is a time in which you're being asked to tend to multiple projects at once and to engage multiple talents. The Hierophant is often seen as the embodiment of structure and consistency— two powerful ingredients in achieving success and financial stability. Think of the Hierophant as your guide or mentor — someone who has the experience and knowledge to get you on the path to success. Your mentor can help you stay focused by helping you set clear goals and providing guidance, support, and motivation when things aren’t going your way. By having a mentor, or financial advisor to lean on, you can save time and effort because instead of making costly mistakes along the way, you’ll have someone there to show you the right way. So if you’re looking for help in setting up proper financial goals, perhaps it's time to seek out a Hierophant-type figure who can provide much-needed direction and assistance. The more you commit to yourself in the next six months, the more you’ll see your investments, income, and self-worth grow.

The Aries new moon activates your 3rd house of early education, how to process information, and communicate with your community, siblings, and neighbors. Your mind is on fire and ideas are being downloaded at light speed. It is a good time to share these ideas with others because networking will be successful for you now. Be sure to take that creative energy and use it on something that you can offer others. Focus on yourself, not on what others have or do. You have lots to share, so remember that competition leads to disharmony while collaboration fosters connection. Gossiping will only lead to anger and hurt, so be mindful of your words now. The words you choose to communicate with carry weight. They make an impact and leave an impression. If you grew up feeling like your voice didn't matter, it could be hard as an adult to remember that your words have power. If you've been feeling stuck with any writing projects, this new moon signals to make a push to get these projects off the ground. Aries is ruled by Mars, which gives the gift of energy to push through challenges. The more intention you put into these projects, the more significant their impact will be. The third house is ruled by Gemini (The Lovers) with Mercury (The Magician) as its planetary ruler. The Lovers and The Magician alludes to the magick and power of unions. It’s the energy that inspires covens: to come together and combine efforts to raise energy to achieve a goal. We all need a little extra support sometimes, or it's possible some project, tasks, and life goals can only be achieved by a group effort. The new moon in the 3rd house invites you to seek support in your local community. Connect with friends, family, and neighbors to provide support and receive help in return. Whether it's to take on a new challenge, spark a creative idea, or just find someone to talk to who understands. If you're fortunate enough to have your needs met and still have the capacity to give back, then why not share it with your local community? With the new moon in the 3rd house, make the choice to find those who can help keep your energetic momentum growing creating a harmonious flow of energy.

The Aries's new moon activates your 4th house of home, roots, and family. It is critical to examine the roots of your life to ascertain your connections to family, home, and parents and what keeps you rooted. You might be feeling more reclusive during this New Moon, but it’s helping you to get clear on your inner process. You might also be thinking about exploring inner conflicts around what you need to feel happy and stable. Perhaps there are some changes occurring in your home and family situation right now, or you are assessing what provides you with a sense of comfort and security. This is a time when your emotional needs are being renegotiated. The fourth house is ruled by Cancer (The Chariot) with Luna (The High Priestess) as its planetary ruler. The Chariot symbolizes being active, in control, and taking direction of one's life, needing to take control of one's emotions, and forward motion. The Chariot can represent an actual vehicle, or represent a symbolic metaphor for the transportation of energy. The Chariot, like all vehicles, requires maintenance - be it emotional, spiritual or tangible parts that need fine-tuning or replacing. The new moon in the 4th house is a time for maintenance, of your emotions and emotional body. Take time to check in and feel, you cannot think your way out of emotion. Allow yourself to feel angry, scared or overwhelmed; to cry, rage and process any emotions you’re holding inside — this will help you move forward. Letting these feelings build up over time, can be damaging. It weighs down your emotional vehicle, making your journey more cumbersome Here's an important truth about facing your emotions: it's hard and it takes courage. But doing the work is worth it. By acknowledging and confronting your anger, grief, and fears head-on, you can process them before they manifest in unhealthy ways. Taking the time to express your emotions actively helps you to move the energy through you and out. When you acknowledge your feelings and express them in a healthy way, you are able to move through your emotions and come out the other side with wisdom, understanding, growth & awareness. Just like a river flowing, you can confront your anger, grief, and fears head-on – allowing yourself to feel and process them before they manifest or consume you. The Chariot can symbolize an emotional, spiritual or physical journey. Or, the courage, dedication, drive and motivation to reach one's goal or destination. This could be a time of focused and emotional discipline to remain dedicated to your current journey. The Chariot can symbolize an arrival: that of a pregnancy, a guest or unexpected news.

The Aries new moon activates your 5th house of fun, heart-centeredness, and children. Love, relationships, children, creativity, and self-expression are at the forefront of this New Moon. How you identify with these areas will reshape you. Consider how you are expressing yourself and how it is being received by those around you. It is important for you to stay connected to what you love. Returning to an old hobby or joyful pastime could help lift your mood. “I am most fulfilled when I am appreciated for my spark and creativity.” The 5th house is ruled by Leo and corresponds to Strength in the Major Arcana. The Strength card reminds you of a sacred power, grounded in inner strength and trust, that comes from emotional mastery. The Strength card of the Golden Eclipse tarot illustrates the Fool sitting poised, channeling the energy of the Universe. The lion is a metaphor for the primal energies of the emotional body, the flames referencing its burning passions. Strength symbolizes being in tune with your inner creative flow when time seems to stand still. It symbolizes the power of channeling Source. When you focus on creating from a place of pure presence, you can tap into a field of awareness that unlocks all the infinite possibilities of creation. Your work will come alive and flow through you—not just by you. The Aries new moon and Strength guide you to set intentions to infuse any projects or ideas with a new spark of creativity. Art can challenge your own thinking and spark your imagination. It’s a powerful tool that can be used to explore ideas, create new concepts, and challenge your existing beliefs. Whether it’s painting, drawing, sculpting, writing, or any other form of art, it’s the perfect way to open up your mind to new possibilities and perspectives. Strength can also suggest a time of connecting with animals, inviting a new pet to your home, possibly fostering a pet, or volunteering at a rescue. Animals can be a great source of comfort, laughter, and love.

The Aries new moon activates your 6th house of health and being of service. You need to create a new self-care regimen that will give you more energy, and create more stability and routine in your life. This includes your work environment and learning to balance work with self-care. If you feel like you are not being acknowledged, this feeling will pass. However, this does not mean ignoring negative feelings as unexpressed anger will find its way into your body and can create health issues. Find a way to express it, and if you have the opening, communicate your boundaries and needs to others in a way where they can receive what you have to say. “I transform and know myself more through a structured approach to my self-care.” The new moon is the perfect time to set intentions to introduce activities that can help you channel Aries energy towards better health. Running is a great way to do this, as it increases blood circulation to the brain, improving your mood. Running and walking can also be forms of meditation, connecting your mind and body, clearing your mind, and keeping you present in the moment, which can help reduce anxiety. The 6th house is ruled by Virgo and corresponds to The Hermit in the Major Arcana. The Hermit teaches you to master the Self by practicing silence, meditation, and seclusion. In this stage of the journey, you're being asked to be more attentive to details, looking at how you give too much of yourself and are left feeling drained and under-appreciated. The New moon in the 6th house teaches you that commitment to small actions, daily practices, and short-term goals link to your overall health and wellness.

The Aries new moon activates your 7th house of relationships. Relationships in work and love are the emphasis for you now, as well as the need to balance your own needs with the needs of others. This New Moon gives you the opportunity to make changes that will help you evolve both as a person and partner as issues and imbalances that have not been dealt with will arise for discussion or resolution. Perhaps you are finding that your people-pleasing behavior does not create a win-win situation. Face the fears that are coming up around commitment or abandonment, and work through them with support. Be honest about what you need from others and yourself; it is a liberating act. Make truth a priority in all your relationships and get it all out on the table. Some information might cause a little jolt or pain, but see it as a necessary step toward intimacy or separation. Aries energy is heated, and this is an optimal time to set intentions and create a ritual to Venus to bring more passion and heat into your relationships. The 7th house is ruled by Libra and corresponds to Justice in the Major Arcana. Justice symbolizes cause and effect, the consequences or rewards of past actions, a favorable outcome of judicial matters, responsible conduct, making well-balanced choices, having integrity, and cultivating peace of mind. The Aries new moon in the 7th house can signal a time when you take action to cut certain people or elements out of your life; either to protect your relationship, protect your ability to create a relationship; or remove elements that do not align with your integrity. Integrity is not a one-time decision – it’s an ongoing choice that requires commitment and dedication. Having a strong sense of integrity means not giving in to anything or anyone that doesn’t align with your values. You stand firm and don’t compromise on the things that you know matter most. Justices reminds you that when you stick to your own integrity, you can live life with a clear conscience. No matter the situation, compromising your integrity, whether it be to avoid conflict, and loneliness, or to advance your career or make more money, will take a toll on you in more ways than one - from your sense of self-respect to your professional reputation and trustworthiness. Justice also symbolizes balance. What you need and want from others, needs to be balanced with what they want and need from you in return. If that balance cannot be struck, it will be time for major changes. This new moon is asking you to determine what your emotional needs are, and make sure they’re being met. This new moon is the perfect time to take a deep dive into your love life and make sure that you're connecting with those who have the capacity to understand, accept, and love all of you. If you're partnered, now is a time to look at any areas where integrity may have been lacking in your relationship. And most importantly, be sure to have conversations covering all aspects of the relationship - no topic should remain off limits. Here's to taking an honest look at what it means to deepen your relationships, with integrity and honest communication.

The Aries's new moon activates your 8th house of transformation, symbolism, and other people's money. It is a time of transformation and trust in the unfolding of life. Your focus this New Moon will be areas of intimacy and shared resources, as you are challenged to look within and trust the inner resources of you were previously unaware of. Step to the edge of discomfort, and let go of the small version of yourself; do not fear what you might transform into. You are exploring topics of loss, control, surrender, and delving into your inner resources to cope in this time of uncertainty. Remember that fear can be a gift — even the fear of letting go, that nothing will come in its place, and that the space will not be filled. Trust yourself first, and everything else will align. There is nothing wrong with taking small steps, but no step at all will keep you stuck. The 8th house is ruled by Scorpio and corresponds to Death in the Major Arcana. The New moon in the eighth house can represent a 'death' from one's old Self or old life and a drastic and necessary change in lifestyle. Getting caught up in internal thoughts and life's battles is easy. But if you take a moment to create a tiny altar in your space, it can help you remember what's important and where to focus your attention. Your new moon intention, “security is an inner construct that I have some control over. I build trust in myself and trust outside myself naturally follows. Even in the darkness, I find the light and power I hold within. I burn brighter with every step I take towards befriending my fears.”

The Aries new moon activates your 9th house of the higher self, philosophy, and greater wisdom. Foreign cultures, places, and higher learning are calling for you, and you will find some of your deepest desires nurtured in those realms. Use this Aries New Moon to broaden your horizons both internally and externally, helping you see life in a new and fresh way. Traveling will help to give you perspective in situations in your life that feel clogged and stifled. Your creativity is ignited and you're ready to share your gifts with others through performance or teaching. In relationships, re-frame any debates or conflicts of interest as opportunities to find common ground, rather than focusing on what’s not working. Teaching, sharing, communicating, and learning are the best uses of your time during this New Moon. Your new moon intentions, “creative collaboration dissolves all dissonance.” The 9th house is ruled by Sagittarius and corresponds to Temperance in the Major Arcana. Temperance guides you to find the balance between the Mundane & Spiritual Worlds. If you live too anchored in the mundane, invite in more of lifes mysteries. If you find yourself deep into Spiritual studies, anchor yourself to earthly matter. f you can successfully find that perfect balance between your spiritual pursuits and your life on the ground, you can use the wisdom to unlock the mysteries to live an enchanted life. Temperance symbolizes the merging of the spiritual and mundane worlds, discovering our purpose or meaning, mindfulness of overindulging or drinking, moderation, the balance of passion and reason, and cultivating patience. The Aries new moon signals a time of rebirth, renewal, and belief systems. What you believe shapes your thoughts, behavior, and ultimately, your outcomes in life. It's time to question your core beliefs and see if they need some upgrading. The Aries new moon in your 9th house is also a time to explore different belief systems, religions, and ideologies- and find out what resonates most with you.

The Aries new moon activates your 10th house of career and public recognition. Right now, your career is your main focus. As you discover more about yourself, you might be wondering if your current work situation honors all these different parts. This question might eventually lead you to take on a new career path, or a promotion in your current one. You do not always like being in leadership roles, but now you are seeing that taking on some extra responsibility, whether that be in your current work or on your own, will be fulfilling. You are pushing through some old limitations around personal accomplishments. If you feel like you are taking a step back, it might be needed in order to help you reflect on what is most important to you, and what will help you achieve the long-term goal of success. Use this time to figure out which direction you want to take in your career and move forward. Your new moon intentions, “I try on a new skin as a leader of my own destiny and reality. The comfort of leading others will soon settle in as I move past my comfort zone.” The 10th house is ruled by Capricorn and corresponds to the Devil in the Major Arcana. The Devil/Capricorn speaks to any false belief that you are trapped or stuck in your current circumstances. The Devil usually symbolizes struggles with a moral problem — a choice between lust or love; and it’s important to identify and stay clear of any romantic obsessions or fantasies within the workplace that could potentially thwart your means of financial freedom. The Devil/Capricorn reminds you that you have agency in your life and that no matter what our current circumstances may be, we always have the power to create change. The Devil/Capricorn also signifies feelings of being overwhelmed with an overthinking or an international struggle. It’s possible you may realize a shift in your values and beliefs, or realize that you have taken on the views of others that are misleading you of your fulfillment. This is a time to set the intention to align your career with your core values and interests. If you’ve ever struggled with ambition, life direction, status, public identity, life mission, authority, or responsibility then this Aries new moon is a time to renew and rebirth who you are. It’s time for a personal quest that will lead you to discover what matters most to you and how you can use your strengths to help others. It’s time to stop waiting for someone else to give you permission and start taking ownership of your life. Take time each day to unpack how you want to show up. What story do you want? What experience do you want? Redefine your core values and make sure everything that comes after aligns with those values. Aspire to grow in ways that are genuine and meaningful so your ambition isn't just a means to an end but part of a larger purpose.

The Aries's new moon activates your 11th house of friendship. Friends, community, and networking with others are opening for you at this time, so engage with your community to see where your gifts can be offered. Your ideas should be shared. You are naturally a talker and this New Moon is bringing that out more in you. Surround yourself with friends and people who share your same values and vision, and stay close to those you trust. If conflict is showing up for you now, try to be a conduit for cohesion and finding common ground regardless of whether or not you contributed to it. If that is not possible, consider moving on from the person or people causing this disruption. Avoid gossip. Instead, stay focused on what is working in your projects and relationships, and gently tend to what is not working. Integrating your ability to think practically and outside the box is needed now. The 11th house is ruled by Aquarius which corresponds to The Star in the Major Arcana. The star symbolizes a wish granted, hope, inspiration, and faith. The star brings with it strength and the free flow of energy that is necessary to connect with the soul. Let it remind you of the beauty surrounding us and the broader vision of the future. The Star is a card of one's wish being granted, as she rules over the Law of Attraction. You possess the power to create your reality, and that can start with being intentional with your thoughts, feelings, and who you surround yourself with. If you are an artist: writer, musician, artist, actor, etc. this is a time to set the intention to have yourself and your work seen. If you have an established network, use it. If you are starting to build your network and community - put energy into being seen, and discovered for your art and talents. The Star is asking you to re-align with your spark — something deeper than simply relaxing, or "taking space." You're being asked to take the steps to work on the inner parts of yourself that need your attention and that you've been deflecting or ignoring. The Aries new moon in the 11th house signals a time of rebirth or renewal in your social networks. This is a time to set intentions to create connections and find strength in numbers. You can create positive connections with people who share your interests, and together you can learn, grow and build forms of support. Surround yourself with individuals who inspire you, and don't forget to be an active part of the conversations. Aries new moon intentions, “my bigger vision becomes grounded in reality when I use my words as a bridge to connect communities, cultures, genders, and races. I am a teacher for the teachers.”

The Aries new moon activates your 12th house of karma, subconscious, and endings. This New Moon is in your 12th House, which means that dreams, creativity, illusions, and loss are surrounding you now. Clarity may come in time, but for now, focus on your creative expression. If you feel like you are underwater, know that it will pass soon, and use this time to connect to your spiritual and artistic side. Let yourself dream, meditate, and be inspired by all that is coming through to you right now. Try not to make any solid decisions because not all is what it seems. You may be receiving downloads of information from past lifetimes or ancestral lineage, or trauma that needs to be healed and cleared. Focus on how this makes you feel, including feelings of loss and grief, in order to move through this. It will also be helpful to turn to your spiritual practices and faith to help get you through any challenges. The twelfth house of the zodiac is ruled by Pisces, represented by The Moon in the Tarot. The Moon represents this Law of Rhythm that governs over the natural cycles of life, the changing of the seasons, and the different stages of development. She embodies this rhythm in her lunar phases of mounting and diminishing waxing and waning energies. Pisces ancient planetary ruler is Jupiter, which corresponds to by The Hanged Man. The Moon reflects the natural rhythm and cycles of life, while The Hanged Man represents enlightenment, pause, meditation, and intuition. This new moon reminds you that enlightenment is often found when you surrender your mind to intuition and meditation. So listen, dive deep within, and discover what wisdom lies in your sacred inner realms. Your new moon intentions, “I contain multitudes within each sensation I experience. My body is the divine work of art, unlimited in expression, and shapeshifting to meet each new moment with newness and curiosity.”

The Libra full moon is an opportunity to embrace what makes you unique. As the energies of this full moon wash over you and activate your first house, they will provide energy toward healing and acceptance. As you will discover, this cannot be found inside yourself. As this full moon shines a brilliant light, you are asked to look at your relationship with your self-care, how you compromise with others, and your relationship with social freedom and beauty. The Libra full moon in the 1st house is a powerful time for self-reflection and finding balance. The 1st house, ruled by Aries, corresponds to The Emperor in the Major Arcana and represents the self, identity, and leadership. With Mars, the ruler of Aries, corresponding to the Tower in the tarot, this full moon may bring unexpected change and challenges that force you to let go of your ego and embrace balance. The Tower, a powerful tarot card, represents the journey to enlightenment through the human spine and chakras. The Tower is divided into two halves, seven stories above and seven stories below, representing man's higher and lower consciousness. Each tower ring represents a chakra, which kundalini energy must pass through to reach enlightenment at the crown chakra. The Tower reveals a basic fact of spiritual life: the Universe may strike unexpectedly, bringing insights and awareness to break down all the long-established patterns and assumptions that are no longer working. However, when the shock abates, you may find a sense of release and liberation, perceiving a divine logic at work. This is where the Libra full moon comes into play, bringing balance and harmony to the powerful energy of the Tower. It's a reminder to find balance in your life, let go of the things holding you back, and embrace change with an open mind and heart. To help you navigate this time, repeating this affirmation every morning and night is useful until it becomes second nature: "I am strong and capable. I am never moved nor shaken by the outside environment." This affirmation will remind you of your inner strength and resilience during this change and uncertainty.

The Libra full moon illuminates your second house of money, property, family, and assets, shining a spotlight on your wallet and budget. This shows you where you can take gains or need to make adjustments. If you have not invested in your personal and financial needs, this full moon will push you to pay attention to them. The Sun is in your transformative eighth house of Aries, and the full moon is in your 2nd house of values, bringing lessons of ancestral healing surrounding money blocks, finances, self-worth, and value. This is a time to release any false beliefs passed down from your ancestors that might be preventing financial success and stability; namely, the three most common ancestral abundance-blocking states: scarcity mindset; that net worth equals self-worth; and the mindset that compares you to others. The 2nd House of Finances and Foundation is ruled by Taurus and corresponds to The Hierophant in the Major Arcana of Tarot. The Hierophant represents structure, consistency, and guidance - all essential elements in achieving financial stability and success. The Hierophant can be considered a mentor or guide, someone with the experience and knowledge to help you navigate the path to success. If you're seeking help setting proper financial goals, it may be beneficial to seek a mentor or financial advisor who can provide direction and assistance. This mentor can help you stay focused by setting clear goals and providing guidance, support, and motivation when things are not going your way. Having someone to rely on can save time and effort, as they can prevent costly mistakes and show you the right way. A non-monetary form of investment highlighted is in yourself and your self-worth. If you are feeling down, take the time to write a gratitude journal of all that you have accomplished and focus on what makes your heart sing. Appreciate the little things and say thank you each morning to create an energetic environment that attracts abundance. These simple acts bring you closer to your core values, which are unique to you and make life worth living.

The Libra full moon illuminates your house of communication and the local community. This might be a time to explore changes in where you live or take on home improvement projects. It is also a reminder that it is ok not to be perfect; all are flawed, but what matters is the truth in self-expression — especially regarding feelings and limitations. You can inspire others even if you do not feel you have it all together. The 3rd house is ruled by Gemini and corresponds to The Lovers in the Major Arcana, bringing focus on communication and relationships. Mercury, the planetary ruler of this house and represented by The Magician in the tarot, emphasizes the power of words and the ability to manifest your desires through effective communication. In the Tarot, The Lovers card represents the power of connection, relationships, and choices. It represents the power of love and attraction and the ability to make decisions based on your heart rather than your head. The Lovers card can also symbolize the power of commitment and loyalty and the ability to balance the opposing forces of the heart and mind. Similarly, The Magician card represents the power of words and communication and the ability to manifest your desires through focused intention and action. The Magician is a symbol of creativity, resourcefulness, and the ability to use the tools at your disposal to achieve your goals. He also embodies the power of self-expression and the ability to use your words to create change. In the context of the full moon in Libra, The Lovers and The Magician suggest that this is a time to focus on your relationships and communication, consider changes that need to be made, and improve your communication skills. It's a reminder, to be honest and true to yourself in expressing your feelings and limitations and that it's okay not to have everything perfectly balanced in your relationships. The Magician emphasizes the power of words and manifestation. This is a good time to consider changes in your relationships or to focus on improving your communication skills. The energy of the full moon in Libra also reminds you that it's okay not to have everything perfectly balanced in your relationships and that being honest and true to yourself is important in expressing your feelings and limitations. With the Sun in the 9th house of mental exploration and philosophy, this is a good time to focus on your own development and reflect on your beliefs and perspective. Meditation and journaling can help you process any thoughts holding you back. Speak from the heart and express the love within you. Be gentle with yourself; your growth is an act of living art. You are at your best when you say what is in your heart, so express all the love inside. This full moon encourages you to strive for balance and harmony in your relationships and to use effective communication to manifest your desires. Remember that support from others is important and that some goals can only be achieved through teamwork. If you have the means, consider supporting and understanding others in your relationships. Take the time to find balance and harmony in your relationships and communicate effectively during this full moon.

The Libra full moon shines a light on your 4th house of home, family, and security. This is a time to focus on creating a visually pleasing and harmonious living space through cleaning and decluttering your home. This can be a form of self-care and can help clear your mind and emotions. Additionally, it's important to focus on emotional and spiritual cleaning by letting go of any negative emotions or past experiences that may hold you back from feeling at peace in your home. The full moon also brings to attention the emotional foundations of your life and the role your home plays in fulfilling those needs. It may bring up past experiences and repressed emotions that need to be reflected upon and released. Embrace the power of intention setting and visualization to manifest the home and family life that you desire. This full moon is a reminder to prioritize self-care and make time for the things that bring you joy and bring you closer to your goals. This Libra full moon challenges you to break out of any routines that have held you back and to try new things. You may have stagnated out of fear or a lack of inspiration. The Scorpio full moon illuminates your 3rd House of early education, your understanding of how to express yourselves, and your unique language to communicate within the community, your siblings, and your neighbors. The Scorpio full moon illuminates your 12th house of karma, subconscious, and endings. This full moon shines a light on all the inner work you have been doing these past few years. Release your need to be in control, allow for endings, mourn if needed, and allow yourself to flow with the current of whatever is unfolding, even if the destination is still unknown. By practicing breathwork, you can tap into this energy and release any trapped emotions or past struggles. Reflect on this full moon energy, and take the time to acknowledge what you're letting go of and embracing. Breathe deeply, and shift your focus to the present moment. Take a moment to connect with your breath, do 4-7-8 breathing the traditional way, empty your lungs of air, breathe in through your nose for 4 seconds, hold your breath for 7 seconds, exhale out of the mouth for 8 seconds, and repeat at least 4 times and work through this full moon energy.

The Gemini new moon illuminates your 2nd House of Disposable Income and Foundation. There’s been a lot of activity in your sign over the last few weeks, and you are emerging with a new sense of who you are and what direction you want to take. Any behind-the-scenes work you’ve been doing will soon be noticed. You’re exploring how to create a solid foundation under your feet. Discover what foundation and comfort mean for you at this time. Figure out what you value most, and find a way to allow yourself to receive emotional connection, love, physical support, and abundance. This New Moon is about reconnecting to your resources, finances, security, and self-worth. The second house is ruled by Taurus and corresponds to The Hierophant in the Major Arcana. The Hierophant is often seen as embodying structure and consistency— two powerful ingredients in achieving success and financial stability. Think of the Hierophant as your guide or mentor — someone with the experience and knowledge to get you on the path to success. Your mentor can help you stay focused by helping you set clear goals and providing guidance, support, and motivation when things aren’t going your way. Having a mentor or financial advisor to lean on can save time and effort because instead of making costly mistakes along the way, you’ll have someone there to show you the right way. So if you’re looking for help setting up proper financial goals, perhaps it's time to seek a Hierophant-type figure who can provide much-needed direction and assistance. The more you commit to yourself in the next six months, the more you’ll see your investments, income, and self-worth grow.

This Gemini new moon is a reminder of the power of words. Your mind is on fire, and ideas are being downloaded quickly. Share these ideas with others because networking now is where you’ll find the most success. The Gemini new moon encourages you to explore the ideas that excite you. What creative and writing projects can you commit to? You may be ready to start teaching or even return to school. How can you share what you’ve trained in and practiced over the years? The third house is ruled by Gemini (The Lovers), with Mercury (The Magician) as its planetary ruler. The Magician symbolizes manifestation, mastering of self, working with energy, powerful intention, skill and wisdom, creation, willpower, telepathic communication, and speaking or writing your desire into existence. The Magician is the master of the elements, showing tools necessary for creation or transmuting what resides in our minds and intentions into material reality. The new moon in the 3rd house invites you to seek support in your local community. Connect with friends, family, and neighbors to provide support and receive help in return. Whether it's to take on a new challenge, spark a creative idea, or find someone to talk to who understands. If you're fortunate enough to have your needs met and still have the capacity to give back, then why not share it with your local community? With the new moon in the 3rd house, choose to find those who can help keep your energetic momentum growing - creating a harmonious flow of energy. Your new moon intention, “My knowledge is one of my gifts, and sharing it brings me and others fulfillment.”

The Gemini new moon illuminates your 4th House of Home and Family. You may be feeling more reclusive during this New Moon, but it’s helping you get clear on your own internal emotional process. You could be seeing some changes to your home and family situation or re-assessing what provides comfort and security. You may also be thinking about moving and exploring the various contradictions and conflicts within yourself around what you need to feel happy and stable. This may be a time when your emotional needs are being renegotiated. The Gemini new moon in the 4th house is a time for gathering together for meaningful conversations and for taking the time to nurture relationships that make you feel cozy and at ease. Take this time to reconnect with family and friends, creating lasting memories and strengthening connections. Make the most of this time to gather with those who bring you joy and spend quality time together. Now is an opportunity to make new memories and celebrate relationships. The 4th house is ruled by Cancer and corresponds to The Chariot in the Major Arcana. The Chariot symbolizes being active, in control, and taking direction in one's life, as well as needing to take control of one's emotions. The Chariot is a powerful reminder that you control your actions, reactions, and momentum. And, for many, your Chariot is an extension of your home, where you transport yourself and things from one life event to another. The Chariot symbolizes the importance of having a safe and secure container to navigate life successfully. Your new moon intention, “I am both mother and father, friend and lover.”

The Gemini new moon illuminates your 5th house of fun, children, and creativity. Love, relationships, children, creativity, and self-expression are at the forefront of this New Moon for you. How you identify with them will reshape you. Are you abandoning a part of yourself to receive love and validation? You’re questioning if you show up fully as yourself and how this impacts your life. The new moon is a reminder not to abandon yourself or get stuck in rebellious pride or ego. The 5th house is ruled by Leo and corresponds to Strength in the Major Arcana. The Strength card reminds you of a sacred power grounded in inner strength and trust from emotional mastery. The Strength card of the Golden Eclipse tarot illustrates the Fool sitting poised, channeling the energy of the Universe. The lion is a metaphor for the primal energies of the emotional body, the flames referencing its burning passions. Strength symbolizes being in tune with your inner creative flow when time seems to stand still. It symbolizes the power of channeling Source. When you focus on creating from a place of pure presence, you can tap into a field of awareness that unlocks all the infinite possibilities of creation. Your work will come alive and flow through you—not just by you. Your new moon intention, “my humor, charisma, and optimism magnetize love and new opportunities to connect. I am most fulfilled when I am appreciated for my unique spark and creativity.”

The Gemini new moon illuminates your 6th house of health and being of service. Your health, work, and daily routines may change as new information challenges and evolves stuck patterns. Flexibility is your best friend. Maybe you’re connecting more with community through work or a new health or exercise routine. Anything arising right now is to help you break through disharmony and find your way back to health and service. If you’ve been giving too much, now’s the time to focus on yourself. Pushing yourself ahead when it’s not your time to move will only slow you down in the long run. If you’ve been obsessing too much about your health or work, it could be causing too much stress, and now you need to recalibrate and refocus your awareness. The 6th house is ruled by Virgo and corresponds to The Hermit in the Major Arcana. The Hermit teaches you to master the Self by practicing silence, meditation, and seclusion. In this stage of the journey, you're being asked to be more attentive to details, looking at how you give too much of yourself and are left feeling drained and under-appreciated. The new moon in the 6th house guides you to set the intention to commit to small actions and daily practices and create short-term goals - which together link to your overall health and wellness.

The Gemini new moon illuminates your 7th house of relationships. Relationships in work and love are at the forefront for you now. Any issues and imbalances that haven’t been dealt with will finally arise for resolution or discussion. This season may illuminate the ways in which your unwillingness to commit or make concrete decisions have led you down unhealthy roads and relationships in the past, guiding you to evolve the ways you perceive commitment. Face the fears that are coming up around commitment or abandonment and work through it with support. The seventh house is ruled by Libra and corresponds to The Lovers in the major arcana. The Lovers symbolize unions and the harmonious blending and flow of energy. Libra is ruled by Venus, who adores beauty and harmony, and this full moon is a perfect time to find something beautiful and let it inspire you. It could be anything from a painting, a sunset, or a piece of jewelry. Let the beauty of the world around you fill you with happiness and peace, and allow this to shift your energy.

The Gemini new moon illuminates your 8th house of transformation, symbolism, and other people's money. It’s a time of transformation and trusting in the unfolding of life. Areas of Intimacy and shared resources are your focus as you learn to trust in yourself most of all. You’re exploring topics of loss, control, surrender, and delving into your inner resources to help you get through this time of uncertainty. Your natural ability to dive deep into the underworld/unknown will help you navigate through any uncertainty or darkness. What you thought gave you security may not be so anymore as you learn to access your deeper inner resources to pull you through challenges. Fear can be a gift. Fear of letting go, fear that nothing will come, fear that space won't be filled? Step to that edge of discomfort and let go of that small version of yourself. Trust yourself first and most, and everything else will align. The 8th house is ruled by Scorpio and corresponds to Death in the major arcana. This energy can manifest as a separation or 'death' from one's old self or old life, a drastic and necessary change in lifestyle, or a time to explore your shadow and fears to allow for release and transformation. This is a time to set the intention to explore the mysteries of life. Now is the time to follow that path if you feel called to shamanism, astrology, tarot, or psychology. You may even decide to become a healer or a teacher. At any moment, you can find the brighter side of even the darkest topics and add a little lightness to the conversation.

The Gemini new moon illuminates your 9th house of the higher self. Use this New Moon to broaden your horizons both internally and externally to help you see life in a new and fresh way. Creativity is ignited and you're ready to share your gifts with others through performance or teaching. Any debates or conflicts of interest are an opportunity to find common ground instead of focusing on what’s not working. The 9th house is ruled by Sagittarius and corresponds to Temperance in the Major Arcana. Temperance symbolizes the merging of the spiritual and mundane worlds, discovering our purpose or meaning, mindfulness of overindulging or drinking, moderation, the balance of passion and reason, and cultivating patience. It’s possible you aspire to understand the truth and wisdom behind the mysteries. It's possible that you are struggling, seeking to understand the greater meanings of life, asking questions like, “What is life? What did my soul come to learn this lifetime?” You are looking for greater meaning in the mundane world of the day-to-day, perhaps through something spiritual. The search for true wisdom isn't linear, but diving into the mysteries of life can bring tremendous rewards. Temperance, on a spiritual level, speaks of the potential for true communication with your Higher Self. When you are open to fate and curious about synchronicities, your Higher self can make its presence known. The planetary ruler of Sagittarius/Temperance is Jupiter, which corresponds to The Wheel of Fortune. The Wheel of Fortune themes includes a change of fate, luck, expansion, fate, destiny, positive karma, and the beginning or end of a cycle. This new moon encourages you to remain curious and open-minded to new chance encounters and invites unexpected opportunities. You know that feeling when the Universe is conspiring in your favor? This is the essence of the Aquarius new moon in the 9th house. This is a moment when saying ‘yes’ to a new opportunity, interview, helping someone, or a vacation could lead you on an adventure where you'll discover your new best friend, new career, life partner, new residency or something else entirely. This new moon reminds me of the saying, be careful what you wish for - you must just be limited yourself. This new moon’s energy is the perfect time to take a leap of faith and say yes to new opportunities, adventures, and people life has in store for you.

The Gemini new moon illuminates your 10th house of career and public recognition. Career is your main focus now. You’re discovering more and more about yourself on a daily basis and wondering if all the different parts of yourself are being honored and acknowledged in your career. Sudden changes in status, responsibility, or direction will further your growth, even if it’s unclear how at the moment. Take a step back from this current timeline and focus on the long-range details. Make sure that whatever you put your energy into, it aligns with your values and is building toward your future. How can you support yourself with podcasts, books, or finding a mentor to empower you to expand and step more into a public role? This question might eventually lead you to take on a new career path or maybe even a promotion. The 10th house is ruled by Capricorn and corresponds to the Devil in the Major Arcana. The Devil/Capricorn speaks to your false belief that you are trapped or stuck in your current circumstances. The Devil symbolizes struggles with a moral problem — or feeling overwhelmed with an international struggle. Gemini, in its shadow, is prone to gossip; and it’s important during this new moon to not succumb to gossip within the workplace. Set the intention to surround yourself with networks and colleagues who have integrity and to avoid office drama.

The Gemini new moon illuminates your 11th house of friendships and networks. You’re a natural leader, and this New Moon is bringing that out more in you. Network, connect, and create community. Your ideas should be shared and collaborated with others. Community and networking is a big focus for you now. Friendships may be changing, and you might find yourself working with groups that are new and different for you. This is good to help you explore new sides of yourself and get exposed to new ideas and visions. It's time to be present, connect with others, and become a conduit for connection and kindness. Give someone an encouraging word and help them feel connected and less alone. With the new moon, you are guided to bring hope and compassion back into your shared experience. Attend parties with an open heart, and open mind, and let your Light shine. The 11th house is ruled by Aquarius (The Star) with planetary rulers Saturn (The World) and Uranus (The Fool). The Star symbolizes one's wish granted, as it rules over the Law of Attraction. Whatever you put your intention towards, you can bring into your reality. If you are looking to be discovered and seen for your art and talents - now is the time to take action and set those intentions. This starts with being intentional with your thoughts, feelings, and who you surround yourself with. If you are an artist: writer, musician, artist, actor, etc., this is a time to set the intention to have yourself and your work seen. If you have an established network, use it. If you are starting to build your network and community - put energy into being seen, and discovered for your art and talents.

The Gemini new moon illuminates your 12th house of karma, subconscious, and endings. Cancer, Luna is your ruler. This New Moon is in your 12th house, the Pisces house. If you feel like you’re underwater, know that this will pass soon and use this time to connect to your spiritual and artistic side. Let yourself dream, meditate, and be inspired by all that’s coming through to you right now. You may be receiving downloads of information from past lifetimes or ancestral lineage, a trauma that needs to be healed and cleared. Focus on how this makes you feel. You need to move and feel your way through this information. The new moon in the 12th house also represents rest and reflection - this is a good idea to take some time for yourself and regenerate. The 12th house is ruled by Pisces, with the ancient ruler of Jupiter corresponding to the Wheel of Fortune in the Major Arcana. This cosmic wheel symbolizes the ever-changing cycles of life and the endings that come with them. You can tap into its fortune if you remain in alignment with Universal energy but resist it, and you can experience turbulent waters. Life is all about flow, so remember to center yourself within this infinite energy and trust that it will guide you.

The Sagittarius full moon is illuminating your 1st House of Self. It's time to focus on new beginnings and releasing old unhealthy patterns. Focus on how you see yourself rather than how others see you. With this Sagittarius full moon's opposition to the Sun in Gemini, you are being called to expand any rigid, limiting, outdated thoughts that have held you back. full moons are a time of illumination, shining a light even into the depths of your shadow, allowing you to witness your whole self. This full moon may bring a deeper understanding of the parts of yourself you've been hiding, who you are, and who you have grown into. This is a time of celebration, an ideal time to celebrate all that you are. Aries rules the 1st house and corresponds to the Emperor in major arcana. Aries grants you the energy, courage, and wisdom to tackle any challenge. Use this energy on the full moon to face your fears, overcome adversity, and commit to one path and intention until it's fully manifested. Then move on to your following intention and goal. This will help expand your spirit to your full potential.

The Sagittarius full moon illuminates your 2nd House of Disposable Income and Foundation. Sagittarius is a truth-seeker, and the truth is it's time to do some accounting. Take stock of the financial lessons (positive and negative) you've learned these past six months. The full moon in the second house is an opportunity to reflect on your income and security and to re-examine your views on money, finances, and debt. The full moon shines a spotlight on your wallet and budget, showing you where you can make gains or need to make necessary adjustments. You may be reassessing how secure you feel financially, and take this time to see what steps you need to take to create more of a supportive financial foundation. The full moon guides you to shift and let go of critical thoughts that sabotage your self-worth and self-esteem. The more you commit to yourself in the next six months, the more you'll see your investments and income growth. Taurus rules the 2nd house, and with the Sagittarius moon activating your second house, you realize you need a firm foundation to expand. This is a powerful time to remember that your self-worth comes from within. If you're feeling stuck, you must create a strong foundation. This month you thrive with routine and rituals, reinforcing your subconscious that your self-worth comes from knowing that you can always rely on yourself. So long as you feel worthy of it, you have the potential to be abundant in any energy.

The Sagittarius full moon illuminates your 3rd house of communication, early education, and understanding how to express yourself and communicate with your community, siblings, and neighbors. The full moon illuminates, and in the third house, this energy can manifest as a change in your local environment: renovation, renovation to your favorite shop/coffee house/store or gym, or perhaps one of your local destinations closes its doors. Sagittarius seeks the truth, and this full moon can illuminate or highlight communication/information/gossip previously in the shadows. This is a beautiful week to celebrate your siblings and/or social media accomplishments (especially if you're in marketing). This is also an excellent time to communicate and clear up any misunderstandings or falling-outs you may have had with your siblings. Gemini rules the third house and corresponds to The Lovers in the Major Arcana. This is a great time to associate with expanding knowledge. You have an innate thirst for information and love to share what you've learned with others. During this Sagittarius full moon, you may have an insatiable desire to learn and to share what you've learned with others. So you must remember that not everyone agrees with your passions, but those who do could be your biggest supporters. Don't be afraid to put yourself out there. Share your ideas and listen to your partners in theirs so you can all work together to expand.

The Sagittarius full moon illuminates your 4th house of home and family, a time when your home, family, and security are brought more into your awareness. The energy can manifest in challenging family dynamics and healing between family members. It's also possible that your family may need more for you. Sagittarius is the truth seeker and storyteller. This full moon is here to help you better learn, understand, and hopefully heal a wound from your past, childhood, or family history. The 4th house is a Karmic house, bringing family situations to the surface for more profound understanding to learn and then release. It's also possible you recently moved, need to move closer to family, or are settling into a new home. This Sagittarius moon asks you to expand and leverage your Virgo qualities of cleaning and organizing your space to grow. Over these next six months, cultivate actions that facilitate peace in your home and family environments. Your full moon intention, "Find home and comfort inside yourself despite any chaos that surrounds you." Cancer rules the 4th house and corresponds to The Chariot in the major arcana. The Sagittarius full moon in the 4th house brings positive movement and expansion when you channel your energy to cultivate a healthy home life. During this full moon, focus on things that feel like home to expand your energy. Different places feel like home at different times. Experiment. You grow through quiet time in the right environment and with supportive people. During this full moon, whether biological or soul family, family is important to you. Full moons are also a time of celebration; celebrate ad cherish the people in your life and rely on them to pull you out of your cave or welcome them in; if the weather isn't right for an outing.

The Sagittarius full moon illuminates your 5th house of fun and creativity. This full moon invites you to reflect on your relationships. Are they bringing you joy or leaving you feeling drained and unfulfilled? Now is an ideal time to examine what's bringing you pleasure, creativity, and emotional fulfillment. The full moon in the fifth house is a time for self-expression and feeding into your true desires. Buried emotions surface as you re-evaluate what brings you creative and emotional fulfillment. Jupiter, the planetary ruler of Sagittarius, asks that you expand, take up space, and think big. To be big, you must advocate for yourself and step into the comfort of your energy being seen and felt by others. Whatever resistance you feel towards being seen, lean into it and figure out what there is to learn. This full moon illuminates the importance of believing in your divine creative gifts and visions. You're sourcing inspiration from your past to create your present and future. Be uniquely yourself, and build trust in the process of your creative self-expression. The fifth house is ruled by Leo and corresponds to Strength in the major arcana. The Sagittarius full moon in the fifth house asks that you honor your Strength, power, and potential as a leader. On this full moon, dare to show your heart. If you dare to be yourself and follow your heart, you can step into your most authentic self. Be honest with yourself and others, and then make room for that honesty to shine through. Whether that means opening up to someone new or revealing some part of yourself that you've been keeping hidden away. It's time for you to step into the potential that lies inside and unleash it. Dare to expose your heart and release any blocks that keep you from doing so.

The Sagittarius full moon illuminates your 6th house of health and being of service. This is an excellent time to release any daily habits or activities that harm your overall well-being. Perhaps learning gentle, energetic practices like Qi Gong, Yoga, and Tai Chi may help revitalize and inspire you. You need to create a new self-care regimen that will give you more energy and create more stability and routine. Take a moment and see what activities bring you the most distraction, and take steps to empower yourself - reclaim the real estate in your head. Whatever pillar of your day-to-day life feels unclear, tend to it and ask yourself what it's teaching you. Jupiter, the planetary ruler for Sagittarius, asks that you expand and think of your long-term goals. While the 6th house shows you how daily practices and small actions towards short-term goals link to your bigger vision and all that you wish to call into fruition. Take note of what you have achieved. Honor the work, effort, and labor you have put into your work and self. Your full moon intention, "Slow down and focus on the details of health, work, and daily habits." The sixth house is ruled by Virgo and corresponds to The Hermit in the major arcana. Hermits are the keeper of wisdom. A true teacher shows how to find the answers within oneself instead of giving the answer. If you seek guidance and knowledge, you can discover this wisdom by helping others. When you help another, you learn to expand through their healing; in return, you learn tools to heal yourself. The full moon in Sagittarius is a time to trust yourself and what you have to offer. Trust yourself, and trust in the healing power of your presence and touch.

The Sagittarius full moon illuminates your 7th House of Relationships. You’re a natural communicator, and this full moon deepens your desire to talk and connect with those you committed to these past few years. Take time to show up for these conversations. Face the fears around commitment or abandonment and work through them with support. Allow yourself to listen, and be open to truths revealed - yours and theirs. This full moon illuminates the important unions; may you find them and redefine them. This full moon helps you recognize the gift of co-creating and commitment; it asks that you honor your promise to others and your commitment to yourself. Sagittarius requires nothing less than the truth, and this full moon will hold space for truths that need to come to the surface to be recognized. The full moon in the seventh house can signal a time to celebrate relationships that are in balance, entering deeper into a level of commitment (marriage, engagement, moving in together, starting a business), and the relationships where there is a lack of balance result in endings. Any commitments that have hit limitations or need to be released can be at this time. Over the next six months, explore what a healthy relationship built on truth and trust looks and feels like for you. The seventh house is ruled by Libra and corresponds to The Lovers in the major arcana. The Lovers symbolize unions and the harmonious blending and flow of energy. Libra is ruled by Venus, who adores beauty and harmony, and this full moon is a perfect time to find something beautiful and let it inspire you. It could be anything from a painting, a sunset, or a piece of jewelry. Let the beauty of the world around you fill you with happiness and peace, and allow this to shift your energy.

The Sagittarius full moon illuminates your 8th House of Transformation, Symbolism, and Other People's Money. The full moon in the eighth house illuminates what others have given to support us (or didn't give support) and signals a time when we can give back to those who have helped us along our journey or let go of the baggage that was given that we no longer need to carry. We often carry with us the generational conditioning of our ancestors without realizing it. But it's never too late to take back control of your life and forgive yourself for any limitations imposed on you. You have the power now to break free from any conditioning and embrace your true potential. Take time to reflect on any debt or shared resources holding you back, and take steps and address how you can free yourself from these obligations. This full moon illuminates how you've healed and how this healing has transformed you. This is a time to prioritize your mental, emotional, and physical health over the next six months. This full moon, ruled by Jupiter, asks you to expand; continue to let go of that small version of yourself. Don't fear what you might transform into. You are much more expansive and empowered than you realize. The 8th house is ruled by Scorpio and corresponds to Death in the major arcana. This energy can manifest as a separation or 'death' from one's old self or old life, a drastic and necessary change in lifestyle, or a time to explore your shadow and fears to allow for release and transformation. In your 8th house, the Sagittarius full moon is a time to reflect upon your fears. It's a time to delve deep into the mysteries of life and explore all the hidden corners of your soul. Now is the time to follow that path if you're feeling called to shamanism, astrology, tarot, or psychology. You may even decide to become a healer or a teacher. At any moment, you can find the brighter side of even the darkest topics and add a little lightness to the conversation. On this full moon, meditate on your fears and notice how they affect your mental, emotional, and physical well-being. Notice which fears hold you back and which are limiting you. Once you identify these fears, take steps to strengthen your belief in yourself and your intuition. Let yourself be guided and inspired by your own intuition. Honor your sacredness, and embrace the wisdom and power that flows from within. Let it remind you that you're here to grow, evolve, and expand.

The Sagittarius full moon illuminates your 9th House of Higher Self. This past year has been very challenging for you and has you questioning spirituality, philosophy, fairness (or lack of justice of life), and if there is Divine logic. Losing faith is part of questioning, learning, and building trust in the unknown. This full moon asks that you trust your process. Take this time to meditate, deepen your relationship with your Higher Self, and prioritize your spiritual and emotional wellness. Release any social conditioning that has allowed you to "rationalize" and ignore any spiritual lessons given to you this past year. This full moon signals a time of honor to honor and appreciate all the spiritual work you have done for yourself; the humbling in knowing lessons and learnings are part of your journey and the unfolding path. The more you know, the more you realize you do not know. The 9th house is ruled by Sagittarius and corresponds to Temperance in the major arcana. Temperance symbolizes the merging of the spiritual and mundane worlds. On a spiritual level, Temperance speaks of the potential for genuine communication with your Higher Self. It is a moment of spiritual transformation. The Sagittarius full moon in your ninth house will teach you to question the deeper meaning of life. You are here to learn, explore, and make mistakes. This can leave you confused and uncertain, but that's also what makes it so attractive. It makes you question. When you can find the courage to challenge your fears, you will discover that life is truly an adventure. Stay true to your soul's path, and you will find incredible luck and new opportunities for personal growth during this Sagitarrius full moon.

The Sagittarius full moon illuminates your 10th house of career and purpose. You don’t always like being in leadership roles. However, this full moon asks that you step into your greater purpose and take on more responsibility, whether in your current work or forging a path on your own. This is a time to release any resistance to accountability, responsibility, feelings of imposture syndrome, and self-sabotaging tendencies that hold you back from shying away from maturing into your "adult" life and greater purpose. The 10th house is ruled by Capricorn and corresponds to the Devil in the major arcana. The Sagittarius full moon in the 10th house teaches you can expand through focus. You're motivated to take action and accomplish your most ambitious goals during this full moon. But don't forget to stay balanced along the way! So, try adding small doses of fun, like taking time for yourself or pursuing a hobby. The full moon asks you to focus and commit to a project, and you can trust that you'll be equipped with the strength to continue.

The Sagittarius full moon illuminates your 11th house of friendships. This full moon illuminates the importance of those you surround yourself with. You seek community and friendship, and you're ready to release any false friends or networks that do not support your purpose or the purpose of the greater good. Stay focused on what's working in your projects and relationships, and gently release anything that is not working. This full moon gifts awareness of the social structure you have cultivated for yourself and a time to enjoy those you choose to surround yourself with. The 11th house is ruled by Aquarius, your sign, and corresponds to The Star in the major arcana. This full moon teaches you to expand through unique experiences, embracing your unconventional ideas, which you do naturally. You can reach your full potential by embracing and sharing these ideas with the world. You may start a business that helps the world innovate with new technology and progressive ideas. The full moon lets you release the fear of stepping into your uniqueness and full potential.

The Sagittarius full moon illuminates your 12th house of karma, Subconscious, and Endings. This full Moon shines a light on all the inner work you have been doing these past few years. This may be a more emotional time than usual, as dreams, creativity, illusions, and loss surround you now. You may receive downloads of information from past lifetimes/ancestral lineage and the trauma that needs to be healed, cleared, and released. This full Moon signals a time for stillness within yourself and observation. Reflect on any deep purging you've done, and reflect on what you want to call in to fill the space. Release your need to be in control, and allow yourself to flow with the current of whatever is unfolding. No time is wasted when you are in flow with the Universe and being guided towards a life built on truth and your greater and true happiness. The 12th house is ruled by Pisces and corresponds to the Moon in the major arcana. The Moon symbolizes mysticism, lunar rituals, and being drawn to the magick of the Moon. With the Sagittarius full moon in your 12th house, you are asked to expand spiritually, connect with your divine wisdom, and heal others. Pisces gives access to the unseen worlds in which healing and regeneration occur, allowing you to be still within the oneness of the cosmos, remembering that you are more than just a physical being. If you're feeling blocked or uninspired, try cleansing your energy and creating an altar to honor your magick. Doing so will recharge your spiritual batteries and provide you with much-needed inspiration. Stay open, be still, and surrender — you never know what wisdom and healing you might receive.

Happy Birthday Cancer! The Cancer new moon shines alight upon you, illuminating your 1st House of Self. This New Moon in your home sign creates some dynamic tension on how you communicate a new vision of yourself. Big changes are in store for you now in relationships and how you express yourself. The time has come for a full makeover of your identity and how you meet the world. This is the time to clarify what you want to call in, what talents you want to develop, and which direction you want to take in life. If you have experienced setbacks this past year, this is the time to strategize on how to face and solve any challenges. With a New Moon in your sign, it’s time to focus on new beginnings and releasing old unhealthy patterns. This is a time of rebirth and redirection. Your intention for this New Moon is “to trust where your emotional and intuitive compass is taking you and be true to your inner guidance.” The 1st house is ruled by Aries (The Emperor), with the ruling planet Mars (The Tower). The Cancer (The Chariot) new moon in the 1st house can signal a time when you’re being Divinely guided, through symbols or dreams, to reconsider how you navigate and show up in the world. Cancer corresponds to The Chariot in the Major Arcana. The Chariot symbolizes being active, in control, and taking direction of one's life, as well as needing to take control of one's emotions. Aries represent new beginnings and karmic cycles. While the Emperor asks you to find and assert your individuality apart from external, socially defined norms, you may struggle with discomfort in exerting your individuality. The Cancer new moon is a time to set intentions to step firmly into your authority and power, cultivating a healthy self-image and personal responsibility. The new moon wants you to be your own source of recognition and control; instead of letting others dictate your worth and value. The Cancer new moon is a time to set intentions to control your actions, reactions, and momentum. Concentrate on how you picture yourself rather than how others see you; draw upon your own wellspring of internal support.

The Cancer new moon illuminates your 2nd house of disposable income and foundation. There’s been a lot of activity in your sign over the last few weeks, and you are emerging with a new sense of who you are and what direction you want to take. Any behind-the-scenes work you’ve been doing will soon be noticed. This month and new moon are about reconnecting to your resources, finances, security, and your sense of self-worth. Taking time to realign your values is critical to your emotional well-being. Figure out what you value most, and find a way to allow yourself to receive both emotional connection and love, and physical support and abundance. Honoring your values, reworking your finances, and exploring your senses and sensuality is most important to you now. Your intention for this New Moon is “To explore value of healthy pleasure and sensation, and trust in the wisdom of my body” Money is more than just a physical exchange for your efforts - it's a representation of your worth, too. If you want to be successful, whether it means achieving your goals or creating a healthy, fulfilling life, you have to believe that you are worth it. It's time to start internalizing that you are worthy of financial and emotional stability and that success is achievable. And if you're having trouble believing in yourself, don't be afraid to ask for a mentor who can help guide you. The second house corresponds to The Hierophant in Major Arcana. The Hierophant teaches that there is more than just the material world; there is a divine ruler. As the High Priestess taught the Fool to discover spiritual wisdom from within, the Hierophant teaches the Fool to find spiritual wisdom from external sources: Spiritual leaders, mentors, ancestors, and community. The Hierophant's links to religion, knowledge, and traditions passed down through oral teachings parallel the "fixed" teachings that comprise our social and religious framework. The Hierophant teaches you to return to tradition; you may have expanded your horizons past your comfort zone, and now it's time to return to the familiar to re-frame your focus. Venus is the planetary ruler of the 2nd house, which corresponds to The Empress in the Major Arcana. During this new moon, you would benefit from the guidance of a financial planner, estate lawyer, or therapist. It's also possible your mother could play a significant role (alive or in memory) during this Cancer new moon.

The Gemini new moon illuminates your 3rd house of communication. There's possibly a big reveal happening in your life at this time, and communication, perspective shifts, and new information stream into and swirl around you now. This information is to bring peace and clarity into your home, especially if it means making big changes in who's allowed in it. The third house is ruled by Gemini (The Lovers), with Mercury (The Magician) as its planetary ruler. The Lovers and The Magician alludes to the magick of connections. The new moon in the 3rd house invites you to seek support in your local community. Connect with friends, family, and neighbors to provide support and receive help in return.
