Whether it's to take on a new challenge, spark a creative idea, or just find someone to talk to who understands. If you're fortunate enough to have your needs fulfilled and still have something more to give, consider showing some kindness to those around you. With the new moon in the 3rd house, make the choice to find those who can help keep your energetic momentum growing - creating a harmonious flow of energy. Your intention for this New Moon is “to allow the flow of information to help remold and communicate your values and emotional expression.”

The Cancer new moon highlights your 4th house and brings awareness of home, family, and security. You could be seeing some changes to your home and family situation right now, or assessing what provides you with a sense of comfort and security. Emotional security as well as physical security. You may be feeling more reclusive during this New Moon, but it’s helping you get clear on your own internal emotional process. Take this time to consider how family fits into your future and what steps you can take toward cultivating deeper and healthier family connections. You can't rewrite your family history, but you can become a source of strength and love for your loved ones. This Cancer New Moon is a reminder of the importance of understanding the dynamics of your family - so that you can learn from them, unburden them and be a support system for each other. Let's recognize what's arising, find healing within and show up for your loved ones during this time. The 4th house is ruled by Cancer and corresponds to The Chariot in the Major Arcana. The Chariot symbolizes being active, in control, and taking direction of one's life, as well as needing to take control of one's emotions. The Chariot is a powerful reminder that you control your actions, reactions, and momentum. And, for many, your Chariot is an extension of your home; where you transport your Self and things from one life event to another. The Chariot symbolizes the importance of having a safe and secure container to navigate life successfully. Your intention for this New Moon is, “to come back to your inner home and internal sense of safety and security. Here is where your power lies.”

“What drains your spirit drains your body. What fuels your spirit fuels your body.” - Carolyn Myss Intimacy, romance, children, and creativity are themes for this Cancer new moon in your 5th house. Love, relationships, children, creativity, and self-expression are at the forefront of this New Moon for you. How you identify with them will reshape you. Are you abandoning a part of yourself in order to receive love and validation? Intense feelings about your own worth and value may cause temporary emotional conflict. Returning to an old hobby or joyful pastime can help lift your mood. It’s important for you to stay connected to what you love. Having fun and enjoying yourself is your top priority. Let yourself play and remember what it’s like to be a child with curiosity. The 5th house is ruled by Leo and corresponds to Strength in the Major Arcana. The Strength card reminds you of a sacred power, grounded in inner strength and trust, that comes from emotional mastery. The Strength card of the Golden Eclipse tarot illustrates the Fool sitting poised, channeling the energy of the Universe. The lion is a metaphor for the primal energies of the emotional body, the flames referencing its burning passions. Strength symbolizes being in tune with your inner creative flow when time seems to stand still. It symbolizes the power of channeling Source. When you focus on creating from a place of pure presence, you can tap into a field of awareness that unlocks all the infinite possibilities of creation. Your work will come alive and flow through you—not just by you. Your intention for this New Moon is “Use your natural charm, faith, and courage to express to those you love, you feel. Discover your inner child and nurture them in all the ways they wish. This allows true self-love and love of others to unfold naturally.”

The Cancer new moon illuminates your 6th house of health and being of service. If you’ve been giving too much, now’s the time to focus on yourself. Pushing yourself ahead when it’s not your time to move will only slow you down in the long run. Anything arising right now is to help you break through disharmony and find your way back to health and a more balanced lifestyle. This includes your work environment and learning to balance work and self-care. The Cancer new moon, in your 6th house, reminds you that you always have the power to make new choices in your daily activities. Do you want to become a morning person? You can do it. You can also shift your daily commute to the office to incorporate a hybrid or fully work-from-home instead. The power is in your choice to choose. The Cancer moon reminds you that you can still find joy in your work, routines, and day-to-day life. If you feel unmotivated or disconnected from life, this full moon encourages you to incorporate daily habits to balance your body and mind. Reconnect with what inspires you and create daily practices that bring the spark and magick back into your life. The 6th house is ruled by Virgo and corresponds to The Hermit in the Major Arcana. The Hermit teaches you that the key to mastering the Self is to observe, be still, and practice silence. The full moon in your 6th house is a reminder that small, daily commitments and short-term goals are essential for overall health and wellness. You can learn a lot from observing your daily ritual, routines, and habits. The Magician, ruler of your 6th house, represents the power of manifestation through intention and action. Your 6th house, guided by Virgo and The Hermit, reminds you to focus on yourself, be mindful of your daily rituals, and use your willpower to create positive change in your life.

The Cancer new moon illuminates your 7th house of relationships. Relationships in work and love are at the forefront for you now. Any issues and imbalances that haven’t been dealt with, will finally arise for resolution, or at least discussion. Truth is a priority in all relationships and now’s a good time to get all things out on the table. Some information might cause a little jolt or pain, but see it as a necessary step toward intimacy, or towards separation. The Cancer new moon in the seventh house is an excellent time to re-examine your relationship's current situation. Libra rules the 7th house and corresponds to Justice in the Major Arcana. Justice wants you to find clarity, emotional balance, and fairness in relationships. Sometimes it's easier to be more compassionate to those in your intimate relationship than yourself. You can lend a sounding ear to your partner but then judge and criticize yourself for feeling emotional. Feeling bad is complicated enough on its own. Trying to repress or suppress those feelings only makes things worse. Instead, try accepting your emotions. Give yourself the same emotional support you would give another. Don't try to change or suppress your emotions - just allow them to be and allow yourself to feel them. Free up space to let your feelings pass through you without holding on to them or judging yourself for their intensity. If you're feeling stuck, ask yourself where you might be avoiding or denying the truth in your emotions. Then, take some time to look inside and get to the root of these issues. You can do this with the support of your friends and family and with a bit of self-compassion.

The Cancer new moon illuminates your 8th house of transformation, symbolism, and other people's money. You’re exploring topics of loss, control, surrender, and delving into your inner resources to help you get through a time of uncertainty. What you thought gave you security, may not be so anymore as you learn to access your deeper inner resources to pull you through challenges. The Cancer new moon is in your 8th house of transformation. It’s a time of transformation and trust in the unfolding of life. Areas of Intimacy and shared resources are your focus as you learn to trust in yourself most of all. Power dynamics may force you to look inside yourself and access that well of inner power and strength you may not have known you have. Step to that edge of discomfort, and let go of that small version of yourself. Build trust in yourself and trust outside yourself will naturally follow. The 8th house is ruled by Scorpio and corresponds to the Death card in the Major Arcana. The 8th house also contains themes of occult studies, symbolism, and searching for the meaning behind signs and symbols. However, sometimes, searching for meaning in everything is a coping mechanism against the fear of uncertainty. It's human nature to dislike uncertainty. It's tempting to want everything to have an order and a purpose, but that's impossible. Life can be unpredictable, And uncertainty is an inevitable part of life. How you cope makes all the difference. Accepting smaller moments of uncertainty, you can learn to build your courage and inner strength to help you face it confidently when uncertainty arrives in big ways—as it will eventually.

Sudden changes in status, responsibility or direction will further your growth, even if it’s unclear how at the moment. Take a step back from this current timeline and focus on the long-range details. Make sure that whatever you put your energy into, it aligns with your values and is building toward your future. Career is your main focus now. You’re discovering more and more about yourself on a daily basis and wondering if all the different parts of yourself are being honored and acknowledged in your work. You’re pushing through some old limitations around personal accomplishments. If you feel like you’re taking a step back, it may be needed in order to help you reflect on what’s most important to you, and what you need most to help the long-term goal of success. Use this time to figure out which direction you want to be heading in with your career and move forward. The 10th house is ruled by Capricorn and corresponds to the Devil in the Major Arcana. The Devil speaks to your false belief that you are trapped or stuck in your current circumstances. As your career evolves, it can be easy to get caught up in uncertainty. Sometimes it's easy to get stuck in your head - overthinking and questioning yourself. But don't let the noise of your thoughts keep you from advancing. Cancer corresponds to The Chariot, which symbolizes being active, in control, and taking direction of one's life, as well as needing to take control of one's emotions. During this new moon listen to your intuition and ask questions about the new career opportunities that come your way. Do they offer security, support, and an environment that will promote your well-being? Surveying the landscape of possibilities can help put you in the driving seat when it comes to making a wise career move. After all, only you know what will make you happy and fulfilled in the long run - so go with what works for you. The Cancer new moon is also a time to set intentions surrounding work-life balance. By taking the time to set intentions to support and nourish your emotional needs, you can then better support your work or public life accordingly. The Cancer new moon is a time to set intentions to align your career, with your core values and interests. Your intention for this New Moon is, “to know what work in the world nourishes you and allow it to evolve you into maturity.”

Friends, community, and networking with others is changing and opening for you. See where your gifts can be offered and offer them. Network, connect, and create community. Community and networking is a big focus for you now. Friendships may be changing, and you might find yourself working with groups that are new and different for you. This is good to help you explore new sides of yourself and get exposed to new ideas and visions. Stay focused on what’s working in your projects and relationships, and gently tend to what’s not working. Integrating your ability to think practically is needed now. This is a time to set intentions to call-in people and moments that bring you contentment and fulfillment. The 11th house is ruled by Aquarius (The Star) with planetary rulers Saturn (The World) and Uranus (The Fool). The Star symbolizes one's wish granted, as it rules over the Law of Attraction. Whatever you put your intention towards, you can bring into your reality. If you are looking to be discovered and seen for your art and talents - now is the time to take action and set those intentions. This starts with being intentional with your thoughts, feelings, and who you surround yourself with. If you are an artist: writer, musician, artist, actor, etc., this is a time to set the intention to have yourself, and your work seen. If you have an established network, use it. If you are starting to build your network and community - put energy into being seen, and discovered for your art and talents.

Dreams, creativity, illusions, and loss are surrounding you now. Clarity may come in time, for now, focus on your creative expression. This new moon is in your 12th house, the Pisces house. If you feel like you’re underwater, know that this will pass soon, and use this time to connect to your spiritual and artistic side. Let yourself dream, meditate, and be inspired by all that’s coming through. You may be receiving downloads of information from past lifetimes or ancestral lineage, a trauma that needs to be healed and cleared. Use your creative outlet and faith in something higher than yourself to be the path towards healing. The 12th house is ruled by Pisces and corresponds to The Moon in the Major Arcana. The Moon reminds you of the Law of Rhythm that governs natural development and the shifting of energies. The 12th house is ruled by Pisces, with the ancient ruler of Jupiter corresponding to the Wheel of Fortune in the major arcana. This cosmic wheel symbolizes the ever-changing cycles of life and the endings that come with them. You can tap into its fortune if you remain in alignment with Universal energy but resist it, and you can experience turbulent waters. Life is all about flow, so remember to center yourself within this infinite energy and trust that it will guide you. Allow yourself to exist within the collective consciousness and experience the healing and regeneration that comes with osmosis. Your New Moon intention is, “to allow the cycle of endings and beginnings to unfold without grasping at the expectation of the dream. Your faith, trust, and creative expression will nurture you.”

The Capricorn full moon is illuminating your 1st house of self. This is a time of celebration, an ideal time to celebrate all that you are. It's time to focus on new beginnings and releasing old unhealthy patterns. Focus on how you see yourself rather than how others see you. With this Capricorn full moon's opposition to the Sun in Cancer, you are seeking emotional security and exploring how the structure or lack of structure you've created supports or undermines your emotional well-being. Can you give yourself more structure and emotional support? Similar to this lunation, you have been growing these past six months, from the new moon in Capricorn to this full moon in your sign. What has shifted in the past six months that asks you to step into more responsibility? How are you being guided to accept more responsibility and mature yourself?

The Capricorn full moon shines its light on your 2nd House of Finances and Foundation, bringing attention to your hard work, responsibility, and determination in the areas of self-worth, foundation, and financial security. Take stock of the financial lessons you've learned in the past six months, since the new moon in Capricorn, and re-examine your views on money, finances, and debt. As the full moon opposes the Sun in Cancer, you may be exploring the connection between emotional security and the structure or lack of structure in your financial foundation. Consider how the structure you have created supports or undermines your emotional well-being. Take this time to see what steps you need to take to create a more supportive foundation for yourself, including self-worth, financial stability, and skill set that will support your career. The Capricorn full moon guides you to let go of any negative thoughts or limiting beliefs that may be holding you back from achieving financial stability and self-worth. The more you commit to yourself and take action in the next six months, the more you will see your income, investments, and self-worth grow. The 2nd House of Finances and Foundation is ruled by Taurus and corresponds to The Hierophant in the Major Arcana of Tarot. The Hierophant represents structure, consistency, and guidance - all essential elements in achieving financial stability and success. The Hierophant can be considered a mentor or guide, someone with the experience and knowledge to help you navigate the path to success. If you're seeking help setting proper financial goals, it may be beneficial to seek a mentor or financial advisor who can provide direction and assistance. This mentor can help you stay focused by setting clear goals and providing guidance, support, and motivation when things are not going your way. Having someone to rely on can save time and effort, as they can prevent costly mistakes and show you the right way. Remember, the more you commit to yourself and take action in the next six months, the more you will see growth in your income, investments, and self-worth.

The Capricorn full moon illuminates your 4th House of Home and Family. The full moon in the fourth house signals a time when your home, family, and security are brought into your awareness. Emotions surrounding family, healing between family members, it's also possible this is a time when your family could need more for you. With this Capricorn full moon's opposition to the Sun in Cancer, you are seeking emotional security and exploring how the structure or lack of structure you've created supports or undermines your emotional well-being. As well as how your emotional well-being either strengthens or weakens your foundation. The Capricorn full moon may also illuminate the karma of past actions, which could also be forcing you to mature and take on the responsibility that you may have been avoiding. The 4th house is a Karmic house, bringing family situations to the surface for deeper understanding, learning, and then healing. It's also possible you recently moved, need to move closer to family, or are settling into a new home. Over these next six months, cultivate actions that facilitate emotional support within your home and family environments; and see your foundation strengthen. Your full moon intention, "Find home and comfort inside yourself despite any chaos that surrounds you."

The Capricorn full moon illuminates your 5th house of fun and creativity. Art gives you an outlet to self-express, inspire, and be inspired. Art is a path to Self Discovery. It can evoke calming effects and produce neural changes in your brain. Through art, you can explore your inner self, resolve inner conflicts or express internal joys. Art can also help you cope with difficult situations. When you express yourself through a creative outlet (drawing, painting, dancing, music, singing, or writing), you can help yourself process the thoughts and emotions you are experiencing. The full moon in the fifth house is a time for self-expression and if you’re feeling restricted, use art as a creative outlet for any stuck thoughts and emotions. This Capricorn full moon illuminates the importance of commitment to yourself and your creative gifts and using them as a tool to heal and understand any restrictions and setbacks you experienced in the last six months.

The Capricorn full moon illuminates your 6th House of Health and Being of Service. This is an excellent time to release any daily habits or activities that harm your overall well-being. Perhaps create a list and see where you can introduce new structures to help you organize and automate your day-to-day to streamline and optimize your time. This full moon highlights the need to create a new self-care regimen to bring stability and routine. Take a moment and see what tasks, obligations, and activities bring you the most resistance and distraction, and take steps to improve the process; drop the avoidance and worry, and reclaim the mental real estate in your head. It's easy to get caught up in the challenges of everyday life and forget that they're usually just temporary. It's important to stay patient and consistent and to remember that there is always a bigger picture. The challenges you face now will fade, but the lessons you learn will remain. The full moon in the 6th house teaches you that commitment to small actions, daily practices, and short-term goals link to your greater vision. Take note of what you have achieved. Honor the work, effort, and labor you have put into your work and self. Your full moon intention, "Slow down and focus on the details of health, work, and daily habits."

The Capricorn full moon illuminates your 7th House of Relationships. The Capricorn full moon takes on an emotional tone that is a little more somber, reserved, and serious. Abandonment issues might arise, and you may feel alone and only have yourself to lean on for support; this is what Capricorn energy does. It pushes you to review your life, mature and set boundaries. If you want your relationship to thrive, you need to set some ground rules. That means having open and honest communication about what you both want and need. It also means having respect for each other to stick to those agreements. When everyone is on the same page, it makes it easier to navigate through life's ups and downs. So sit down with your partner and figure out what you need to feel safe, respected, and loved. It's the foundation on which all great relationships are built. Without this agreement, your connection will be sabotaged before it even has a chance to begin. The full moon in the seventh house can signal a time to celebrate relationships that are in balance, entering deeper into a level of commitment (marriage, engagement, moving in together, starting a business), and the relationships where there is a lack of balance result in endings. This full moon helps you recognize the gift of committing to others; and asks that you honor the commitment you made with others as well as the commitment you make to yourself. Any relationships and commitments that have hit limitations or need to be released can be at this time.

The Capricorn full moon illuminates your 8th house of transformation, symbolism, and other people's money. The full moon in the eight house illuminates what others have given to support you (or didn't give support) and signals a time when you can give back to those who have helped you along your journey or let go of the baggage that was given that you no longer need to carry. We all carry with us the weight of our ancestors' generational conditioning. But it's time to learn to forgive yourself for everything you didn't know how to do or didn't know you had the power to do until now. Then take the time to reflect on any debt or shared resources holding you back, and take steps to free yourself from these obligations. You deserve to live a life unencumbered by the past. If you feel like your life is in flux, don't worry - it's all part of the process. Things are being rearranged so that you can build on a more solid foundation. You may also be getting a maturity upgrade, which could manifest as taking on more responsibility in health, home, work, or more authority in your life. Don't fear what you might mature into. You are much more responsible than you realize. The full moon in the 8th house signals a time of transformation. Some are big and noticeable, while others are small and more personal. But all of these transformations require you to let go of your old self and embrace the destiny meant for you.

The Capricorn full moon illuminates your 9th house of the higher self. This past year has been very challenging for you and has you questioning spirituality, philosophy, fairness (or lack of justice of life), and if there is Divine logic. Jupiter, the planetary ruler of the 9th house, is known for its expansive capacities, shifting your thoughts to personal growth, faith, and the philosophy of life. The Capricorn full moon in the 9th house pushes you to seek religion and philosophy as a framework for creating a life of well-being. If you're feeling lost or questioning your faith during this full moon, consider picking up a philosophy book. It can help you to reflect deeply on your current situation and find meaning in even the most difficult experiences. Henri Bergson's theory of creativity is especially relevant, as it reminds you that you are the creator of your own life. Additionally, Epicurus reminds you that happiness comes from within, a peaceful body and soul. So you shouldn't seek it from external sources. And finally, Stoicism teaches you to accept what you cannot change and not be defeated by outside forces. This full moon is a reminder that faith is not static. Like all relationships, it's a process. The journey of faith is a complex line. It ebbs and flows. There are times of growth and progress, as well as times of restriction and discouragement. But even in tough times, it's essential to trust the process. The full moon reminds you to stay committed to your path and overcome setbacks by prioritizing your spiritual and emotional wellness. Losing faith is part of questioning, understanding, and building trust in something greater. This full moon asks that you trust your process, remain committed to your path, and overcome setbacks until you regain momentum. Take this time to meditate, deepen your relationship with your Higher Self and prioritize your spiritual and emotional wellness. This full moon signals a time of honor, and to honor and appreciate all the spiritual work you have done for yourself and the humbling in knowing lessons and learnings are part of your journey.

The Capricorn full moon illuminates your 10th house of career, recognition, and purpose. This full moon asks that you step into your greater purpose and take on more responsibility, whether in your current work or forging a path on your own. You know who you are and what you're worth, Aries. This self-actualization will ultimately lead to an ascension in your career and public status. full moons are often a time of celebration, and hopefully, you're being recognized for the hard work you've put into your career in the last six months during this lunation. Sometimes it can be challenging to keep your priorities straight amid work pressures and career building. Between juggling responsibilities at home and work, it's easy to feel like you're spread too thin and aren't giving your full attention to anything. But, if you don't slow down to check in with your emotions, you'll be ignoring your needs, missing out on opportunities, and falling into unfulfilling patterns that lead you further away from emotional fulfillment. When you don't give yourself a chance to thrive, you're robbing yourself of the opportunity to reach your full potential. This is a time to release any resistance to responsibility, feelings of imposture syndrome, self-sabotaging (what's the worst that can happen?), and impulsive tendencies that hold you back from maturing into your "adult" life and greater purpose. Listen to yourself, and give yourself the time you need to feel whole and emotionally centered. Explore what a mature and successful work-life balance feels like for you and if you feel you still need to create it, take actionable steps toward it. The 10th house is ruled by Capricorn and corresponds to the Devil in the Major Arcana. The Devil/Capricorn speaks to your false belief that you are trapped or stuck in your current circumstances. The Devil usually symbolizes struggles with a moral problem — a choice between lust or love; but mostly, it means you're overwhelmed with an international struggle. You may haven't defined your values or beliefs and have taken on the views of others that are misleading you of your fulfillment. This is a time to release any aspects of your career that do not align with your core values and interests.

The Capricorn full moon illuminates your 11th house of friendship. Good friends are good for your health, and this full moon illuminates the importance of those you surround yourself with. The close friends and networks in your life can help you cope with traumas, such as a job loss, serious illness, divorce, or the death of a loved one. The friendships and networks in your life can encourage you to change or avoid unhealthy lifestyle habits, such as excessive spending, drinking, or lack of exercise. Just as good friends are good for your health, toxic relationships harm your overall well-being and drain you emotionally and mentally. Long-term unhealthy relationships weaken your immune system, and living in a constantly hostile environment pumps your body's cortisol levels, leading to adrenal fatigue. This full moon encourages you to make responsible decisions and review who you allow having access to your energy. You seek community and friendship, and you're ready to release any false friends and networks that are restricting and do not support your growth. This full moon asks that you mature and show that you can be trusted and build trust in others. Trust is built on respect, being responsible, dependable, and forming strong bonds. Keep personal information shared with you in good faith by others private. Keep to your commitments and arrive on time; seek the same level of response from others. Stay focused on what's working in your projects and relationships, and gently release anything that is not working. This full moon gifts you awareness of the social structure you have cultivated for yourself and time to celebrate those you choose to surround yourself with.

The Capricorn full moon illuminates your 12th house of karma, Subconscious, and Endings. This full moon shines a light on all the inner work you have been doing these past few years. The Capricorn full moon takes on an emotional tone that is a little more somber, reserved, and serious. This may be a more emotional time than usual; dreams, creativity, illusions, and loss are surrounding you now. You may receive downloads of information from past lifetimes/ancestral lineage and the trauma that needs to be healed, cleared, and released. This full moon signals a time for stillness within yourself and observation. Reflect on any deep purging you've done, and reflect on what you want to call in to fill the space. Release your need to be in control, and allow yourself to flow with the current of whatever is unfolding. No time is wasted - even if you've been reflecting on the past few years and how, perhaps, you feel like you haven't accomplished what you set out to do. When you are in flow with the Universe, you are being guided towards a life built on truth and your greater and true happiness. The 12th house is ruled by Pisces, whose planetary rules are Neptune/Modern (The Hanged Man) and Jupiter/Ancient (The Wheel of Fortune). The Hanged Man symbolizes a time to reflect and face what you may be avoiding. The full moon in the 12th house can signal a time for self-reflection, a time to find yourself after you've gotten lost in the busyness of life, or numbing yourself by keeping busy. During this full moon, allow yourself to tune out the world and tune in to your body. If you've been feeling lost or like you're just going through the motions, this is the perfect time to find yourself again.

The Leo new moon is illuminating your 1st house of Self. Happy Birthday, Leo! This New Moon in your home sign creates some dynamic tension on how you communicate a new vision of yourself. Big changes are in store for you now in relationships and how you express yourself. The first house symbolizes new beginnings. Beginnings are full of surprises, ups, downs, and turnarounds, but this beginning is yours to design. This new moon is a time to clarify what you want to call in, what talents you want to develop, and which direction you want to take. This is a time to set intentions for a full makeover of your identity and how you want to meet the world. Leo corresponds to Strength in the Major Arcana. The Strength card reminds you of a sacred power grounded in inner strength and trust from emotional mastery. If you have experienced setbacks this past year, this is the time to strategize how to face and solve any challenges.

The Leo new moon activates your 2nd House of Disposable Income and Foundation. Leo corresponds to Strength in the Major Arcana. The Strength card reminds you of your sacred power, being grounded in inner strength and trust that comes from emotional mastery. The lion is a metaphor for the primal energies of the emotional body, the flames referencing its burning passions. When these animalistic drives are not centered, they can fuel emotions like anger, jealousy, greed, and fear; hence, personal development entails a degree of self-mastery. The Leo new moon in the 2nd house is a time to master your emotions and make decisions from a place of abundance, not fear. There’s been a lot of activity in your sign over the last few weeks, and you are emerging with a new sense of who you are and what direction you want to take. Any behind-the-scenes work you’ve been doing will soon be noticed. How much you value yourself is apparent in what you’re manifesting externally. Keep showing up for yourself and believing in your talents; your beauty, your compassion, and creativity will be seen. You’re exploring how to create a solid foundation under your feet. Discover what foundation and comfort mean for you at this time. Figure out what you value most, and find a way to allow yourself to receive both emotional connection and love and physical support and abundance. Honoring your values, reworking your finances, and exploring your senses and sensuality is most important to you now. The second house is ruled by Taurus and corresponds to The Hierophant in the Major Arcana. The Hierophant is often seen as embodying structure and consistency— two powerful ingredients in achieving success and financial stability. Think of the Hierophant as your guide or mentor — someone with the experience and knowledge to get you on the path to success. Your mentor can help you stay focused by helping you set clear goals and providing guidance, support, and motivation when things aren’t going your way. Having a mentor or financial advisor to lean on can save time and effort because instead of making costly mistakes along the way, you’ll have someone there to show you the right way. So if you’re looking for help in setting up proper financial goals, perhaps it's time to seek out a Hierophant-type figure who can provide much-needed direction and assistance.

Your mind is on fire, and ideas are being downloaded at light speed. The 3rd house is ruled by Gemini, a sign of ideas, where concepts fly out of your mind and into the air like butterflies. The new moon in the 3rd house allows you to connect with the world in new ways and discover new ideas. Share these ideas with others because networking now is where you’ll find the most success. You may be ready to start teaching or even return to school. Much of what you create, experience, and project when the Sun is in Leo comes from where you physically are, what you are physically doing, and who you surround yourself with in the present moment. The third house is ruled by Gemini (The Lovers) and Mercury (The Magician) as its planetary ruler. The Lovers and The Magician allude to the magick and power of connections. The new moon in the 3rd house invites you to seek and give support in your local community. Connect with friends, family, and neighbors to provide support and receive help in return. Whether it's to take on a new project, open a local business, spark a creative idea, or just find someone to talk to who offers you a sense of belonging. If you're fortunate enough to have your needs met and still have the capacity to give back, then why not share it with your local community? You may find yourself organizing or taking part in or organizing a community art fair, play, or an event for children to bring the community together. The Magician (Mercury) alludes to a time of creation and flow. He calls forth the reality that you can make what you want to happen by mastering your willpower, asking you to gather your tools and resources (community) for support towards manifesting. With the new moon in the 3rd house, make the choice to find those who can help keep your energetic momentum growing - creating a harmonious flow of energy. Your intention for this New Moon is “To allow the flow of information to help remold and communicate your values and emotional expression. Use your words and information wisely and with good intent, and for the greater good of all involved.”

You may be feeling more reclusive during this New Moon, but it’s helping you get clear on your own internal emotional process. You may also be thinking about moving and exploring the various contradictions and conflicts within yourself around what you need to feel happy and stable. This may be a time when your emotional needs are being renegotiated. All relationships require give and take. Think about what makes you feel secure and safe without getting stuck in stagnancy. Set intentions to reconnect with your roots - your family, friends, and the places that feel at home. Take this time to cultivate and appreciate the people and places that have left a lasting impression on your life. Appreciate their presence, impact, and the love that remains even after they are gone. The 4th house is ruled by Cancer and corresponds to The Chariot in the Major Arcana. The Chariot symbolizes being active, in control, and taking direction in one's life, as well as needing to take control of one's emotions. The Chariot is a powerful reminder that you control your actions, reactions, and momentum. Take control of your own journey and be proud of the life that you have procured. Remember that despite any hardships or challenges that have come into your life, it doesn't rob you of your radiant positivity. You are strong enough to conquer anything that comes your way - even if it's a notion from your past. It's time to embrace the present moment and surrender any baggage that holds you back from becoming the person you long to be. Your intention for this New Moon is, “Stay connected to what feeds you emotionally and seek that out. This will carry you through the storm. To come back to your inner home and internal sense of safety and security. Here is where your power lies.”

Love, relationships, children, creativity, and self-expression are at the forefront of this New Moon for you. How you identify with them will reshape you. Consider how you are expressing yourself and how it’s being received by those around you. Are you abandoning a part of yourself in order to receive love and validation? Or, maybe you’re unwilling to reflect on a part of yourself that creates conflict and disharmony in your relationships. You’re renegotiating how you show up fully as yourself and the impact it has in your life. Don’t abandon yourself, but also don’t get stuck in pride or ego and follow the path of selfishness. Find a balance. Sometimes, your mind can become cluttered with stress and overwhelming thoughts. It's important to take a step back and give yourself permission to relax. Through relaxation and leisure activities, you can break free from the cycle of endless thinking that keeps you stuck in one place. Connecting deeper with your heart space will bring clarity and help cultivate inspiration. If you have children, during the New Moon let your little ones lead the way. Send them some extra love, and spend time with them to explore. Whether it's hunting for shells on the beach, discovering new trails in nature, or being creative with crafts, let your children's imaginations run wild and show them how much you care by simply spending some quality time together. The 5th house is ruled by Leo and corresponds to Strength in the Major Arcana. The Strength card reminds you of a sacred power, grounded in inner strength and trust that comes from emotional mastery. The Strength card of the Golden Eclipse tarot illustrates the Fool sitting poised, channeling the energy of the Universe. The lion is a metaphor for the primal energies of the emotional body, the flames referencing its burning passions. Strength symbolizes being in tune with your inner creative flow when time seems to stand still. It symbolizes the power of channeling Source. When you focus on creating from a place of innocence and pure presence, you can tap into a field of awareness that unlocks all the infinite possibilities of creation. Your intention for this New Moon is, “To discover your inner child and nurture them in all the ways they wish. This allows true self love and love of others to unfold naturally. Find time for your creative gifts and relationships. Your heart is whispering to you what you’re needing most now. Listen.”

You’re needing to create a new self care regimen that will give you more energy and create more stability and routine in your life. This includes your work environment and learning to balance work, self-care, and adding more pleasure to your daily life. You may feel like you’re not being acknowledged now, but this is passing. That doesn’t mean ignoring it, however. Unexpressed anger will find its way into your body and create health issues. Find a way to express it, and if you have the opening, communicate your boundaries and needs to others in a way where they can receive it. Leo corresponds to Strength in the Major Arcana. The Strength card reminds you of your sacred power, being grounded in inner strength and trust that comes from emotional mastery. The lion is a metaphor for the primal energies of the emotional body, the flames referencing its burning passions. When these animalistic drives are not centered, they can fuel emotions like anger, jealousy, greed, and fear; hence, personal development entails a degree of self-mastery. The 6th house is ruled by Virgo and corresponds to The Hermit in the Major Arcana. The Hermit teaches you to master the Self by practicing silence, meditation, and seclusion. In this stage of the journey, you're being asked to be more attentive to details, looking at how you give too much of yourself and are left feeling drained and under-appreciated. You may often think about how to be a source of Strength for others but forget about the importance of taking care of yourself. If you don’t protect your own energy during moments when you are giving more than you are receiving, it will severely deplete you and make you unable to help those around you. During this new moon, take intentional actions to safeguard your energy and prevent yourself from over-giving and ending up drained. The New moon in the 6th house teaches you that commitment to small actions, daily practices, and short-term goals link to your overall health and wellness. Your New Moon intention is, “To tend to yourself first so that you can better serve others. Your health improves, and opportunities open when you leave self-sacrifice tendencies behind. Make health and creativity your primary focus now. Work issues will work themselves out when you focus on yourself for a bit.”

Relationships in work and love are at the forefront for you now. Any issues and imbalances that haven’t been dealt with, will finally arise for resolution or at least discussion. Be honest about what you need from others and yourself. Honesty is a liberating act. This new moon is giving you the opportunity to make the necessary changes to help you evolve as a person and as a partner. The 7th house is ruled by Libra and corresponds to Justice in the Major Arcana. Justice symbolizes cause and effect, the workings of destiny or karma, the consequences or rewards of past actions, law, trial, justice, truth, balance, achieving balance after tribulations, retribution, the law on your side, favorable outcome of judicial matters, responsible conduct, making well-balanced choices, and integrity. The Justice card indicates that you may be wrestling with handling an unjust situation appropriately, or struggling with hurt pride. You don’t always have to wait for someone else to bring justice. You can take the initiative to create it yourself. When faced with injustice, sometimes the best course of action may be simply to acknowledge mistreatment and move on. Other times, however, you can approach a situation with an open heart, and talking points that honor your personal values and make sure those who wronged you are held accountable. You can achieve justice, correct the scales and find balance without having to wait for others. Leo corresponds to the Strength card. The Strength card reminds you to tap into your inner power, which comes from emotional mastery - the strength to control your passion and temperaments rather than be controlled by them. Remember, you have the capacity to make decisions that come from a place of trust within yourself. Leo provides a perfect example of this strength in their determination, fearlessness, courage, and self-expression. We can all draw from their courage and trust that no matter what comes our way, we are capable of handling it with grace, poise, and dignity. Your New Moon intention is, “To tend to your heart in relationship matters and trust in the cycles of endings and beginnings. A new life is right around the corner for you. Anchor into yourself while sharing all the gifts that partnerships and co-creating have to bring. The tension will make you stronger, regardless of the outcome.”

You’re exploring topics of loss, control, surrender, and delving into your inner resources to help you get through this time of uncertainty. What you thought gave you security, may not be so anymore as you learn to access your deeper inner resources to pull you through challenges. Fear can be a gift. Fear of letting go, fear that nothing will come, fear that space won't be filled? Trust yourself first, and everything else will align. There’s nothing wrong with small steps either, but no step at all will keep you stuck. This season and new moon, you’ll be exploring the most intimate spaces of your own soul. Don’t fear what you might transform into. You are much more expansive and empowered than you realize, and being in connection with another may remind you of this whether it’s birthed out of a deep connection, or a lesson of disempowerment. Power dynamics that haven’t been addressed are now arising, asking for changes in your relationships. Be open to new solutions to old patterns, however uncomfortable or painful the solutions may seem. The 8th house is ruled by Scorpio and corresponds to Death in the tarot. The new moon in the 8th house is an invitation to explore and understand the mysteries of life. It's a call to tap into your inner wisdom and use it to transform your life. This energy can manifest as the death of your old self and the birth of a new one. It's a chance to delve into topics like shamanism, astrology, tarot, or psychology in order to learn, and heal yourself and help others. If you're feeling called to become a healer or a teacher - now is the perfect time to set your intentions and follow this path.

It’s time to take your passion for travel and the spotlight and put it into action. Foreign cultures, places, and higher learning is calling for you and you find some of your deepest desires being nurtured there. Keep your mind open to new perspectives and new worlds begin to open up. Traveling helps give you perspective in situations in your life that may feel clogged and stifled. Use this New Moon to broaden your horizons both internally and externally to help you see life in a new and fresh way. Creativity is ignited and you're ready to share your gifts with others through performance or through teaching. It’s important that you don’t get too caught up in a need for validation and satisfaction. The 9th house is ruled by Sagittarius and corresponds to Temperance in the Major Arcana. Temperance guides you to find the balance between the Mundane & Spiritual Worlds. If you live too anchored in the mundane, invite in more of life's mysteries. If you find yourself deep into Spiritual studies, ground yourself back down to earthly matters. If you can successfully find that perfect balance between your spiritual pursuits and your life on the ground, you can use the wisdom to unlock the mysteries to live an enchanted life. Temperance symbolizes the merging of the spiritual and mundane worlds, discovering your purpose. Temperance invites you to balance ego and humility. Your intention for this New Moon is “to allow your perspective to be opened, and allow new truths and understandings to feed your spirit. Reflect on the rigidity of your creativity, perspective, and ideals - and use them as a means to connect with others - not a means to create distance or conflict.”

Friends, community, and networking with others is changing and opening for you. See where your gifts can be offered and offer them. Network, connect, and create community. Your ideas should be shared and collaborated with others. Surround yourself with friends and people who share your same values and vision for the future community and networking is a big focus for you now. There is something magical that happens when you share the same space with people who understand the intricate stories of your life. It's like finding a little piece of yourself amongst a group of people – they become family. Sometimes, it just takes one person to remind you of who you are and what matters most. It's a reminder that our shared experiences bind us together in ways that defy distance or time. The Leo new moon wants you to hold your friends close in your heart, even when life takes you far away. The New Moon in the 11th house may signal a time when your friendships may be changing, and you might find yourself working with groups that are new and different for you. This is good to help you explore new sides of yourself and get exposed to new ideas and visions. Your New Moon intention is, “To allow your unique gifts to be a source of nurturing support for yourself and for others. Focus on your vision for the future and how you’re friends, community, and creativity can fit together. You can bring harmony to all aspects by staying true to yourself.”

Dreams, creativity, illusions, and loss are surrounding you now. Clarity may come in time, for now, focus on your creative expression. This New Moon is in your 12th house, the Pisces house. If you feel like you’re underwater, know that this will pass soon, and use this time to connect to your spiritual and artistic side. Let yourself dream, meditate, and be inspired by all that’s coming through to you right now. Try not to make any solid decisions because not all is what it seems with the new moon in the 12th house. This energy is more about exploring your internal landscape and expressing it through creative means as a manifestation of the divine. You may be receiving downloads of information from past lifetimes or ancestral lineage, trauma that needs to be healed and cleared. The 12th house is ruled by Pisces and corresponds to the Moon in the major arcana. The Moon symbolizes mysticism, lunar rituals, and being drawn to the magick of the Moon. With the Leo new moon in your 12th house, set intentions to connect with your divine wisdom. The 12th house gives access to the unseen worlds in which healing and regeneration occur, allowing you to be still within the oneness of the cosmos, remembering that you are more than just a physical being. If you're feeling blocked or uninspired, try cleansing your energy and creating an altar to honor your magick. Doing so will recharge your spiritual batteries and provide you with much-needed inspiration. Stay open, be still, and surrender — you never know what wisdom and healing you might receive. Leo is Light. When we look at the sky, it looks blue, it is actually all colors, and reflects back a light wave of blue. Leos’ light absorbs all signs and reflects back Leo. The house in which you have Leo, and your sun sign, are the areas in your life where you are asked to cultivate leadership, to channel energy to that area of your life with an open heart. To focus on, and develop these areas of yourself, and become a great beacon of Light. Your New Moon intention is, “To allow the cycle of endings and beginnings to unfold without grasping at the expectation of the dream. Your faith, trust, and creative expression will nurture you. Relax into the creative wisdom that is bigger than yourself, and let it guide you instead of getting lost in the unknown. You are being re-created.”

The Aquarius full moon is illuminating your 1st house of Self. It's a time to reclaim your power and ability to speak your mind freely, not attaching or being afraid of rebelling against the status quo. This gift you naturally have and continue to grow into each year. You are a freedom fighter, and you not only fight for the ability to live a free life in your truth; you also advocate for those around you to live with the same freedoms. At heart, you are a humanitarian. With this Aquarius full moon's opposition to the Sun in Leo, it is time to align your visionary mind with your heart and spirit; walk your path and speak your mind without letting shame get in the way. This full moon asks that you listen to your intuitive voice, which is distinctive to you. Allow this voice to guide you in creating a unique life to your signature soul frequency. There is a power in living a life that is independent and elevated from external conditioning. Living in your unique truth is your gift to yourself and a gift and example to others. They, too, hold the power to envision a life for themselves that aligns with their signature soul vibration. What has shifted in the past six months, allowing you more space and freedom? Have you let go of external judgment? If you're currently feeling restricted due to the opinions of others, how can you free yourself of this judgment? This Aquarius full moon is an opportunity to be guided for the next six months, to step into your power, and honor what makes you unique and different. Leverage your gifts to elevate you from the masses, stand out, and be recognized for your contributions.

The Aquarius full moon illuminates your 2nd House of Disposable Income and Foundation. Take stock of the financial lessons (positive and negative) you’ve learned these past six months, beginning with the new moon in Aquarius. The Aquarius full moon guides you to rebel against and free yourself from any critical thoughts that sabotage your self-worth and self-esteem. The Aquarius full moon in the second house is a time to reflect on your income and security. A time to re-examine your views on self-worth, feelings of lack, money, finances, debt, and any fears that come up around these themes to be worked through and shifted. You challenge disruption and approve commitment, it’s both a positive trait and your downfall. Sometimes, your ability to defer gratification and commit to long-term goals can have you keeping to a decision that isn’t materializing to its greatest potential. Perhaps you were overpromised? Aquarius energy is futuristic, transcending the now and gaining insight from the future. The 2nd House of Finances and Foundation is ruled by Taurus and corresponds to The Hierophant in the Major Arcana of Tarot. The Hierophant represents structure, consistency, and guidance - all essential elements in achieving financial stability and success. The Hierophant can be considered a mentor or guide, someone with the experience and knowledge to help you navigate the path to success. If you're seeking help setting proper financial goals, it may be beneficial to seek a mentor or financial advisor who can provide direction and assistance. This mentor can help you stay focused by setting clear goals and providing guidance, support, and motivation when things are not going your way. Having someone to rely on can save time and effort, as they can prevent costly mistakes and show you the right way. Take a second look at what you committed to in your investments. Did you commit to a financial decision or stock trade that needs to be reworked or traded due to a market forecast? You may be reassessing how secure you feel financially, and take this time to see what steps you need to take to create more of a supportive foundation and take control of that which is within your own self to make yours. This full moon may also signal a time when you make a sizeable investment in yourself, paying for marriage, a downpayment on a house, or paying for education or further education are some examples. Be mindful if any financial planets, like Venus or Mercury, are retrograde at this time. It is not always possible to avoid making financial plans during a retrograde period. If a decision needs to be acted on at this time, quadruple-check any documents and contracts that need to be signed during a possible unstable cosmic window. The more you commit to yourself in the next six months, the more you’ll see your investments, income, and self-worth grow.

The Aquarius full moon illuminates your 3rd House of communication, early education, and your understanding of how to express yourselves, process information, to communicate with your community, your siblings, and your neighbors. Take time to find the stillness amidst the chaos, and go within to discover and integrate the wealth of information stored within your body, which contains all the answers you need to heal and help heal those close to you. Your words hold power, and what you say receives extra attention during this full moon. In relationships, communication and clarity are key. If you want to build strong connections with those around you, you have to make sure that your words and intentions are understood. That's why it's so important to take the time to listen, learn, and communicate effectively. Whether you're trying to repair a relationship or just create stronger connections with those around you, it's vital, to be honest, open, and clear about what you want and need. Take the time to listen and be heard, and you'll find that understanding can often lead to healing and building a stronger community. This full moon is a reminder to take a step back and reflect on the journey you've been on. Consider what you've learned, the experiences you've had, and the people you've met. It's a time for self-reflection and to reconnect with yourself, your lifestyle, your goals, and what matters most. Let this moment be a reminder that you have the power to create the life, lifestyle, and community you want. What we desire has a power of its own. It's like a lover calling out to be connected with. It sparks something electric in you, opening your eyes and pushing you from one community to another. Create with intention.

The Aquarius full moon illuminates your 4th house of home, family, and karma. The 4th house is a Karmic house, bringing family situations to the surface for a more profound understanding to learn, heal, and release. The full moon in the fourth house signals a time when your home, family, and security are brought into your awareness. Emotions will surface surrounding family and healing between family members; it’s also possible this is when your family could need more of you. It’s also possible you recently moved, need to move closer to family, or are settling into a new home. Aquarius rules innovation and out-of-the-box thinking. You may introduce new technology into your home or the home of your parents and family members to help connect more and simplify day-to-day life activities. Would introducing smart-home devices make your life a little easier? Would your parents benefit from senior care technology or fresh grocery home delivery? Think of ways technology is either helping or hindering your connection at home and with your family; make adjustments accordingly. Over these next six months, cultivate actions that facilitate emotional support within your home and family environments; and see your foundation strengthen. Your full moon intention, "find home and comfort inside yourself despite any chaos that surrounds you."

The Aquarius full moon illuminates your 5th House of Fun and Creativity. Nothing is stagnating about Uranus/Aquarius, and if you have big inspiration, you could gain a lot by taking action, even if it feels unpredictable. The full moon in the fifth house is a time for self-expression and if you’re feeling restricted, use art as a creative outlet for any stuck thoughts and emotions. Art gives you an outlet to self-express, inspire, and be inspired. Art (drawing, painting, dancing, music, singing, or writing) is a path to Self Discovery. Through art, you can explore your inner self, cope with difficult situations, resolve inner conflicts, or express internal joys. Art can evoke calming effects and produce neural changes in your brain; art is a tool to rewire yourself from the inside out. The Aquarius full moon can bring about events and creative outlets for you to have the freedom to self-express. Ask yourself, when did you last feel true joy? Reduce activities that do not stoke your spirit to create space for activities that light you up and fill you with pleasure. With the Aquarius full moon in your 5th house, you may feel a sense of restlessness and a yearning for liberation. This celestial event beckons you to question the status quo and seek new ways to express your unique and authentic self. Your individuality takes center stage as you are encouraged to embrace your differences and celebrate the aspects that make you truly one-of-a-kind. This is a time to let go of any inhibitions and allow your inner child to lead the way toward creative expression and self-discovery. With the Aquarian energy inspiring you to think outside the box, you are gifted with a surge of creative inspiration and a desire to explore new avenues of self-expression. You are encouraged to tap into your passions and let your heart guide you toward new and exciting opportunities for personal growth and fulfillment. Embrace your authentic self, trust in your intuition, and allow your creativity to flow freely.

The Aquarius full moon illuminates your 7th house of relationships. Allowing you to heal, empathize with others and lead with your heart; in hopes of creating a more sustainable and compassionate existence. Aquarius is the water carrier, and the waters he carries are given freely to others without expectation. Embrace the power of an unbound life. Free yourself from expectations, relationships, and status quo that are holding you back. Instead, focus on being true to your unique spirit and accepting the truth of who you are at your core. It's time to live life on your own terms. This full moon is a reminder that life is too short to be living someone else's dream. The universe is calling you to live in frequency with your truth and create a life that is uniquely yours. Take this time to examine your life, let go of what no longer serves you, and set out to live a life in frequency/vibration to your truth. The full moon invites you to break free from the chains of societal conditioning. So if you find yourself drawn to intellectual conversations, it's because that's exactly what this full moon is calling for. It's a time to seek out conversations that take you deeper, that challenge you to think differently, and question your beliefs (and what you were taught to believe). This Aquarius full moon is here to shake things up. It will stretch your relationships past their comfort zones and limitations, bringing new insights and breakthroughs. Unbalanced relationships that are built by expectation will crumble; as new insights will create breakthroughs. This dynamic will push you toward deeper commitment or further away towards liberation. The full moon in the seventh house can signal a time to celebrate relationships that are in balance, entering deeper into a level of commitment (marriage, engagement, moving in together, starting a business), and the relationships where there is a lack of balance result in endings. Any commitments that are restrictive and need to be released at this time.

The Aquarius full moon illuminates your 8th house of transformation, symbolism, and other people's money. The full moon in the eighth house illuminates what others have given to support you (or didn't give support). Life is a journey that doesn't always go according to plan. Life is full of moments of reflection and gratitude. This is the time when you can give back to those who have helped you along your journey or let go of the baggage that was given to you that you no longer need to carry. Along the way, people will lift you up and bring you down. Use this time to appreciate the people, places, and experiences that helped you on your journey. And don't forget the lessons you learned from the people who only made things heavy - and then let those people go. We all carry the weight of our ancestors on our shoulders. But it's important to remember that you are not responsible for any generational conditioning passed down to you. Forgiveness is one of the most powerful gifts you can give yourself and your loved ones. It gives you the freedom to break the chains of any generational conditioning. It's time to forgive and reclaim your power. Being aware of the self-sabotaging behaviors that can hinder your growth and goals is essential. During this full moon, you may find yourself in intensely uncomfortable situations that bring up past traumas, or you may be currently experiencing one. Take a step back, ask for help from friends, professionals, and practice self-care. We all have a past, but it doesn't have to define us. Release any fears surrounding traumas; be able to name them. Allow yourself to accept, diagnose, and forgive yourself for experiencing these experiences. Then grow, heal, and free yourself from any previous labels. You are much stronger than you realize. This full moon helps shed any layers of energetic and emotional debris built over the past six months.

The Aquarius full moon illuminates your 9th House of Higher Self. This is a powerful time to connect to life's mysteries and tap into the magick that lies beneath the surface. The Aquarian full moon asks you to question what you see, opening your eyes to the deeper meaning behind the events unfolding around you. This past year has been very challenging for you and has you questioning spirituality, philosophy, fairness (or lack of fairness of life), and if there is Divine logic. It's natural to ask why bad things happen in the world and if there is a higher power that could prevent them. Faith isn't a one-time choice. It's an ongoing journey that takes time, effort, and dedication. It's full of ups and downs, growth and understanding, and doubt and discouragement. But that's all part of the process of building faith. It's a process of learning and building trust in yourself and in something greater. This full moon signals a time to honor and appreciate all your spiritual work; humility in knowing spiritual lessons and learnings are part of your journey. This full moon asks that you trust your process, remain committed to your path, and overcome setbacks until you regain momentum. Take this time to meditate, deepen your relationship with your Higher Self, and prioritize your spiritual and emotional wellness. The more you learn, the more you realize just how much there is to discover. That is the beauty of life - it's a never-ending journey of exploration, growth, and knowledge. Embrace the unknown, keep learning, and never be afraid to ask questions. That's how knowledge is gained.

The Aquarius full moon illuminates your 10th House of Career and Purpose. Aquarians are future-minded and often connected with information, technology, humanitarian efforts, community, and networking. Aquarius is the rebel that helps break down the oppressive norms that keep us in the status quo. The non-conformists push us to think differently and challenge what we know. The Aquarian full moon wants you to explore leveraging emerging technology to advance your career. Take this opportunity to release any resistance. Release any resistance to new technology, feelings of imposture syndrome, and anti-authority or self-sabotaging tendencies that keep you from excelling in your business or career. It's time to let go of any beliefs or patterns holding you back from greatness. During this full moon, you may see projects/businesses that didn't innovate fail; or a project/business that you've been working on struggle because the world is not ready to welcome its disruption and/or innovation. Sometimes it takes a long time for the world to recognize a revolutionary idea. Inventors and scientists who challenge the status quo are often invalidated and disgraced by their peers, only to see their ideas and discoveries years later, sometimes even after these individuals pass on. This is a time to release any aspects of your business/career that do not align with your core values and interests. full moons are often a time of celebration, and hopefully, you're being recognized for the hard work you've put into your business or career in the last six months during this lunation.

The Aquarius full moon illuminates your 11th house of friendship. This full moon is all about exploring and understanding your community. It's about finding what kind of people, places, and lifestyles make you feel like your most authentic self. Take this time to think about what changes you need to make in your life, not in yourself so that you can feel comfortable in the community that supports you the most. This full moon brings with it a powerful invitation to be more intentional with your relationships. It's time to surround yourself with those with a similar soul view and personal vibration. Let the energy of this powerful lunar phase draw you closer to those who will nurture and support you and understand and accept you for who you are. Make time for meaningful conversations and connections, because great things can happen when like minds come together. This full moon is a reminder to choose your social circle carefully. Surround yourself with people who lift you up, inspire you, and support your freedom. Let go of false friends or networks that restrict you and don't bring out the best in you. Aquarius/Uranus is associated with traumatic experiences, which can cause dissociation and distancing emotions. If you feel more disconnected than usual, the root of this distancing could lie in a traumatic event. Breakthroughs are a signature Uranus/Aquarius trait, so whatever you're experiencing now, find ways to support your nervous system. This full moon gifts you awareness of the social structure you have cultivated for yourself and time to celebrate those you choose to surround yourself with. You deserve to be surrounded by people who genuinely believe in you and want to see you happy and successful.

The Aquarius full moon illuminates your 12th house of karma, subconscious, and endings. Aquarius can tune into different frequencies and receive information beyond what one can physically see and hear. Sometimes this can even be in the form of dreams or insights that eventually end up as innovations, inventions, and technologies. This full moon is a reminder to tune into your inner frequency and take a moment to listen; you carry within you the wisdom of lifetimes. Have you ever had a dream that felt like a download of ancient wisdom? That could be your ancestors talking to you. Attention to your dreams can help unlock this knowledge and clarify your current reality. Giving you the insight you need to make the right choices. So if you find yourself receiving downloads of information from past or future lifetimes, don't be afraid to explore them. This full moon is a reminder to take a moment for stillness and reflection. Spend some time in solitude, observing your thoughts and feelings. Look back on any deep purging you've done and how it has changed you. Then, use that insight to call in what you desire and need and fill the space with your most beautiful intentions. Life can be challenging, but it's important to recognize when your own behavior holds you back. Whether it's self-sabotage, addiction, or simply feeling overwhelmed, finding healthy ways to process your emotions is essential. If you feel as if your feelings are too strong, find healthy ways to process these emotions. If you're having difficulty handling this full moon energy, find people and places that feel supportive. We often find ourselves struggling to stay in control of our lives. But sometimes, the best thing you can do is to let go and follow the path that the Universe has laid out for you. Release your grip, allow yourself to flow with the current, and trust that whatever unfolds is meant to be.

Happy Birthday Virgo! The Virgo new moon is illuminating your 1st house of self. It’s time to focus on new beginnings and releasing old unhealthy patterns. Taking some time for self-care is always a good idea, but under your new moon, your desire to purify and heal your body and life is amplified. Focus on how you see yourself rather than how others see you. Take the time to reflect and really understand yourself, your needs and wants, and your values. Break out of the cycle of guilt-driven productivity and overconsumption - self-care is key to a healthier mental state. Take time for yourself each day to restore and reflect. Spend time in nature or practice yoga, write in a journal or meditate. Whatever works for you, make sure to schedule it into your day so that it becomes a regular habit. Some decision you made about 6 months ago is now up for review and revision. Think about all that has transpired since then. Try not to allow any disappointments or grief to keep you from moving forward. You’re focused on yourself, your health, and what you need to do to make your desires a reality, and in doing so you may be in opposition to some important relationships in your life. Virgo corresponds to The Hermit. The Hermit is willing to explore the shadows and bring what is hidden into the light. The Hermits' lessons bring you to wholeness and authenticity. With the Virgo new moon in the 1st house, this is a time to step firmly into your power, cultivating a healthy self-image and personal responsibility. The 1st house is ruled by Aries and corresponds to The Emperor in the Major Arcana. The Emperor guides you to take control of your own worth and value, painting a picture of yourself that comes from within - beyond any external, socially defined norms. Let this be a reminder that you can be your own source of wisdom, recognition, and strength. The New Moon in Virgo is a time to clarify what you want to call in, what talents you want to develop, and which direction you want to take in life. If you have experienced setbacks this past year, this is the time to strategize on how to face and solve any challenges. With a New Moon in your sign, it’s time to focus on new beginnings and releasing old unhealthy patterns. This is a time of rebirth and redirection. Virgo & Virgo Rising Tarotscope Create your tarotscopes for this new moon. Create sacred space, clear your mind and position the cards and see what guidance comes forth: The Sun (Sun) and Moon (The High Priestess) are in Virgo (The Hermit), illuminating the 1st House (Aries/The Emperor), with ruling planet Mars (The Tower). 3.
