When you leave self-sacrifice tendencies behind and prioritize your own health and well-being, you'll find that opportunities open up and your overall health improves. Remember to focus on your own needs and to create a self-care regimen that helps you feel grounded and energized. This will allow you to better serve others and to move forward with confidence and clarity. The 6th house, ruled by the sign of Virgo, corresponds to The Hermit in the Major Arcana. The Hermit teaches us to master the Self through practices such as silence, meditation, and analyzation. In this stage of your journey, you may be asked to be more attentive to details and to consider how you give too much of yourself, leaving you feeling drained and underappreciated. The new moon in the 6th house can teach you that commitment to small actions, daily practices, and short-term goals is essential for your overall health and wellness. Remember to focus on taking care of yourself and to be mindful of your own needs. This might include establishing a self-care routine or setting small, achievable goals that help you to feel grounded and energized.

The Libra new moon activates your 7th house of relationships. As the New Moon in Libra approaches, you may find that your relationships are reflecting back to you some important lessons about commitment and decision-making. This is a time to consider how your unwillingness to commit or make concrete decisions in the past may have led you down unhealthy roads and into unhealthy relationships. It's important to be honest with yourself and others about what you need from relationships. The 7th house is ruled by Libra, which corresponds to Justice in the Major Arcana. Justice asks you to consider where you might be avoiding or denying the truth in your emotions and to take the time to look within and get to the root of any issues. It can be easy to be more compassionate towards others in your intimate relationships than towards yourself. You may lend a listening ear to your partner but then judge and criticize yourself for feeling emotional. Remember that feeling bad is complicated enough on its own and that trying to repress or suppress your emotions only makes things worse. Instead, try accepting your emotions and giving yourself the same emotional support that you would give to someone else. Allow yourself to feel your emotions without holding on to them or judging yourself for their intensity. If you're feeling stuck, consider reaching out to friends and family for support and practicing self-compassion. Take the time to explore your emotions and to get to the root of any issues. Remember that it's okay to feel a full range of emotions and that it's important to allow yourself to feel and process them in a healthy way. The new moon in the seventh house is a time of new beginnings and a chance to find balance and fairness in your relationships. Honesty can be a liberating act, and this New Moon offers an opportunity to make changes that will help you to evolve as a person and as a partner. Remember that truth is a priority in all relationships, and now is a good time to get everything out in the open. Some information might be a little jolting or painful, but try to see it as a necessary step towards greater intimacy or separation. During this time, you may also find that you're focusing on balancing your personal needs with the needs of others. You might see new relationships open up as others come to a close, and it's important to trust in the natural cycles of endings and beginnings. Your New Moon's intention is to tend to your heart in relationship matters and to trust in the cycles of life. Remember that a new life is always right around the corner, and take care of yourself as you navigate the ups and downs of relationships.

The Libra new moon activates your 8th house of transformation, symbolism, and other people's money. It’s a time of transformation and trust in the unfolding of life. Areas of Intimacy and shared resources are your focus as you learn to trust in yourself. Power dynamics may force you to look inside yourself and access that well of inner power and strength you may not have known you have. Step to that edge of discomfort, and let go of that small version of yourself. Don’t fear what you might transform into. You are much more expansive and empowered than you realize. Being in connection with another may remind you of this, whether it’s birthed out of a deep connection or a lesson of disempowerment. Power dynamics that haven’t been addressed ask for changes in your relationships. Any unhealthy or abusive behaviors within yourself or from others need to be let go of, or you may experience some shocking moments which will force transformation. Be open to new solutions to old patterns, however uncomfortable or painful the solutions may seem. The 8th house is ruled by Scorpio and corresponds to Death in the major arcana. This energy can manifest as a change in life, separation or 'death' from one's old self or old life, a drastic and necessary change in lifestyle, or a time to explore your shadow and fears to allow for release and transformation. In your 8th house, the Libra New Moon is a time to balance your fears with reason. Recognize the source of your fear. Fear can be a gift. Fear of letting go, fear that nothing will come, fear that space won't be filled. Trust yourself first, and everything else will align. There’s nothing wrong with small steps, but no step at all will keep you stuck. Is it based on real, present danger or is it a fear of the unknown or something that may happen in the future? By understanding where the fear is coming from, we can better assess whether it is warranted and take steps to address it. Seek out evidence to support or refute your fear. Is there evidence to support your fear or is it based on assumptions or beliefs that may not be accurate? Gather information and consider multiple viewpoints to help you see the situation more clearly. It's a time to delve deep into the mysteries of life and explore all the hidden corners of your soul. Now is the time to follow that path if you're feeling called to shamanism, astrology, tarot, or psychology. You may even decide to become a healer or a teacher. At any moment, you can find the brighter side of even the darkest topics and add a little lightness to the conversation. Your intention for this New Moon is, “Security is an inner construct that I have some control over. I build trust in myself and trust outside myself naturally follows. Even in the darkness, I find the light and power I hold within. I burn brighter with every step I take towards befriending my fears.”

The Libra new moon activates your 9th House of Higher Self, making it a time to push past your comfort zone and expand your horizons. Foreign cultures, places, and higher learning is calling for you, and you find some of your deepest desires being nurtured there. Traveling helps give you perspective in situations that may feel clogged and stifled. Use this New Moon to broaden your internal and external horizons to help you see life in a new and fresh way. Creativity is ignited, and you're ready to share your gifts with others through performance or through teaching. Any debates or conflicts of interest are an opportunity to find common ground instead of focusing on what’s not working. Stay connected to what feels true for you, and maybe even try on a few different “truths” to see which one resonates most for you. The 9th house is ruled by Sagittarius and corresponds to Temperance in the Major Arcana. Temperance guides you to find the balance between the Mundane & Spiritual Worlds. If you live too anchored in the mundane, invite in more of life's mysteries. If you find yourself deep into Spiritual studies, ground yourself back down to earthly matters. If you can successfully find that perfect balance between your spiritual pursuits and your life on the ground, you can use the wisdom to unlock the mysteries to live an enchanted life. Temperance symbolizes the merging of the spiritual and mundane worlds, discovering our purpose or meaning, mindfulness of overindulging or drinking, moderation, the balance of passion and reason, and cultivating patience. Your intention for this New Moon is, “To allow your perspective to be opened, and allow new truths and understandings to feed your spirit.”

The Libra New Moon is activating your 10th house of career and purpose, shining a light on your professional accomplishments and efforts. This new moon challenges your feeling and thoughts on what and who to put your trust into. This new moon may bring about sudden changes in status, responsibility, or direction that will further your growth, even if it’s unclear how. Take a step back from this current timeline and focus on the long-range details. Make sure that whatever you put your energy into, aligns with your values and is building toward your future. The 10th house is ruled by Capricorn and corresponds to the Devil in the Major Aracana. The energy of The Devil can suggest a feeling of being ensnared or stuck in your current circumstances and may speak to struggles with moral dilemmas or an unhealthy fixation on something. This energy can also bring a tendency towards excessive contemplation and distractibility, so it is crucial to be vigilant and avoid falling prey to unhealthy workplace crushes or obsessions. The Devil can also bring a desire for change and restlessness, so if you find yourself feeling unenthused or dreary with your current work or work surroundings, do not hesitate to take charge and identify areas for improvement. Use the energy of this Aquarius New Moon to devise creative solutions and revitalize your work and workplace to make them more invigorating and fulfilling. Set intentions to challenge outdated ideas and systems and to find ways to bring new energy and inspiration to your professional life.

With the New Moon in Libra in your eleventh house of community and friendships, you may feel a pull towards finding balance and harmony within your social circles. This is a time to reassess the relationships and groups you are a part of and ensure that they are supporting and uplifting you. The eleventh house, ruled by Aquarius and influenced by The Star in the Major Arcana, may also bring a desire to get involved in social or community causes and make a positive impact on the world around you. The Star is a symbol of hope and inspiration, a guiding light that illuminates the path ahead. It represents the strength and free flow of energy necessary to connect with your soul and find your place in the world. As you navigate this New Moon, let The Star remind you of the beauty that surrounds you and the greater vision of the future. With the power of the Law of Attraction at your fingertips, you have the ability to create your own reality. So be intentional with your thoughts, feelings, and the people you surround yourself with. If you are an artist, such as a writer, musician, artist, or actor, this is a time to set the intention to have yourself and your work seen. If you have an established network, use it to your advantage. If you are just starting to build your network and community, put effort into being seen and discovered for your unique gifts and talents. The Star is inviting you to realign with your spark and find a community that supports and nurtures you. As you focus on what is working in your projects and relationships, take care to gently tend to what is not. This may require integrating your ability to think practically and outside the box. Your New Moon intention might be, "to allow my unique gifts to be a source of nurturing support for myself and for others."

The Aries full moon illuminates your 1st house of Self, a time to reclaim yourself, energy, and power. The first step in reclaiming your power is acknowledging where you have given it away. The Aries's full moon signals a time to start taking back control of your life and your decisions. Aries teaches you to step into your authority. This full moon reminds you that your strength, power, and self-worth are within you. It encourages you to assert and express yourself and may bring awareness to your struggle regarding your appearance, self-esteem, and personality. Whether you're facing a personal or a more significant challenge, this moon supports you in overcoming obstacles and stepping into your authority. The full moon in the 1st house can bring challenges of me vs. them. Have you been feeling stuck in a relationship dynamic? It's time to take back your power and create some healthy boundaries. Your needs may clash if you're in a close relationship with someone. This can leave you feeling drained, both mentally and emotionally. First, communicate openly and honestly with the people involved. Second, set boundaries. It's okay to say "no" when you need to. Remember, you have a right to your own time and space. And finally, seek support from someone who isn't involved in the relationship dynamic and can offer a fresh perspective. You have a natural inclination to shake things up and keep them moving. You thrive on action and motion and can't stand being idle for too long. However, be mindful not to stir things up unnecessarily out of boredom or restlessness. It's important to find a balance between taking action and being at peace with stillness. Don't become an agitating force in your own life, and remember to pause and reflect on your actions. The first house is ruled by Aries and corresponds to the Emperor in the Major Arcana. How would it feel to believe in your authority and proceed fearlessly? When you align with your true Self, you will be on the correct path, and your obstacles will be overcome. If you allow yourself to be influenced by others, acting out of alignment with your authentic Self, you may experience friction and roadblocks. Embrace your inner warrior. Aries energy is all about pushing through. Remember that you're a fighter no matter what life throws at you during this full moon.

The Aries's full moon illuminates your 2nd house of disposable income and foundation. Aries asks that you advocate for your time and talent. This Aries full moon brings awareness around your worth. Accepting less than you are worth gives others the green light to do the same and can leave you feeling stuck and struggling. You may experience increased tension around salary, client fees, and advocating for your time and experience as you realize you may have been underselling yourself for a long time or others aren't honoring the value your talents bring. Advocating for yourself is an essential part of your financial career trajectory. Your self-advocacy strategies will differ between your first job and what they will be later in your career, and your system must change accordingly. Your manager may need more training, resources, or desire to invest in your career development. If you want to develop your career path, you must be your own advocate. You can only self-advocate if you know your value and worth; take time during this full moon to do a self-assessment backed with critical projects, peer review, facts, and figures. Have this information ready when advocating for a salary adjustment or promotion. If you are self-employed, know your worth. Articulating the value that you and your company bring is essential in any negotiation. Keep it professional. It can be difficult to self-advocate, but a crucial part of it is not letting your emotions get the better of you. The Aries full moon is a time for release, and if you're feeling taken advantage of, unappreciated, or unable to ask for what you need, this is the perfect time to work through and let go of those feelings. This is a time to assert your needs and to set the intention to be compensated for your efforts. If you've been holding back from asking for what you need, use this full moon to summon the courage to speak up. It's important to stay positive and not get bogged down by criticism of your current situation. Instead, focus on how you spend your energy, time, and your money. Make adjustments, curb your expenses, and focus on what you require in terms of resources and opportunities to help you grow and succeed.

The Aries full moon illuminates your 3rd house of early education, how to process information, and communicate with your community, siblings, and neighbors. Speaking your peace comes naturally to you. However, your outspoken nature can cause heated arguments during this full moon if you find your feelings hurt or caught up in your ego. If you disagree, take a step back and focus on your responsibilities in this dynamic. You'll be able to approach the situation with more clarity and integrity. You are constantly bombarded with messages - from the news, arts, friends, family, strangers, and social media. It can be tough to sift through everything and figure out what's important. But you receive a message that resonates with you every now and then. A sign or message that confirms what you already know deep down. No matter what life throws, you can choose how you react to the information. The messages you receive - whether in blessings or challenges - help define you and shape your life. These are the messages that stick with you and help to guide you on your path. During this full moon, kismet words will be exchanged. The messages you receive and conversations you hold will fill your hours, shape your decisions, and change the structure of your life and the lives around you. So it's essential to be open to whatever comes your way and to use it as an opportunity to grow and learn. What messages have you been receiving lately? The words you choose to communicate with carry weight. They make an impact and leave an impression. If you grew up feeling like your voice didn't matter, it could be hard as an adult to remember that your words have power. If you've been feeling stuck with any writing projects, this full moon signals to make a push to get these projects off the ground. Aries is ruled by Mars, which gives the gift of energy to push through challenges. The more intention you put into these projects, the more significant their impact will be.

The Aries's full moon illuminates your 4th house of home, roots, and family. It is critical to examine the roots of your life to ascertain your connections to family, home, and parents and what keeps you rooted. Aries is a warrior, and this Aries full moon is a time to reflect on the importance of having a safe and supportive home base. Whether that's with your blood family, your chosen family, or simply a place to call your own - roots are important. By looking back, you can gain a better understanding of your current situation. Now is the time to take stock of what you have and what you need to create a sense of security and belonging. The past six months have been a journey for you in terms of your relationships with relatives and where you live. This period has helped you clarify who and what's important and helped you find a more stable base and home within yourself. Take note of the parts of your past that are visiting you in the present. This Aries full moon also puts pressure on your career. Celebrate your successes and cut yourself some slack for the things that haven't worked out. Making progress can be something other than an all-or-nothing proposition. You can be thoughtful and deliberate in your actions toward career growth without sacrificing your home and personal life.

The full moon is a time of illumination and helpful if you feel stuck in the dark. This Aries full moon illuminates your 5th house of fun, heart-centeredness, and children. You're a natural optimist. Being an optimist doesn't mean you're always happy or that everything is perfect. It just means you know that life is an adventure, despite the challenges thrown your way, and things will eventually work out as long as you take the time to tend to what is needed and think things through. It can be easy to get caught up in the hustle and bustle of everyday life and forget to make time for yourself. But it's important to remember that you are worth your time and energy. If you're feeling lost, uninspired or unfulfilled in your romantic or creative life, take a step back and reassess. It might be time for a change. Every single event that occurs in your life is a reflection of your inner state. Set out on a local adventure, rediscover the beauty around you, and see things from a different perspective. It's also possible creative project you worked on earned success or recognition. After all, the sun is in your 11th house of community, putting you into the limelight. The energies of this lunation remind you that there is no such thing as too much positive attention. This is a great opportunity to start feeling more confident in your love life. Any buried emotions surrounding a fear of being "seen" or stepping into your power may surface for examination. Aries is a warrior, and the Aries's full moon reminds you that it's essential to be your own champion. You are your own best advocate and champion. This sometimes means advocating and loving yourself more than you were raised to, seeing yourself, and fighting for yourself in the ways you want others to defend and see you.

The Aries full moon illuminates your 6th house of health and being of service. This is an excellent time to release any daily habits or activities that hurt your overall health, energy, and well-being. This full moon's energy demonstrates that the quick wins in your life don't always last and sometimes are difficult to repeat. The challenges you are facing right now signal the weakness in your life's "system design." Take time to cultivate a system of habits that simplifies and strengthens the areas where more structure is needed (i.e., family, health, work, finances, morning routine, etc.). This full moon in Aries is a time to focus on releasing any built-up annoyances or frustrations in your day-to-day routine, especially at work. With the potential for tempers to flare, it's best to avoid any situations that could cause conflict. If this is a busy time for you, get ahead of the week by organizing your home, meal-prepping, or outsourcing some of your responsibilities to reduce cognitive overload and stress. Take a moment and see what tasks, obligations, and activities bring you the most resistance and distraction, and take steps to improve the process; drop the avoidance and worry, and reclaim the mental real estate in your head. The Aries full moon is the perfect time to get out and active. With this full moon activating your 6th house, this is also a time to introduce activities that can help you channel Aries energy towards better health. Running is a great way to do this, as it increases blood circulation to the brain, improving your mood. Running and walking can also be forms of meditation, connecting your mind and body, clearing your mind, and keeping you present in the moment, which can help reduce anxiety. The 6th house is ruled by Virgo and corresponds to The Hermit in the Major Arcana. The Hermit teaches you to master the Self by practicing silence, meditation, and seclusion. In this stage of the journey, you're being asked to be more attentive to details, looking at how you give too much of yourself and are left feeling drained and under-appreciated. The full moon in the 6th house teaches you that commitment to small actions, daily practices, and short-term goals link to your overall health and wellness.

The Aries full moon illuminates your 7th house of relationships. You sometimes attract what you are. Often times you attract those in desperate need of what you are. The full moon in Aries calls for you to step into your authority, and one of the most effective ways of doing so is by setting healthy boundaries with yourself and others. You may be spending time reflecting on your relationship choices and when the lack of boundaries left you feeling drained, emotionally and financially. You may also be processing a recent loss or contemplating the ending of a significant relationship; if healthy boundaries and a peaceful home cannot be reached. The full moon is a time to reflect on your most important relationships. It's an opportunity to examine the conflicts that arise and ask yourself what they're teaching you. If you're not showing up for your own life, you can't expect to show up for anyone else. That's why learning how to self-analyze and keep a journal is important. Writing down your thoughts and feelings can be a powerful tool for self-discovery. Taking the time to read back through what you've written can help you better understand yourself and your situation. Armed with this knowledge, you can make the necessary changes to help you become more present in your life. Aries is a passionate warrior, and the Aries full moon asks that you examine the fights/battles in your intimate relationships. It can be difficult to feel supported and loved by those around you, especially when they don't know how to show up for you; and when you don't understand each other's love language. Don't hold anger towards others when they can't or don't know how to support you; this only steals your focus and progress. Most people don't even know how to show up and support themselves. If you find yourself in this situation, don't get discouraged. We all have different love languages. If you feel like you're not giving or receiving the support you need in your relationships, ask yourself (or your partner) what that looks like. It may be a matter of learning how to communicate and express what support means to you. Use this as an opportunity to grow closer to those you care about. Not everyone in your life is going to be able to receive what you have to give. And that's okay. Just be conscious of what you expect from others, and be wary of wanting what they can't give and giving what they can't receive. Some people only know how to take, and others know how to receive. Be grateful for those who can welcome you with open hearts. Healthy relationships genuinely are the secret source to a life well lived.

The Aries's full moon illuminates your 8th house of transformation, symbolism, and other people's money. The full moon in the eighth house is a time to reflect and reassess what you've been given and what you can give back. It's a chance to take stock of who has been supporting you and to show your appreciation for those who have helped you along your journey. It's also a reminder that it's okay to let go of the baggage that others gave you if it no longer serves you; or was never yours to carry. Know that you are valuable and worthy of love and connection. You have a keen eye for perfection, but your standards can become a prison. And it's too easy for your inner voice to become a critic and bully. It's time to change the way you talk to yourself. It's time to let go of the pain, the hurt, and the anger. Fill yourself with love and strength, and know you are worthy of healing and deep emotional fulfillment. The full moon in Aries may require facing internal demons or working through financial issues. Don't be surprised if anger arises during this full moon, as your thoughts may turn to old or current legal matters (lawsuits, divorce, custody battles, bankruptcy, etc.) Thinking about where you made mistakes, sabotaged, or didn't advocate for yourself; leaves you feeling that you need to address, correct or play catch-up now. Spending on the healing work and maturity you've done, you'll either come to acceptance and make shifts or continue to face challenges by sinking into anger or playing the victim. Be careful with debt and money during this time, and ensure you're handling your finances well. Be gentle as well as honest with yourself. The 8th house is ruled by Scorpio and corresponds to Death in the Major Arcana. The full moon in the eighth house can represent a 'death' from one's old Self or old life and a drastic and necessary change in lifestyle. Getting caught up in internal thoughts and life's battles is easy. But if you take a moment to create a tiny altar in your space, it can help you remember what's important and where to focus your attention.

The Aries full moon illuminates your 9th house of the higher self, philosophy, and greater wisdom. Ready to hit the road? This Aries full moon in the ninth house is the perfect time to satisfy your wanderlust. It's time to throw caution to the wind and book that spontaneous trip you've been dreaming of. Explore new places, experience different cultures, and shift your perspective. The more you experience, the more you realize how much there is still to learn and explore - and that's beautiful. Jupiter, the planetary ruler of the 9th house, is known for its expansive capacities, shifting your thoughts to personal growth and the philosophy of life. The Aries's full moon in the 9th house pushes you to seek philosophy as a framework for creating a life of well-being. Philosophy is often seen as complex and challenging, but it can be one of the most helpful tools to understand yourself and the world. Philosophy can help you to reflect deeply on your current situation and find meaning in even the most difficult experiences. Henri Bergson's theory of creativity is especially relevant, as it reminds you that you are the creator of your own life. Additionally, the Greek philosopher Epicurus reminds you that happiness comes from within, a peaceful body and soul. So you shouldn't seek it from external sources. And finally, Stoicism teaches you to accept what you cannot change and not be defeated by outside forces. If you're feeling lost or stuck during this full moon, consider picking up a philosophy book. It might change your life view. Philosophy is more than just a school of thought - it's a way of life. It challenges you to question your belief system and grow and evolve as a person. The beliefs you hold can have a great deal of power over you. They can influence your thoughts, emotions, and actions. You may hold onto beliefs without really questioning them. But when you take the time to examine your beliefs more closely, you can gain a new level of clarity. This clarity can help you make more thoughtful choices about what you believe and if any views were passed down that don't resonate with you. The starting point of Greek philosophy is, "Am I being true to myself?" It's a question that challenges you to examine everything around you and question what you believe. By questioning the world around you, you can find your own truth and build an authentic and meaningful life. In a constantly changing world, staying grounded in your values and beliefs is essential. It's a journey of self-discovery and re-discovery that can lead to a more authentic and fulfilling life. During this full moon, take some time to reflect on the beliefs you hold. As you examine your thoughts, pay attention to which ones encourage thoughtfulness and which encourage frenzied states. Choose wisely as you move forward.

The Aries full moon illuminates your 10th house of career and public recognition. Cancer, this full moon is affecting you in a big way. With the moon being your ruling planet, you're extra sensitive to its effects. The full moon is a time of illumination when you can see things more clearly. So use this time to take a good hard look at your career and work-life balance. If you're feeling stuck in your life, it might be time to break up with the worn-out values and ideologies holding you back. Stagnation is the enemy of evolution, so don't be afraid to shake things up and forge your own path. You can convince yourself that you're happy with your job, even though it's monotonous and creatively stifling. You can also tell yourself you're okay with a noncommittal partner. While accepting and being content with your current circumstances is good, complacency is not. To improve your situation, you must admit that you want more and fight for yourself. The first step is acknowledging your fears (fear of success, happiness) is the first step to conquering them. But once you can identify and face your fears head-on, you can start making real progress. It's easy to become complacent in life. You can get comfortable in your routines and stop striving for more. But complacency is a trap. It's not living - it's simply existing. If you're not careful, you'll look back on your life and realize you wasted it, being afraid to take risks and seize opportunities. If you're worried that speaking up for yourself will make you unlikeable, look around you. Many people advocate for themselves and are still likable (if not more so). Chances are, you admire them for their confidence and ability to inspire others. They're not afraid to ask for what they want, nor should you. If you feel like you're not being seen or valued at work, it's time to take a stand. The full moon in Aries reminds you to be brave and fight for what you want. Power struggles can be tough to navigate, and you're a compassionate soul, so confrontations can take a lot out of you. Remember to recenter yourself and connect with your element, water, when things get overwhelming. During this full moon, visualize your desired outcome and how you want to feel. Take deep breaths to calm your nerves, and communicate clearly and directly with your co-workers or colleagues. You should practice role-playing with a close friend to ensure you are being assertive and not coming across as aggressive.

The Aries's full moon illuminates your 11th house of friendship. During this full moon, you will be exploring what community you feel most comfortable in and what you need to change in your life, not your Self, to feel like you can express your most authentic Self. This full moon asks that you surround yourself with people who challenge you to be the best version of yourself. If you surround yourself with people who are negative and bring you down, you need to make a change. Life can be challenging enough; invite people who fight for you, not against you. You may take a break from a significant friendship or network of friends; to give yourself distance from a challenging dynamic. To re-enter the relationship/network later with a different perspective. Take the time to sort through your differences and come to a fair assessment. Even when it's hard, being honest with each other is one of the most critical parts of any relationship. Keep going if you're facing a challenging situation with a friend. The Aries's full moon can signal abrupt endings, and you may be navigating the emotions of being ghosted by someone you care about. No matter what you call it, ghosting, stonewalling, or emotional abuse, it's never okay. It's a cowardly way to avoid conflict, leaving the other person feeling hurt, confused, and alone. If you can't have an honest conversation with someone, that's not the relationship you need to be in. After a ghosting experience, you're left in the dark and uncertain about what happened. Your brain wants certainty. It's natural to want answers in a situation like this, but sometimes you just have to accept that you may never know why things ended the way they did and just move on. You may feel overlooked and hurt and question everything about the situation, including your self-worth. A big lesson of this Aries full moon is that what other people choose to do - or not do isn't about you. It's not personal. It doesn't reflect on your worth as a person. It's just a choice they've made; how people treat others directly reflects how they feel about themselves. That is on them. It's not about you; once you embrace that knowledge, it's a liberating force.

The Aries full moon illuminates your 12th house of karma, subconscious, and endings. Full moons can be a time of celebration; however, now may be a time to withdraw into a sanctuary of self-care and seclusion. Difficult experiences can shape your life in unexpected ways, such as trauma and bereavement, and can impact physical health, emotional state, beliefs, behaviors, and relationship patterns. Healing this trauma and addressing it at its root is essential for letting go, moving forward, and starting anew. This full moon is a time for stillness and reflection. This is a perfect time if you've felt called to do some deep inner work. You may receive downloads of information from past lifetimes or your ancestral lineage, and it's time to clear up any spiritual or emotional debt holding you back. Take some time to reflect on what you want to call to fill the space. This full moon could bring about a personal transition or transformation. Or, you might feel a stronger connection to the collective at this time. On the positive side, this full moon could also give you a heightened sense of intuition and imagination, making it an excellent time to explore creative projects or engage in deep reflection.

Happy Birthday Scorpio! What can you feel ready to heal, release and accept about the past so you can live more fully in the present? Scorpio corresponds to Death in the major arcana. This energy can manifest as a separation or 'death' from one's old self or old life, a drastic and necessary change in lifestyle, or a time to explore your shadow and fears to allow for release and transformation. As you look back on this past year, how comfortable are you with the process and change that has occurred so far? What transformation are you in the midst of right now? These questions aren’t meant to make you doubt yourself, but rather invite you to see yourself without the lens of external validation, and fully embrace and honor the person you are becoming. Surrender to life's imperfections and disappointments and allow them to sculpt your character and nurture your heart. This New Moon in your home sign creates dynamic tension on how you communicate a new vision of yourself. Big changes are in store for you now in relationships and how you express yourself. This is the time to clarify what you want to call in, what talents you want to develop, and which direction you want to take in life. If you have experienced setbacks this past year, this is the time to strategize how to face and solve any challenges. The Taurus full moon illuminates your 12th house of karma, subconscious, and endings. This full moon is an opportunity to reflect on your deep purging and what you want to call in to fill the space.

Leverage this full moon energy to bring more honesty and connection into your life. This Gemini full moon is a reminder that you have the potential to create something unique and meaningful through conversations. It's an opportunity to connect and grow with those around you. To create a space for healing and transformation. As you grapple with complex and challenging topics, may you hold them with grace and compassion - for yourself and those you engage with. So take some time to be present in your conversations, and celebrate the magick of everyday interactions. After all, it's in your interactions with others that create space for healing. With the full moon in Gemini and the sun in Sagittarius, you're sure to see a turning point in several vital areas of your life. The Gemini full moon illuminates your 4th House of Home and Family. The full moon in the fourth house signals a time when your home, family, and security are brought into your awareness. The full moon in Gemini is shining a spotlight on the fourth house. No matter what changes occur, keep your focus on your emotional foundation. The full moon in the 4th house and the Sun in your 10th is about finding balance in your personal and professional life. Your home is so much more than a physical space. It's the center of your emotional world, the sanctuary of your peace of mind, and reflects who you are. That's why it's so important to take care of it and make sure it's organized and clutter-free. So if you want to grow and succeed, it's important to take the time to organize your sanctuary and remove any emotional clutter. Don't let your home, emotional world, and family life get in the way. Create a space of peace and positivity, that will nurture and uplift you.

The Gemini full moon illuminates your 5th house of fun, children, and creativity. This full moon illuminates the importance of believing in your divine creative gifts and visions. The Gemini full moon illuminates your 6th house of health and being of service. This is a good time to release any daily habits or activities that harm your overall well-being. You can't pour from an empty cup. Maybe you've been feeling a little overwhelmed lately, or you've been putting work above self-care. Either way, this lunation is a reminder that you need both. Perhaps try some gentle energy practices like Qi Gong, Yoga, and Tai Chi to help you revitalize and inspire you. Reflect on your daily routines and ask yourself what shifts can be made to cultivate more health-conscious habits. Set yourself up for health and success.

The Gemini full moon illuminates your 7th house of relationships. With the Sun in Sagittarius, the sign of truth and freedom, and the full moon in Gemini, the sign of communication and conversation. The full moon in the seventh house is a time to celebrate relationships that have served you well and to acknowledge when it's time to let go of those that don't. It's an opportunity to take stock of your relationships - the ones that are strong and balanced and the ones that may be out of balance or lack commitment. The Gemini full moon illuminates your 8th house of transformation, symbolism, and other people's money. It's a time when any secrets, gossip, addictions, or underhanded behavior will also come to light. This Gemini full moon is a time of revelation and insight. It's an opportunity to shine the light on the things that were hidden in the shadows of Scorpio season. With new knowledge and revelations, it empowers you to process this information and see how you want to put them into practice moving forward. Shadow work is a powerful technique for harnessing our fear, channeling it into positive energy, and using it to manifest the life we want. Whether you're dealing with anxiety, depression, or anything else, start by doing a little journaling. Writing out your fears can help you process them, so you can get past them. The full moon in the eight house also illuminates what others have given to support you (or didn't give support), and signals a time when you can give back to those who have helped you along your journey or let go of the baggage that was given to you that you no longer need to carry. Any baggage that is not yours to carry only burdens your journey. This baggage can be debt you took on from a divorce, separation, family, ex-roommate, or friend. The baggage can be words or labels placed upon you that you no longer identify with or never were your truth. Take time to reflect on any debt or shared resources that are holding you back, and take steps and address how you can free yourself from these obligations. Honoring your values, reworking your finances, and exploring your senses and sensuality is most important to you now. This full moon invites you to honor your healing. Forgiving yourself for any generational conditioning that was passed down to you. Forgive yourself for what you didn't know before or what you didn't know you held power to do, and celebrate the new knowledge and understanding that has been revealed to you. May this full moon bring you peace and clarity on your path; illuminate the ways in which you've healed and how this healing has transformed you.

The Gemini full moon illuminates your 9th house of the higher self. We often ask why bad things happen in the world and if there is a higher power that could prevent them. But faith isn't static. It ebbs and flows, with times of certainty and times of doubt. This year may have tested your faith, but it doesn't mean you have to lose it. Remember that questioning, understanding, and trusting the unknown is part of building faith - not just in something higher than yourself, but in your own power and strength. Have you ever looked at the night sky and felt a connection to something bigger? That's the power of this full moon. It's a reminder to go beyond the surface level and ask yourself what your life experiences mean. Life doesn't always make sense, but it's up to you to make meaning. Not all experiences are meant to build strength. Some just give you the information about what not to do again. Whether it's a relationship, a job, or anything else, it's important not to dwell on the past--instead use the information to make better choices going forward. Our memories can often hold onto more than just the good times. Sometimes, when you least expect it, an old issue from the past can be awakened. Emotions are amplified at this time, and your actions need to be aligned with logic and reason; not everything will make sense (to all your six senses). As it’s usually difficult to see the greater vision from inside the eye of the storm. But instead of trying to suppress your feelings, explore the fault lines of your emotions. Find the wisdom in the old tales that are being replayed now. Anchor yourself in your truth (as Sagittarius is the ruler of the 9th house), and your truth will guide you in taking the right action and navigating the unknown. Under this full moon, let the light of understanding guide you. Tap into that power and trust in the understanding that these experiences are here to inform, shape, define and guide you.

The Gemini full moon illuminates your 10th house of career and public recognition. The full moon is here to light up your path to success! Whether it's through speaking at an event, writing for publication, or anything else you're passionate about, don't be afraid to take a chance and express yourself. Now is the time to make your mark. Remember to think outside the box to take your career or business to the next level. It's not just about who you know but who knows you. Growing your business network is the key to unlocking new opportunities and possibilities. It's not just about who you know, but what you can do together. Every connection can be an opportunity to collaborate, share ideas, and create new connections. This full moon is a social time, don't be afraid to make connections and build relationships. As your career evolves, it can be easy to get caught up in uncertainty. Sometimes it's easy to get stuck in our heads - overthinking and questioning ourselves. But don't let the noise of your thoughts keep you from advancing. When you start to feel the spiral of overthinking and questioning, take a deep breath and remember that it's okay to be a work in progress. Guided meditation can help as you attempt to stay centered and optimistic. You must keep yourself grounded and your home a sanctuary during these transitions. By taking the time to reflect on your needs within your home, you can then support your work or public life accordingly. Especially when your career and business ask that you show up fully. Now is the time to release any resistance to integrating parts of your unique personality into your public-facing career persona. It's time to claim your power and step into your true potential.

The Gemini full moon illuminates your 11th house of friendships and networks. The Gemini full moon is here, and it's time to take stock of your relationships. Who do you have in your life that brings out the best in you? Who is helping you reach your goals? Take this moment to reflect on the importance of the people around you and their impact on your journey. This is a time to reflect on the people and moments that bring contentment and fulfillment. Let the light of the Gemini full moon guide you. Reach out to those that bring joy, laughter, and love into your life. Let go of what doesn't serve you, and surround yourself with those who make you shine. This full moon can bring about gossip and heated arguments; sometimes, it is better just to walk than to fight with fools. Instead, you can focus on building more robust, meaningful relationships and social connections. Sometimes it's easy to get caught up in social media drama, so be honest with yourself about who your true friends are and stop allowing toxic people into your life (physically or digitally). It's time to release false friends, networks, and social platforms that aren't supportive of your mental health. The shadow of Gemini energy can have you constantly refreshing your social media feeds, obsessed with the latest news. This energy can leave you feeling more overwhelmed and confused rather than informed and connected. Social media and the internet have been incredible tools for breaking down barriers, staying in touch with long-distance friends, and helping you connect with others and other cultures. On the one hand, you've gotten so much by connecting with others online. But on the other hand, it's so easy to become distracted and consumed by it all. The constant dopamine hits and dopamine crashes can leave you feeling drained and unsatisfied. Constantly being "on" and "shareworthy" can be exhausting. But how much is too much? You can easily forget that technology is a tool, not an end in itself. It's essential to ensure you're using it to your benefit and not letting it take over your life. This full moon asks that you find a way to balance your need for social media and digital connection and your need for information. This is a time to fine-tune your social media presence (or altogether remove yourself from specific platforms). When you post something, you never know who might see it. And you never know what kind of impact it might have on your life or career. So take social media seriously. Be thoughtful with your words and careful about what you post. You never know when it might return to reward or bite you. The internet keeps receipts. Focus on what is working in your projects and relationships, and let go of anything holding you back. Don't be afraid to let your Leo light shine. You are multi-faceted, complex, and full of potential. Allow your strengths and the things that make you unique to be seen. Don't be afraid to express yourself authentically, even if it means you might face judgment or rejection. To find your true voice and make your mark in the world, you have to be brave. To find your creative voice, you must first be vulnerable. You have to trust yourself, your ideas, and your vision. You may have to stand alone for a while, but you are strong enough to do so. As a creative leader, it's your strength and courage to be vulnerable and stand firm in the face of opposition that will set you apart. Share your truth and vision with confidence - you have the power to manifest your message into reality.

The Gemini full moon illuminates your 12th house of karma, subconscious, and endings. Cancer, Luna is your ruler. The full moon naturally has a more powerful influence on your emotions and inner world. You can tap into its fortune if you remain in alignment with Universal energy but resist it, and you can experience turbulent waters. Life is all about flow, so remember to center yourself within this infinite energy and trust that it will guide you. This full moon offers an opportunity to step back and reflect on the past 12 months and prepare for what's to come. While it can be tempting to get stuck in the past, it's helpful to remember that everything in your life changes. It's important to honor that and to hold space for all the endings and new beginnings that lie ahead. Release your need to be in control, allow for endings, mourn if needed and allow yourself to flow with the current of whatever is unfolding, even if the destination is still unknown. By practicing breathwork, you can tap into this energy and release any trapped emotions or past struggles. Reflect on this full moon energy, and take the time to acknowledge what you're letting go of and embracing. Breathe deeply, and shift your focus to the present moment. With practice, you can let go of old patterns and trauma and make room for the new. Breathwork can bring profound healing to your spirit and body, especially when releasing trapped emotions and past challenges. Take a moment to connect with your breath, do 4-7-8 breathing the traditional way, empty your lungs of air, breathe in through your nose for 4 seconds, hold your breath for 7 seconds, exhale out of the mouth for 8 seconds, and repeat at least 4 times and work through this full moon energy.

The Capricorn new moon activates your 6th house of health and being of service. Leo, you’re not one to feel restricted, but you might just need to slow down now and reevaluate your lifestyle and health habits. A new self-care regimen that will give you more energy and create more stability and routine in your life. “I transform and know myself more through a structured approach to my self-care.” The Capricorn new moon in your 6th house of work and daily routine is illuminating the importance of self-care and balance in your daily life. If you've been feeling overlooked or unacknowledged, it's important to address these feelings rather than ignore them. Unexpressed anger can manifest in negative ways, both physically and emotionally, so find healthy outlets for expression and clearly communicate your boundaries and needs to those around you. Anything arising right now is to help you break through disharmony and find your way back to health and service. The New Moon in Capricorn is shining a light on your work and service in the world. The sixth house is ruled by Virgo and corresponds to The Hermit. Virgo and the Hermit observe. The Hermit encourages you to purify your mind - to look closely at yourself, so you can start taking note of the ways in which you give too much of yourself. With patience, contemplation, and observation, you can make small changes in your daily routines which can add up to create an impactful transformation.

Remember that being human means being imperfect and that it is a part of life. Embrace the human experience, and do not judge yourself for your mistakes or shortcomings. Any unresolved issues or imbalances that have been lingering will come to the surface for resolution or at least for open discussion. This season presents an opportunity for you to make the necessary changes to help you grow and evolve as a person and a partner.
