The other is a reflection of your own inner beauty. Both are part of the infinite. Reflect on how you have held space for your partner and close relationships, and how they have held space for you. Consider how your relationship with yourself and others has expanded over the past year. Have you been more open to new connections? As you set your intention for this new moon, remember that the new lessons about connection are here to inform you about your ability and desire to commit. Mastering the art of listening and sharing mutually is a skill that will serve you well in all your relationships.

The Capricorn new moon activates your 8th house of transformation, symbolism, and other people's money. This is a time of transformation and growth, as you learn to trust in the natural unfolding of life. Your focus is on areas of intimacy and shared resources, as you delve deeper into understanding yourself and your inner resources. You may be exploring themes of loss, control, and surrender as you navigate through this uncertain time. The things that you once thought brought you security may no longer hold the same weight, as you learn to tap into your deeper inner resources to guide you through challenges. Trust in yourself and your abilities, as you navigate this transformative journey. The power dynamics in your life may force you to look within yourself and tap into that inner well of power and strength that you may not have known existed. Embrace the discomfort and let go of the small version of yourself. This season, you will be exploring the most intimate spaces of your soul, and it may be a time of transformation. Do not fear the unknown, for fear itself can be a gift that can help you to let go of the past, trust in yourself, and align with the flow of life. You are more powerful and capable than you realize, and being in connection with another may remind you of this, whether it is through a deep connection or a lesson of disempowerment. Power dynamics that haven't been addressed will now arise, asking for changes in your relationships. You may come face to face with how much you unconsciously depend on others to feel validated. Any unhealthy or abusive behaviors, whether within yourself or from others, need to be let go of, or you may experience some shocking moments that will force transformation. Be open to new solutions to old patterns, even if they may seem uncomfortable or painful. Remember, small steps are still steps forward, but no step at all will keep you stuck. Security is an inner construct that you have some control over, so build trust in yourself and trust outside of yourself will naturally follow. Your intention for this new moon is to take control of your inner security and trust in yourself and the universe.

The Capricorn new moon illuminates the path to your higher self, activating the energies of the 9th house of philosophy, greater wisdom, and higher learning. A call to explore foreign cultures, places, and deeper knowledge is resonating within you. Your deepest desires may be nurtured in these realms of discovery and growth. During this new moon, you may experience a sense of focus and stability, as the new moon in Capricorn aligns with your 9th House of Higher Self. This is a powerful time to tap into the mysteries of life and connect with the magick that lies beneath the surface. Incorporate daily spiritual practices into your life, and lean deeper into your intuition. Reflect on your vision and goals for your future self, and commit to taking steps towards achieving them. If you are feeling lost or directionless, it is easy to turn away from your spiritual practices. However, by actively engaging in and deepening your intuition and spiritual practices, you can gain a clearer understanding of your needs, your true path, and your potential. By setting an intention to strengthen your spirituality, new opportunities and paths may open up to you, bringing more light and understanding to your personal journey. If you are seeking to shift your energy and perspective, start by incorporating daily spiritual practices into your routine. Invest in yourself and listen to your intuition - these are powerful tools for creating an expansive and fulfilling life. Trust in the process and allow yourself to be guided by the wisdom of your inner self. The 9th house is ruled by Sagittarius and corresponds to Temperance in the Major Arcana. Temperance symbolizes the merging of the spiritual and mundane worlds, discovering our purpose or meaning, mindfulness of overindulging or drinking, moderation, the balance of passion and reason, and cultivating patience. Perhaps you find yourself eager to uncover the truth and wisdom behind the mysteries of life. You may be struggling to understand the greater meaning of life, asking questions such as "What is life? What did my soul come to learn in this lifetime?" You seek greater understanding and meaning in the everyday world, possibly through a spiritual lens. The search for true wisdom is not always straightforward, but delving into the mysteries of life can bring great rewards. Temperance, on a spiritual level, represents the potential for true communication with your Higher Self. When you are open to fate and curious about synchronicities, your Higher Self can make its presence known. The planetary ruler of Sagittarius/Temperance is Jupiter, which corresponds to the Wheel of Fortune. Themes associated with the Wheel of Fortune include change of fate, luck, expansion, destiny, positive karma, and the beginning or end of a cycle. This new moon encourages you to remain curious and open-minded to new chance encounters, invitations, and unexpected opportunities. As you set your intention for this new moon, consider how you can reconnect to your sense of purpose and spirituality so you can plan your path forward.

The Capricorn new moon illuminates the path of your career and public recognition, activating the energies of the 10th house. Your career is the main focus for you now, as you delve deeper into understanding yourself and your strengths. You may find yourself questioning whether all aspects of yourself are being honored and acknowledged in your current work. This introspection may lead you to explore new career paths that align with your true self and passions. This is an opportunity to assess if your current career path aligns with your values and goals and make changes accordingly. Embrace the journey and let the light of this new moon guide you toward a fulfilling and meaningful career. This Capricorn new moon and the energy of the Capricorn season may be pushing you to confront some difficult areas, particularly in your career and how you take responsibility for your life. Changes in status, responsibility, or direction may arise, even if they are unclear at the moment, but ultimately they are meant to help you grow. Your ability to feel secure and confident in your work will determine the outcome. To navigate this time, it's important to avoid scattered thinking and take a step back to focus on the long-range details. Make sure that whatever you put your energy into aligns with your values and is building toward your future. Use this time to figure out which direction you want to head in with your career and move forward. Consider setting intentions to commit to your career and support your professional growth. Seek support from podcasts, and books, or find a mentor to empower you to expand and step more into a public role. Get clear on your desires and what you need to do to take responsibility for making them a reality. This is an opportunity to take a step towards a new level of maturity and responsibility. Additionally, parents may be asking more of you in a time of need, remember where you came from and use that as a guidepost. The 10th house is ruled by Capricorn and corresponds to the Devil in the Major Arcana. The Devil/Capricorn speaks to your false belief that you are trapped or stuck in your current circumstances. This card often symbolizes struggles with a moral dilemma- a choice between what feels good in the moment and what is truly right for you. It may also suggest that you feel overwhelmed by an internal struggle as you may not have clearly defined your values or beliefs and have adopted those of others that are leading you away from fulfillment. This is a time to set the intention to align your career with your core values and interests. Take the time to reflect on what truly matters to you and what you are passionate about. Identify the values that guide your decisions and make sure that your career choices align with them. This will help you to make choices that are in line with your true self, rather than feeling trapped by the expectations of others.

The new moon in Capricorn brings the spotlight to your friendships, activating the energies of the 11th house. This is a powerful time for connecting with others, building community, and networking. Opportunities for building new friendships, expanding your community, and finding support from others may present themselves now. By actively engaging with your community and seeing where your gifts and talents can be offered, you can take advantage of this energy to boost your career and success. It's important to stay focused on what is working in your projects and relationships and to address any issues that may not be working. During the previous month (Scorpio season and new moon highlighting your 10th house), you may have been facing challenges in your work and career. If you've been feeling like your dreams and goals aren't coming to fruition, it's time to take a step back and review your strategy or consider changing course. You may also be seeing progress in projects that you have been working on and manifesting them into reality. Friendships and social connections may also be shifting, and you may find yourself working with groups that are new and different for you. These changes may require you to adapt and adapt to new communities or locations, or you may realize that the current community and friends you're with are not aligned with your values. These changes are all a part of the process, and they help you explore new sides of yourself, and expose you to new ideas and visions. This season, take a moment to reflect on the kind of company and community you want to surround yourself with. Who aligns with your values and goals? Who are the people you want to have in your life and support you in your journey? Asking these questions will help you make conscious choices about the people and groups you want to be a part of, and ultimately, can help you advance your career and achieve success.

The Capricorn new moon illuminates your 12th house of karma, subconscious, and endings. This energy is focused on exploring your internal landscape and expressing it through creative means. You may be feeling a sense of loss or uncertainty, but this is a time to tap into your spirituality and intuition for guidance. Use this time to connect with your spiritual and artistic side, let yourself dream and meditate, and be open to inspiration. It is important to be mindful of the fact that not everything may be clear or as it seems during this time. This new moon is a reminder to focus on your inner journey and the power of your subconscious. You may be receiving messages from past lives or ancestral lineage, and it may be a time for healing and clearing trauma. It is important to allow yourself to feel and process any emotions that come up and turn to your spiritual practices for support. Take time for self-care and regeneration, and trust in the process of endings and new beginnings. Trust in your purpose and hold it in your heart, regardless of the challenges you may be facing. Remember that everything is temporary and will pass and that this new moon is illuminating your 12th house of rest and reflection, encouraging you to take some time for yourself and recharge. The 12th house is ruled by Pisces and is associated with the planetary energies of Neptune (modern ruler) and Jupiter (ancient ruler). Neptune, also known as The Hanged Man, represents enlightenment, intuition, stillness, and meditation. This new moon may bring a sense of closure to a certain chapter in your life and force you to reflect on your past actions and experiences. It may also bring a moment of insight or inspiration, but it's important to let go of any expectations or attachments to the outcome. Jupiter, also known as The Wheel of Fortune, represents change, luck, and the beginning or end of a cycle. This new moon may bring unexpected opportunities or shifts in your life. It's important to take care of your health and well-being during this time and to make time for rest and restoration. Trust in the process and allow yourself to be guided by the wisdom of the universe. Your new moon's intention is to let go of expectations and to trust in the natural cycle of endings and beginnings. Allow your faith, trust, and creative expression to nurture you and guide you through this transition.

The Cancer full moon shines alight upon you, illuminating your 1st House of Self. This is a time to celebrate. Celebrate who you are and all that you can become. Embrace your growth, your courage, and your strength. See yourself in a new light, and marvel at your beauty, within and without. You are naturally highly empathetic — both interpersonal empathy, which involves understanding how another person feels, and emotional empathy, which consists in understanding how another person's feelings influence their behavior. Both are important, but if you aren't taking care of yourself—by regularly checking in with yourself on a physical level (e.g., via self-care practices), it can be harder to be emotionally present for those around you, especially if you're in a significant partnership. Taking the time to check in with yourself on a physical level can help you stay balanced and connected, so you can keep showing up for those you love in the best way possible. This full moon brings significant changes for your Cancer. Particularly in the relationship and home realm with the Cancer full moon in your 1st house. You might be committing more deeply to a partnership, moving in together, or working through parent/family dynamics. You, more than most, can end up in codependent relationships. You're learning to take on more responsibility than you're used to and navigating the needs of others while honoring your need for support and connection. Now's the time to review and come back to yourself if necessary.

The Cancer full moon illuminates your 2nd house of disposable income and foundation. This full moon is the perfect opportunity to reflect on what you value and what brings you joy. The full moon in the second house is a reminder to take stock of your financial decisions. It's an opportunity to look back on the choices you've made and to reflect on how fear-based or scarcity-driven thinking may have influenced them. By exploring your feelings about money, we can ensure that you make decisions from a place of abundance instead of scarcity. There's still time to make positive changes to create a secure financial future and ensure you don't let fear dictate your financial decisions. This full moon is the perfect time to look inward. This a reminder to reflect on what makes you feel secure. What brings you feelings of stability? During this full moon, you may realize that you've been resistant to building stability in your life. You may be holding traumatic experiences in your subconscious. Whether things that happened to you in the recent past or unresolved emotions, these unresolved energies can make it difficult for you to feel safe. As a result, you could be stuck in fight-or-flight mode, which prevents you from relaxing into a stable environment, and unable to receive the consistent stream of abundance you deserve. You can move on if you give yourself the time and space to process these complicated feelings. Money is more than just a physical exchange for your efforts - it's a representation of your worth, too. If you want to be successful, whether it means achieving your goals or creating a healthy, fulfilling life, you have to believe that you are worth it. It's time to start internalizing that you are worthy of financial and emotional stability and that success is achievable. And if you're having trouble believing in yourself, don't be afraid to ask for a mentor who can help guide you. The second house corresponds to The Hierophant in major arcana. The Hierophant teaches that there is more than just the material world; there is a divine ruler. As the High Priestess taught the Fool to discover spiritual wisdom from within, the Hierophant teaches the Fool to find spiritual wisdom from external sources: Spiritual leaders, mentors, ancestors, and community. The Hierophant's links to religion, knowledge, and traditions passed down through oral teachings parallel the "fixed" teachings that comprise our social and religious framework. The Hierophant teaches you to return to tradition; you may have expanded your horizons past your comfort zone, and now it's time to return to the familiar to re-frame your focus. Venus is the planetary ruler of the 2nd house, which corresponds to The Empress in the Major Arcana. During this full moon, you would benefit from the guidance of a financial planner, estate lawyer, or therapist. It's also possible your mother could play a significant role (alive or in memory) during this Cancer full moon.

The Gemini full moon illuminates your 3rd house of communication. Communication, studies, travel, and networking have been your main focus this full moon. Words have power. They have the power to shape and influence the world around you. Notice if the words you use to communicate your authentic self or if you have been stifling it to fit the status quo or stay small. Find your words. Your words can be powerful instruments of self-expression. Get creative and explore different ways of communication - writing, singing, public speaking - and discover the unique voice within you. Don't let anyone silence you, especially don't silence yourself. The 3rd house corresponds to The Lovers in the major arcana. The Lovers represent the union of duality, in this case, the union and marriage of verbal and nonverbal communication. Words can only get you so far. Sometimes, they just aren't enough. It's not just about the words you use but also your body language. Verbal communication is an important tool, and nonverbal communication can carry just as much weight. Think about your body language, facial expressions, and gestures when talking to someone. It all adds up to create a unique message that speaks volumes. You might reflect more on improving your non-verbal communication skills during this full moon. Improving and avoiding disengaged body language, avoiding eye contact, multitasking, allowing your computer, television, phone, game or book, etc., to get between you and the other person speaking. Your emotions are an essential part of your story. From sadness to joy, anger to gratitude, your feelings are the most potent form of communication. Emotional intelligence is the key to understanding yourself and empathizing with others. It's not just about recognizing and managing emotions; it's also about learning how to express your feelings healthily and positively. The full moon shines brightly, asking you to develop your emotional intelligence. Which requires practice and perseverance but, when mastered, can help you live a more meaningful, honest, and fulfilling life. The full moon in the 3rd house and The Lovers teaches lessons about communication. Ask yourself if you have expressed what you need to say to others, your partner, and even yourself. Does everyone have the necessary information to make honest choices for their emotional well-being, or are you holding back? Look within to determine whether you live in a state of self-love and acceptance.

The Cancer full moon highlights your 4th house and brings awareness of home, family, and security. The 4th house is a Karmic house and brings family situations to the surface for deeper understanding to learn and then release. Home, family, work, and emotional support are the main focuses for you now, Aries, with the Cancer full moon in your 4th house. Success is important to you, but not at the expense of your home life and emotional stability. Life has a way of catching up to you. If you've been too busy tending to the outside world, now is the time to focus on your inner world. As your emotions resurface and demand attention, don't despair - this is a sign that it's time to start the healing process. The full moon in Cancer is a gentle reminder that home and family connections are essential for your emotional well-being. During this time, you can hang out with friends and family who listen without judgment, visit places that evoke positive memories from your past, and take time to reflect on the significant people in your life. Reconnecting with your roots - your family, friends, and the places that feel at home. Take this time for self-reflection and to appreciate the people and places that have left a lasting impression on your life. Appreciate their presence, their impact, and the love that remains even after they are gone. Take this moment to honor your loved ones and be intentional about creating meaningful connections with those still alive. Under this full moon, reflect on everything that brings togetherness. Your family roots shared experiences, and love for each other. The full moon is also a time of celebration, and you may be celebrating the birth of a newborn to your family or a job promotion. The full moon in Cancer signals a time to care for your emotional and career needs. It's not enough to be 'strong' or 'resilient' — you need healthy, nourishing relationships with the people around you. You need to feel safe and secure and trust yourself and others. You need to know that you will be taken care of when you need help and that others will be there for you. And above all, you need to feel loved and supported by those you count as close friends, family, and colleagues. If these things are missing in your life, you are likely feeling emotionally disconnected and burnt out. Use this full moon to release any tension with your home life, and bring yourself into balance and emotional fulfillment. The full moon in Cancer is a time to declutter your home; whether its emotionally charged items or a toxic dynamic in your family line, let go of anything that is no longer needed in order for you to feel relaxed and free. It’s time to take an honest look at what’s cluttering up your life and taking up valuable headspace. From physical items that have outstayed their welcome in your house to emotional baggage holding you back from living in the present. Declutter your home and let go of any charge or emotion attached to your family legacy. Tap into the liberating power of going through what needs to be released and make space for something new to come in. Just remember: you are not your home; you are not your body; you are not your possessions; you are not your jobs or status; you are not your relationships or circumstances. You are just you — pure consciousness — showing up here through all these layers of experience.

“What drains your spirit drains your body. What fuels your spirit fuels your body.” - Carolyn Myss Intimacy, romance, children, and creativity are themes for this Cancer full moon in your 5th house. Intimacy is part of your human nature. From birth, you're wired to crave connection and closeness with those around you. That's why it's so important to nurture your relationships and create moments of intimacy and togetherness. Our connection to each other is so powerful, even from the earliest stages of life. That's why volunteer cuddlers are such an important part of hospitals - they provide the love and care that helps babies in need grow and thrive. A hug is the intentional physical application of energetic connection, an endless cycle of interconnectedness. And yet, as adults, we forget the power of a hug, instead relying on superficial norms to guide our interactions. When was the last time you felt the warmth of a hug or the comfort of a hand on your shoulder? Are you missing the experience of touch? Are you spending most of the day alone or with limited interaction with others? You may have grown accustomed to following society's rules and put your need for physical contact and comfort last. During this full moon, begin reintroducing daily interactions and touch back into your everyday routine. Try to organize your daily life so that you receive human connection every day without having to purposely reach out for it. Because when you feel insecure about reaching out, it's usually the time when you need human connection the most. This full moon in the fifth house can signal the start of a new creative endeavor that has been gestating for some time. The fifth house is ruled by Leo and corresponds to Strength in the major arcana. The Strength card reminds you of a sacred power grounded in inner Strength and trust that comes from emotional mastery. Intense feelings about your own worth and value may cause temporary emotional conflict. No matter how intense your emotions are, you have the power to use them as fuel for your creative fire. Tap into that deeper part of yourself and uncover the strength, creativity, and joy that lies inside. Tap into your inner child and explore the hobbies and pastimes that used to bring you joy. Let these be the spark that ignites your creative passions and fills you with light, and let your inner child run wild.

The Cancer full moon illuminates your 6th house of health and being of service. This is an excellent time to refine any daily habits, routines, or activities that harm your overall emotional well-being. With the Sun in Capricorn, symbolizing work, and the Full Moon in Cancer, asking you to focus on rest and restoration. Work and rest aren't synonymous, but you're learning to balance both now with the Cancer full moon in your 6th house. Your health, work, and daily routines may be getting changed as new information comes through to challenge and evolve stuck patterns. Flexibility is your best friend. You might find remote work opportunities, create your own retreats, or help others create theirs. You may connect more within your local community through work or a new health or exercise routine. Anything arising right now is to help you break through disharmony and find your way back to health and service. If you've been giving too much, now's the time to focus on yourself, restore your sleep schedule, and find a routine that is helpful. The 6th house corresponds to the Hermit in the Major Arcana. The Hermit signals a time to take space and remove oneself from the outside world's noise, distractions, and opinions. The Hermit signals a time to re-evaluate any challenging situations, relationship dynamics, or personal goals that require focus and attention. To be the best version of yourself, you need to take the time to "fill your own cup." Stop and ask yourself what you truly need, then do it. The Hermit is willing to explore the shadows and bring what is hidden into the light. Her lessons bring you to wholeness and authenticity. If you're feeling depleted, try taking some quiet time for yourself. If you're feeling anxious, try taking a few minutes to do some deep breathing. Sometimes you need to take a mental health break. Whether it's to disconnect from work or to process your emotions, taking time for yourself can be essential. The Cancer full moon is an opportunity to shed light on the emotional challenges preventing your body from feeling at ease. It's a time of self-exploration and self-care. Look inward to try and understand how your body responds to the stress and strain of life, what emotional wounds you're carrying, and how these emotions may affect your health. If health issues arise, it's time to find ways to reduce your stress and locate your internal focal point. Finding an inner sense of stability and connection to something higher than yourself will help ease your nerves. As you begin to feel a pull toward repressed emotions, it's essential to take care of yourself physically and emotionally and ensure you have a robust support system. Creating a safe space for yourself can help you process your feelings and find some relief. If you're an introvert, this may be especially important for you. Daily practices will also help anchor yourself and provide stress relief and stability. If you're experiencing loss or grief, find friends, family, and professionals who can support you. Emotional healing doesn't always come easily, so if you're having trouble processing your feelings, don't hesitate to seek help. There are many self-help tools available that can help guide you in the right direction.

The Cancer full moon illuminates your 7th house of relationships. This full moon may illuminate the ways you perceive commitment and emotional vulnerability. With the Sun in Capricorn, the sign of dedication, and the full moon in nurturing Cancer, you may deepen your commitment and find healing ways to share yourself in a relationship. On the other hand, you might be ready to free yourself from the responsibilities of a relationship, to find yourself again, taking space or fully separating from a relationship. If you are single, a full moon in your seventh house could be the ideal time to start dating again. The Cancer full moon is a time to rest, recharge, and rejuvenate. You're motivated to connect with others in ways that support your emotional health and emotional well-being. Balancing your emotional needs with the emotional needs of others is in focus for you now. When you are healthy, happy, and balanced, you are more likely to be able to focus on others and not get pulled in too many directions. Plus, taking care of yourself allows you to be in touch with your emotions, empathize better and understand what those closest to you are feeling without words. People need one another and knowing that you are cared for and understood can be incredibly healing. This is especially true within the context of trauma, where one can struggle to feel connected or understood by others. Trauma can leave you feeling alone and disconnected and lead to symptoms like anxiety, depression, and PTSD. When you have people in your life who care about you and who you feel safe and secure with, it can be a powerful way to build resilience. It also helps you to feel seen and valued, which is essential for healing. The Cancer full moon in the seventh house is an excellent time to re-examine your relationship's current situation. A full moon represents a peak in emotions and a time when you are more likely to feel comfortable being open and honest with your partner. If issues in your relationship need to be addressed, now is an excellent time to start that conversation. One potentially negative aspect of the Cancer full moon in the seventh house is a possible increase in feelings of neediness or jealousy. Be careful not to let feelings of jealousy get out of hand. Libra rules the 7th house and corresponds to Justice in the Major Arcana. Justice wants you to find clarity, emotional balance, and fairness in relationships. Sometimes it's easier to be more compassionate to those in your intimate relationship than yourself. You can lend a sounding ear to your partner but then judge and criticize yourself for feeling emotional. Feeling bad is complicated enough on its own. Trying to repress or suppress those feelings only makes things worse. Instead, try accepting your emotions. Give yourself the same emotional support you would give another. Don't try to change or suppress your emotions - just allow them to be and allow yourself to feel them. Free up space to let your feelings pass through you without holding on to them or judging yourself for their intensity. If you're feeling stuck, ask yourself where you might be avoiding or denying the truth in your emotions. Then, take some time to look inside and get to the root of these issues. You can do this with the support of your friends and family and with a bit of self-compassion.

The Cancer full moon illuminates your 8th house of transformation, symbolism, and other people's money. The full moon in the eight house illuminates what others have given to support you (or didn't give support) and signals a time when you can give back to those who have helped you along your journey or let go of the baggage that was given that you no longer need to carry. Know that you are valuable and worthy of love and connection. Be careful with debt and money during this time, and ensure you're handling your finances well. The 8th house is ruled by Scorpio and corresponds to the Death card in the Major Arcana. The Death card signals a possible time that you're in a situation where fear is holding you in an emotional deadlock. It's even more likely that you're engaging in avoidance tactics and feeling energetically drained. The underlying lesson of Death is that if you let go of the fear of loss or missed opportunities, you will see that change is inevitable. It is up to you to surrender — which feels like Death to the human ego — rather than waste time in denial, avoidance, or pining for lost opportunities. The 8th house also contains themes of occult studies, symbolism, and searching for the meaning behind signs and symbols. However, sometimes, searching for meaning in everything is a coping mechanism against the fear of uncertainty. It's human nature to dislike uncertainty. It's tempting to want everything to have an order and a purpose, but that's impossible. Life can be unpredictable, And uncertainty is an inevitable part of life. How you cope makes all the difference. Accepting smaller moments of uncertainty, you can learn to build your courage and inner strength to help you face it confidently when uncertainty arrives in big ways—as it will eventually.

The Cancer full moon illuminates your 10th house of career and public recognition. If you're in a career that you're happy with, you could be getting a promotion or going into business. If you've been unhappy with your work-life balance, you might be making decisions to change or being forced out of situations that aren't emotionally healthy for you anymore. The spotlight is shining brightly on your career right now, and it's the perfect time to share your voice with the world. Sometimes it can be challenging to keep your priorities straight amid work pressures and career building. Between juggling responsibilities at home and at work, it's easy to feel like you're spread too thin and aren't giving your full attention to anything. But, if you don't slow down to check in with your emotions, you'll be ignoring your needs, missing out on opportunities, and falling into unfulfilling patterns that lead you further away from emotional fulfillment. Listen to yourself, and give yourself the time you need to feel whole and emotionally centered. Explore what successful work-life balance feels for you and if you don't feel you've created it yet, take actionable steps toward it. The 10th house is ruled by Capricorn and corresponds to the Devil in the Major Arcana. The Devil/Capricorn speaks to your false belief that you are trapped or stuck in your current circumstances. The Devil usually symbolizes struggles with a moral problem — a choice between lust or love; but mostly, it means you're overwhelmed with an international struggle. You may haven't defined your values or beliefs and have taken on the beliefs of others that are misleading you of your fulfillment. Perhaps you prefer to switch careers to focus more energy on your family. Maybe you prefer not to have children and find fulfillment in other areas of your life. Perhaps you have no idea what you want, and you need to take this time to discover your values. Happiness is an inside job, don't outsource your happiness. Make sure that you are in charge of your life and values system. And if one thing goes wrong, don't look for someone else to take responsibility for it. Whether it's your partners, kids, pets, or your job. It's important to remember that you are in charge of your happiness and value system. And it's never conditional on anyone else. It is not conditional on your spouse or kids calling you on your birthday. Everyone is an individual with their own values. Don't impose your expectations on them and then feel disappointed when it's not met. So take a moment to focus on yourself and what you truly value. Invest in what you can and what makes you feel happy and emotionally fulfilled. Why is this so important? Because if you don't take control of your happiness and make conscious decisions about how you want your life to look, things will always be out of your control.

The Cancer full moon illuminates your 11th house of friendship. Good friends are good for your health, and this full moon illuminates the importance of those you surround yourself with. In recent years, you've become more aware of the importance of creating a supportive social network. Friends provide you with emotional support, a listening ear, and a shoulder (or couch) when times get tough. Your friends can also be an outlet for you to express yourself and feel accepted. Connecting with others can help you feel seen and valued. Which are one of the hallmarks of well-being. When you feel seen and valued, you are more likely to take care of yourself. You are more likely to neglect your needs when you feel unseen or devalued. It's time to reflect on your connections with the world around you. Technology has allowed you to create and share more information than ever before. But what about forging real, meaningful connections? Make an effort to reach out to those you care about, spend time with nature, and make that human-to-human connection. After all, we all crave authentic connection. The Cancer full moon reminds you that human connection is essential. Even when you feel insecure about reaching out, it's usually the moment when you need it the most. So take a few moments to organize your daily life so that you get regular human contact and interaction. It will do wonders for your mental and emotional well-being.

The Cancer full moon illuminates your 12th house of karma, subconscious, and endings. Full moons can be a time of celebration; however, now may be a time to withdraw into a sanctuary of self-care and seclusion. With the Cancer full moon in your 12th house, you're discovering the best ways to take care of yourself and recharge when you feel overworked, fatigued, and anxious. You'll reconnect to your creativity when you carve out downtime for yourself, and it will remind you how much you love being in the spotlight. Perhaps you're making significant advances in your creative career or working through releasing some recent disappointments. Whichever it is, make sure your self-care habits are helping you through the stress and excitement. Emotional connections are like a lighthouse in the dark. When the waters get rough, their light shows you the way. They keep you grounded and give you a sense of belonging. They remind you that even in the midst of endings, there is still love. Emotional connection can assist in navigating endings. It's a feeling of comfort and belonging, knowing that someone else is there to support you and love you for who you are. Sometimes the most meaningful connections are with our Higher Self and Self. Feeling connected to yourself is the ultimate form of self-compassion, an essential part of feeling whole. If you're feeling disconnected or unsure about how to connect with your Higher Self, you can meditate, journal, or use tools such as tarot cards. Difficult experiences shape life, such as trauma and bereavement, and can impact physical health, emotional state, beliefs, behaviors, and relationship patterns. To move forward and begin anew, it's crucial to heal these traumas and address their roots. During this full moon, you may also be experiencing intense emotional attachments and memories towards certain people who have passed away or places that hold deep significance from your childhood. Remember that healing is a journey, and it's okay to reach out for support from those around you. You are not alone on this path of transformation and growth. The 12th house is ruled by Pisces and corresponds to The Moon in the Major Arcana. The Moon reminds you of the Law of Rhythm that governs natural development and the shifting of energies. The Cancer full moon in the 12th house signals a time of endings. Look up in the sky tonight, and you'll see a reminder that life is a beautiful pattern of cycles, which you are a part of. Everything in life has a beginning and an end, which is inevitable. You can learn how to navigate endings and loss by reflecting on your previous experiences. A reflection is a form of self-care, and it is a chance to process all the events in your life that impacted you and resulted in you starting over. Allow yourself to exist within the collective consciousness and experience the healing and regeneration that comes with osmosis.

Happy Birthday Aquarius. The Aquarius new moon is in your 1st house of Self. As the solar return approaches and the personal new year dawns, it is a time for introspection and contemplation to consider the aspirations and goals you wish to manifest in the coming year. It is an opportunity to gain clarity about the things you desire to manifest in your life, the talents you wish to cultivate, and the direction in which you wish to steer your journey. It is a time to take stock of where you are and where you want to be, to chart a course that will guide you toward fulfilling your desires and realizing your goals. With a new moon in your sign, it’s time to focus on new beginnings and releasing old unhealthy patterns. This new moon is a reminder that your mind is a gift — not a prison. Yes, it can restrict your vision with doubt. But it can also open your world up to endless possibilities and help you see the possibilities in life. You can be the visionary of your own path, standing in your power to create a life that aligns with your soul's signature vibration. You are a humanitarian by nature, with the power to design a life that is free from external conditioning. This Aquarius new moon honors what makes you unique and different. The Aquarius new moon in your sign is a time of transformation. You may decide to make changes in your self-image; get into shape, lose or gain weight, or visit an optometrist or cosmetic surgeon to make changes in your appearance. If you are self-employed and your personality is your brand, this is also a time to redesign your website. Leverage your gifts to elevate you from the masses, stand out, and be recognized for your contributions. The Fool in the tarot represents the Spirit's descent into the physical realm, symbolizing the purity and potential of the soul. As the Fool begins her journey, she leans on her faith and trusts that the Universe will guide her. Uranus, her cosmic companion, imbues her with energy of rebellion, revolution, and change. The Fool is unafraid to take risks, innovate, and break through boundaries, embracing limitlessness and change. She represents faith over fear, daring to step into the unknown with confidence and trust in the journey ahead. The cosmic energy of the 1st house, ruled by the fiery and pioneering Aries, aligns with the Emperor card in the Major Arcana. Aries brings in the energy of new beginnings and karmic cycles, while the Emperor urges us to tap into our inner authority and find our individuality apart from external, socially defined norms. This is a powerful time to step into our personal power and take control of our lives, cultivating a strong sense of self and personal responsibility. As we trust in our inner guidance and let go of outdated patterns, we open ourselves to new opportunities for growth and self-discovery. This is a time to confidently assert ourselves and take charge of our lives Aquarius & Aquarius Rising Tarotscope Create your tarotscopes for this new moon. Create sacred space, clear your mind and position the cards and see what guidance comes forth: The Sun (Sun) and the Moon (The High Priestess) are in Aquarius (The Star), illuminating the 1st House (Aries/The Emperor), with ruling planet Mars (The Tower). 3. The Star (Aquarius) / The Fool (Uranus) 5. The Tower (Mars) 1. The Sun (Sun) 4. The Emperor (Aries) 2. The High Priestess (Moon) 6. {extra card}

The Aquarius new moon is in your 2nd House of Disposable Income and Foundation. Aquarius is a fixed sign, which really brings the energy of stability, determination, and depth. This is a time to create more stability in your life and take stock of the financial lessons (positive and negative) you’ve learned this past year. This new moon asks that you focus on building your skills and strengthening your knowledge in the areas of money management, investments, and budgeting. These essential foundations will enable you to live with confidence, knowing that you are taking the correct steps to secure your financial future. It's helpful to remember that financial growth is not a linear process. This new moon is the perfect time to tap into your creativity and manifest financial abundance, explore new business ventures and make the most of your talents, assets, and work. Leverage the power of this new moon to embark on a journey of wealth creation. The Aquarius new moon guides you to rebel against and free yourself from any critical thoughts that sabotage your self-worth and self-esteem. The 2nd house themes surround resources, wealth building, and assets. Your health is your most valuable asset. It’s the one thing you can’t buy or trade for - it’s yours and yours alone. Think of your body like a bank account – you’ve got to make regular deposits if you want it to grow. It’s easy to take it for granted, but when it starts to fail, so does your ability to succeed in life. The fuel that you feed your body is the currency with which you invest in your well-being. Look after yourself, and you’ll see returns that translate into a richer, healthier, and fuller life. Your health is the ultimate resource – put it first and watch the dividends grow. Aquarius energy wants to help evolve the collective, towards progress. The Aquarius new moon reminds you that as you plan for your future endeavors, use the knowledge and skills that you've developed to help others. Share your strategies for financial success and be a listening ear for those who seek your guidance. Not only will you be of service to others, but you'll cultivate a sense of good karma and wealth in the process. The Aquarius new moon in the second house is a time to set intentions for stable income and security. Be mindful if any financial planets, like Venus or Mercury, are retrograde at this time. It is not always possible to avoid making financial plans during a retrograde period. If a decision needs to be acted on at this time, quadruple-check any documents and contracts that need to be signed during a possible unstable cosmic window. The second house is ruled by Taurus and corresponds to The Hierophant in the Major Arcana. The Hierophant is often seen as the embodiment of structure and consistency— two powerful ingredients in achieving success and financial stability. Think of the Hierophant as your guide or mentor — someone who has the experience and knowledge to get you on the path to success. Your mentor can help you stay focused by helping you set clear goals and providing guidance, support, and motivation when things aren’t going your way. By having a mentor or financial advisor to lean on, you can save time and effort because instead of making costly mistakes along the way, you’ll have someone there to show you the right way. So if you’re looking for help in setting up proper financial goals, perhaps it's time to seek out a Hierophant-type figure who can provide much-needed direction and assistance. The more you commit to yourself in the next six months, the more you’ll see your investments, income, and self-worth grow.

The Aquarius new moon illuminates your 3rd House of communication, early education, and your understanding of how to express yourselves, process information, to communicate with your community, your siblings, and your neighbors. The Aquarius new moon dares you to be different. The new moon brings a chance for disruptive insight and a shift in perspective—a chance for you to explore a new perspective. This new moon comes with a special reminder to reach out to those who bring magick into your life. The Universe is supporting all paths that lead to communication, connection, and collaboration. This is a powerful time for manifesting your dreams, so why not use this new moon to reach out to those who can help make them happen? Whether it be old friends, colleagues, family—even strangers. Spend some time writing: letters, emails, PR releases or hellos expressing what you're creating and how they can be part of it. You may find your newest ally as soon as this lunar cycle wanes. The 3rd house is ruled by Gemini and corresponds to The Lovers in the Major Arcana. The Lovers symbolize choice commitment, negotiating, harmonious flow of energy, and connections. Aquarius is ruled by Uranus and corresponds to The Fool in the Major Arcana. Uranus brings us flashes of insight, awakenings, unexpected breakdowns, and breakthroughs, as well as a need for independence from tradition. Its electrifying energy speeds things up and stimulates innovation in even the most ‘ordinary’. You can tap into Uranus’s energy by breaking away from the rules and norms of society, allowing yourself to think independently, and embracing change and innovation take a leap of faith. Be creative, daring, and open-minded, and allow yourself to make mistakes and learn from them. This is the energy of The Fool / Uranus, and it’s one that can bring unexpected opportunities. The combination of The Lovers and The Fool is guiding you to go with the flow of whatever is unfolding; with each choice moment - choose yourself. In doing so, you foster more meaningful relationships and connections by being authentic in your choices. Mercury is the Planetary Ruler of Gemini and corresponds to The Magician. The Magician symbolizes manifestation, mastering of self, working with energy, powerful intention, skill and wisdom, creation, willpower, telepathic communication, and speaking or writing your desire into existence. The Magician is the master of the elements, showing tools necessary for creation, or the process of transmuting that which resides in our minds and intentions into material reality. The arrangement of these elements on the card reveals the path to manifestation: swords (i.e., thoughts), cups (i.e., emotion), wands (i.e., Spirit and action), coins (i.e., physical manifestation), which are translated into intention, feeling, spiritual correctness and action, and physical effort, respectively. This magickal combination is what is necessary to herald thought into the physical form; in other words, manifesting. It's time to channel your inner Magician. With focus and willpower, you have the ability to craft whatever it is you want in life - whether it be physical, emotional, or mental. So start putting yourself out there, socialize and make meaningful connections. Make sure you're open to feedback and collaboration (it will help you refine your ideas). Remain open-minded (Aquarius). You never know who you might meet that could help propel your vision forward.

The Aquarius new moon illuminates your 4th house of home, family, and karma. The 4th house is a Karmic house, bringing family situations to the surface for a more profound understanding to learn, heal, and release. The Aquarius new moon reminds you that innovative, creative, and out-of-the-box thinking makes life easier. That said, there’s no better way to innovate than introducing smart-home devices into the lives of you and your loved ones. From senior care technology to fresh grocery home delivery, there are so many ways to use tech to stay connected and simplify day-to-day life activities. So do some thinking about how technology and the lack of it are either encouraging or hindering meaningful connections at home and with your family; then make adjustments accordingly. The 4th house is ruled by Cancer and corresponds to The Chariot in the Major Arcana. The Chariot symbolizes being active, in control, and taking direction of one's life; as well as needing to take control of one's emotions. The Chariot is a powerful reminder that you are in control of your actions, reactions and momentum. And, for many your Chariot is an extension of your home; where you transport your Self and things from one life event to another. The Chariot symbolizes the importance of having a safe and secure container to navigate life, successfully.

The Aquarius new moon illuminates your 5th House of Fun and Creativity. Nothing is stagnating about Uranus/Aquarius, and if you have big inspiration, you could gain a lot by taking action, even if it feels unpredictable. The new moon in the fifth house is a time for self-expression and if you’re feeling restricted, use art as a creative outlet for any stuck thoughts and emotions. Art gives you an outlet to self-express, inspire, and be inspired. Art (drawing, painting, dancing, music, singing, or writing) is a path to Self Discovery. Through art, you can explore your inner self, cope with difficult situations, resolve inner conflicts or express internal joys. Art can evoke calming effects and produce neural changes in your brain; art is a tool to rewire yourself from the inside out. The Aquarius new moon can bring about events and creative outlets for you to have the freedom to self-express. The 5th house is ruled by Leo and corresponds to Strength in the Major Arcana. The Strength card reminds you of a sacred power, grounded in inner-strength and trust, that comes from emotional mastery. The Strength card of the Golden Eclipse tarot illustrates the Fool sitting poised, channeling the energy of the Universe. The lion is a metaphor for the primal energies of the emotional body, the flames referencing its burning passions. Strength symbolizes being in tune with your inner creative flow when time seems to stand still. It symbolizes the power of channeling Source. When you focus on creating from a place of pure presence, you can tap into a field of awareness that unlocks all the infinite possibilities of creation. Your work will come alive and flow through you—not just by you. Strength and the Aquarius New Moon asks that you find that one thing that allows you to access this magick within yourself. When your heart and Light (both ruled by Leo) are connected, you can create something from a place of pure presence; which can be a liberating (Aquarius) and purposeful experience. So, like the Fool, which corresponds to Uranus one of the planetary rulers of Aquarius, take the leap by exploring what makes you feel as if time no longer exists. Tap into your passion and don’t be afraid to dive into it. You never know what kind of inspiration, motivation, and success it can unlock for you.

The Aquarius new moon illuminates your 6th House of Health and Being of Service. This is the time to set intentions to cultivate healthy routines and daily habits which support your nervous system and overall well-being. The smallest of daily shifts can help build impactful change. Aquarius is co-ruled by Uranus and Saturn. Uranus' energy can be disruptive, which can cause anxiety when your body senses that something is shifting, and not quite right. This is a natural response. This new moon highlights the need to create a new self-care regimen that supports managing stress and anxiety. It's time to tune into your body and mind, and create positive daily rituals and daily routines that provide more freedom and choice while supporting your mental and physical health. In a world full of demands, it can be tough to find the balance between being productive and taking care of your mental health. The Aquarius new moon offers some ideas that can help you create daily practices to support your nervous system and give yourself freedom and choice: use technology like sleeping apps to track your sleep health; start each day with a cup of chamomile tea; use a meditation app or join a virtual meditation group; incorporate yoga or stretching into your daily routine. These small shifts can make all the difference in managing stress and staying healthy. Make sure you take the time to check in with yourself, recognize where you are overextending yourself, and practice self-care. The sixth house is ruled by Virgo and corresponds to The Hermit. The Hermit symbolizes introspection for personal and spiritual development, taking space from a situation or person to gain perspective, a meeting with a wise person who aids one's journey, and the answers you seek can be found within. Virgo and the Hermit observe. The Hermit encourages you to purify your mind to look closely at yourself, so you can start taking note of the ways in which you give too much of yourself. With patience, contemplation, and observation, you can make small changes in your daily routines which can add up to create an impactful transformation.

recoveredFrom.heading: Virgo (Aug 23 - Sept 22) & Scorpio Rising - New moon in the 6th House
recoveredFrom.note: The heading contains a Scorpio Rising typo. The Virgo sign tag, 6th-house placement, body, and surrounding Aquarius sequence identify this as Virgo rising. A trailing page-number artifact was removed from the body.

entries.body: The Aquarius new moon illuminates your 7th house of relationships. Allowing you to heal, empathize with others and lead with your heart; in hopes of creating a more sustainable and compassionate existence. Aquarius is the water carrier, and the waters he carries are given freely to others without expectation. Embrace the power of an unbound life. Free yourself from expectations, relationships, and the status quo that are holding you back. Instead, focus on being true to your unique spirit and accepting the truth of who you are at your core. The Aquarius new moon in the seventh house can signal a time to set intentions to call in a new relationship, or create more harmony and balance in a relationship, or to open yourself up to explore commitments (marriage, engagement, moving in together, starting a business). The 7th house is ruled by Libra and corresponds to Justice in the Major Arcana. Justice symbolizes cause and effect, the workings of destiny or karma, the consequences or rewards of past actions, law, trial, justice, truth, balance, achieving balance after tribulations, retribution, the law on your side, favorable outcome of judicial matters, responsible conduct, making well-balanced choices, and integrity. The Justice card indicates that you may be wrestling with how to appropriately handle an unjust situation. And, with the New Moon in Aquarius; Aquarius energy includes being fearless, independent, a rebel, and a warrior for social justice. You don’t always have to wait for someone else to bring justice. You can take the initiative to create it yourself. When faced with injustice, sometimes the best course of action may be simply to acknowledge mistreatment and move on. Other times, however, you can approach a situation with a plan, well-crafted arguments, and talking points that honor your personal values and make sure those who wronged you are held accountable. Whether tackling a business contract or navigating the conflicts of a past relationship; if you’re prepared to stand up for what’s right and get creative in finding solutions, you can achieve justice, correct the scales and find balance without having to wait for others.

The Aquarius new moon illuminates your 8th house of transformation, symbolism, and other people's money. The new moon in the eighth house signals a time to set intentions to learn or further develop your craft: tarot, astrology, and occult studies. The new moon in Aquarius is a time when you can more easily channel information that exists in the ether. During this new moon, take time to divine information that will support you in making decisions and navigating the next 6 months. This Aquarius new moon encourages you to tap into and strengthen your intuition. Aquarius is unique, a rebel and this energy shows you it takes courage to go off script, against the mainstream, and into the unknown. Like The Fool, which corresponds to Uranus, one of the Planetary Rulers of Aquarius - if you're ready to take a leap of faith and trust yourself, you'll find strength, self-reliance, and security on the other side. Every successful journey has moments of doubt and uncertainty. Yet, when you take ownership of your decisions and rely on your own intuition and judgment, you build self-reliance, security, and ultimately self-reliance. So dig deep, let your intuition guide you, and never stop developing the magick that lies within you. The 8th house is ruled by Scorpio and corresponds to The Death tarot card. Death can symbolize change, transformation, rebirth, the end of a cycle, separation or 'death' from one's old self or old life. Death signals a time of spiritual and psychological rebirth where the spirit reconnects with the authentic self and the soul's purpose. It’s also a time when you are pushed to go deeper, opening the portal between the seen and unseen worlds. Gifting you access not only to your own potential for spiritual growth and healing - but also healing of your ancestors. Life is full of change. It is an undeniable fact of the human experience. As life changes, you can become entrenched in fear and anxiety over the loss of what has been or the opportunity cost of what could have been instead. In these moments, it is helpful to remember that death isn't an ending, but a transition. It's not about giving up on hope, but rather shifting your attention to what is available in the present moment, combined with intuition to fuel your choices. Let go of the fear of loss or missed opportunities and embrace the transformation that death brings. Surrendering to the unknown and trusting in your own resilience allows you to move forward a little bit wiser and better prepared for what lies ahead.

The Aquarius new moon activates your 9th House of Higher Self. This is a powerful time to connect to life's mysteries and tap into the magick that lies beneath the surface. The Aquarian new moon asks you to question what you see, opening your eyes to the deeper meaning behind the events unfolding around you. Set intentions to meditate, deepen your relationship with your Higher Self and prioritize your spiritual and emotional wellness. The Aquarius new moon in your 9th house may be a sign that the Universe is opening the door to exciting new opportunities. Now is the perfect moment to explore foreign cultures, religions, and educational pursuits. You may even feel the desire to delve deeper into the topics of philosophy, publishing, or law. Going on an adventure can often be a liberating experience, leading to many unexpected discoveries. The Aquarius new moon could bring your attention to these topics and encourage you to explore them deeply. It is important to trust your intuition and take time to reflect during this period in order to gain knowledge and find meaning. The more you learn about Spirituality and life’s mysteries, the more you realize just how much there is to discover. That is the beauty of life - it's a never-ending journey of exploration, knowledge, and growth. The 9th house is ruled by Sagittarius and corresponds to Temperance in the Major Arcana. Temperance symbolizes the merging of the spiritual and mundane worlds, discovering our purpose or meaning, mindfulness of overindulging or drinking, moderation, the balance of passion and reason, and cultivating patience. It’s possible you aspire to understand the truth and wisdom behind the mysteries. It's possible that you are struggling, seeking to understand the greater meanings of life, asking questions like, “What is life? What did my soul come to learn this lifetime?” You are looking for greater meaning in the mundane world of the day-to-day, perhaps through something spiritual. The search for true wisdom isn't linear, but diving into the mysteries of life can bring tremendous rewards. Temperance, on a spiritual level, speaks of the potential for true communication with your Higher Self. When you are open to fate and curious about synchronicities, your Higher self can make its presence known. The planetary ruler of Sagittarius/Temperance is Jupiter, which corresponds to The Wheel of Fortune. The Wheel of Fortune themes includes a change of fate, luck, expansion, fate, destiny, positive karma, and the beginning or end of a cycle. This new moon encourages you to remain curious and open-minded to new chance encounters, invites, and unexpected opportunities. You know that feeling when the Universe is conspiring in your favor? This is the essence of the Aquarius new moon in the 9th house. This is a moment when saying ‘yes’ to a new opportunity, interview, helping someone, or a vacation could lead you on an adventure where you'll discover your new best friend, new career, life partner, new residency or something else entirely. This new moon reminds me of the saying, be careful what you wish for - you must just be limited yourself. This new moon’s energy is the perfect time to take a leap of faith and say yes to new opportunities, adventures, and people life has in store for you.

The Aquarius new moon illuminates your 10th House of Career and Purpose. Aquarians are future-minded and often connected with information, technology, humanitarian efforts, community, and networking. Aquarius is the rebel that helps break down the oppressive norms that keep us in the status quo. The non-conformists push you to think differently and challenge what you know. The Aquarian new moon is a time to set intentions to see how leveraging emerging technology can advance your career. The 10th house is ruled by Capricorn which corresponds to The Devil in the Major Arcana. The Devil pushes you to grow past the fears of your lower nature, into a more mature version of yourself. The Devil speaks to your false belief that you are trapped or stuck in your current circumstances. The Devil can symbolize struggles with a moral problem — a choice between lust or love, obsession or liberation; but mostly, it can indicate you’re overwhelmed with your international dialogue and finding it difficult to stay focused. During this time your thoughts can become a distraction. Also with the energy of The Devil tarot card, be mindful to not entertain any unhealthy workplace crushes or obsessions. Overthinking is an integral part of this Aquarian new moon energy. While this energy can help you think things through, it can also lead to emotional and mental exhaustion if you aren’t practicing awareness. The Devil can also create restlessness energy. So if you’re feeling bored or uninspired with the work you do, or your work surroundings (office), don’t be afraid to take initiative. Take it upon yourself to identify areas that need improvement, challenge outdated ideas, systems, and software (Aquarius), and help create solutions that will make the work you do, and the workplace more stimulating. The Aquarius new moon set intentions to come up with creative solutions and revamp your work and workplace.

The Aquarius new moon illuminates your 11th house of friendship. This new moon set the intention to call in people, places, and lifestyles that make you feel like your most authentic self. This new moon brings with it a powerful invitation to be more intentional with your relationships. It's time to surround yourself with those with a similar soul view and personal vibration. Let the energy of this powerful lunar phase draw you closer to those who will nurture and support you and understand and accept you for who you are. Make time for meaningful conversations and connections, because great things can happen when like minds come together. Surround yourself with people who lift you up, inspire you, and support your freedom. Breakthroughs are a signature Uranus/Aquarius trait, so whatever you're experiencing now, find ways to support your nervous system. The 11th house is ruled by Aquarius which corresponds to The Star. You’re feeling an extra dose of this Aquarian new moon energy. The Star symbolizes a wish granted, hope, inspiration, being on stage/entertainment, muse energy, a rebirth of opportunity, rejuvenation of the spirit, a broader vision of the future, drawing inspiration from the beauty that surrounds you, having faith in the future, calm that is necessary to connect with the soul, faith brings strength and free flow of energy. The Star is a card of one's wish is granted, as she rules over the Law of Attraction. You possess the power to create your reality, and that can start with being intentional with your thoughts, feelings, and who you surround yourself with. If you are an artist: writer, musician, artist, actor, etc. this is a time to set the intention to have yourself and your work seen. If you have an established network, use it. If you are starting to build your network and community - put energy into being seen, and discovered for your art and talents. The Star is asking you to re-align with your spark — something deeper than simply relaxing, or "taking space." You're being asked to take the steps to work on the inner parts of yourself that need your attention and that you've been deflecting or ignoring.

The Aquarius new moon activates your 12th house of karma, subconscious, and endings. Aquarius can tune into different frequencies and receive information beyond what one can physically see and hear. Sometimes this can even be in the form of dreams or insights that eventually end up as new innovations, inventions, and emerging technologies to help move humanity forward. Dreaming is an entryway to collective knowledge. During the Aquarius new moon, let's take a moment to honor this ancestral wisdom and access the limitless potential that lives within us. Set the intention to tune into your inner frequency and take a moment to listen; you have access now to the wisdom of lifetimes. Have you ever had a dream that felt like a download of ancient wisdom? Paying attention to your dreams during this new moon, can help unlock knowledge and possibly clarify your current reality. Giving you the insight you need to make the right choices. So if you find yourself receiving downloads of information from past or future lifetimes, don't be afraid to explore them. On a cellular level, you all hold memories of each of the lifetimes you have ever experienced as well as the lifetimes we one day are going to experience. Just as you can leverage Past Live Regression to guide you in achieving your goals. You can use Future Progression to guide you in seeing future obstacles and opportunities. Tuning into a future lifestyle frequency allow you to see what lies ahead you are better prepared to change the conditions that pave the way. Allow your Higher Self to guide you beyond your immediate awareness, to remain open to receiving innovative solutions to help guide you, from a future point in this lifetime frequency. Allow your future lifetime frequency to help bring your ideas and vision for the future to this present moment. Allow your Higher Self to support your big ideas. Discover insight to questions such as, “What hidden opportunities are around you that will further your current goals and vision?” The 12th house is ruled by Pisces and corresponds to The Moon in the Major Arcana. The Moon is associated with illusion, mysticism, and lunar magick. It can also be associated with confusion, emotionally charged dreams, a period of introspection, and the need to guard oneself against deception. During this time, it can be a struggle to differentiate between illusion and reality. The moon, Luna, is a reminder that life is a natural pattern of cycles. Rhythms exist throughout nature in the changing of the seasons and the different stages of natural development. The Moon represents this Law of Rhythm that governs the natural cycles of life. She embodies this rhythm in her lunar phases of mounting and diminishing waxing and waning energies. Remember that the moon is a mirror; she is a reflection of your Self, your fears, and your subconscious thoughts. Jupiter is the ancient planetary ruler of the 12th house, which corresponds to The Hanged Man. The Hanged Man symbolizes enlightenment, intuition, pause, meditation, and stillness. The Hanged Man, Neptune, Pisces, and the 12th house signal the end of a cycle; depending on where you are in your journey, this can be a time of positive or negative reflection. The Hanged Man asks you to face what you may have been avoiding. It requires you to release your fears of failure and of success; to release the pressure you place on yourself. This is also a time of contemplation, meditation, and rebirth. The Hanged Man, and this new moon, may force you to slow down, particularly if you aren't inclined to do so on your own. It’s important to take care of your health at this time; especially getting enough sleep and restoration. The Hanged Man may also represent a moment of brief enlightenment in which a spark of inspiration or knowledge comes from above. All you need to do is to sit in stillness. Your new moon intention, “I am a direct channel to universal consciousness, and I allow new information to guide me towards my next steps.”

The Leo full moon is illuminating your 1st house of Self. It's a time for celebration and an excellent opportunity to celebrate all you are. The last 18 months have been life-changing for you, Leo.
